scope: Lesson-level skill tags and explicit task-level semantic recurrence evidence; not a complete taxonomy of every subskill and not learner trial evidence.

focus.zh: 大数读写
focus.en: Reading and writing larger numbers

rationale.zh: 两处Q1由读法生成数字；新Q6反向读回20,305/40,506、展开并解释逗号可省与删除内部零改位。接受熟悉语言或读题协助，不以英文发音评数学。
rationale.en: Both Q1s generate numerals from names. New Q6s read back20,305/40,506, expand them and distinguish optional commas from value-changing internal-zero deletion. Familiar languages/reading support are accepted without scoring English pronunciation.

focus.zh: 位值与展开
focus.en: Place value and expansion

rationale.zh: 两处Q2重建百/千贡献；新Q6各从原数分别移一张数字卡、整数乘10、千位增加1，生成三个新数和变化量，区分一张卡贡献十倍与总数十倍。
rationale.en: Both Q2s rebuild hundreds/thousands contributions. New Q6s independently move one card, multiply the entire number by ten and increment thousands, generating every result/change and separating card-contribution scaling from whole-number scaling.

focus.zh: 数轴、比较与排序
focus.en: Number lines, comparison and ordering

rationale.zh: Q3从非零起点定位；新Q7各判最高不同数位/位数，再从两张完整窗口表重建同P/Q及差，解释改窗不改数值顺序；亲修非统一图距，不以纸上位置当数值。
rationale.en: Q3s locate from nonzero origins. New Q7s compare the highest differing place/digit lengths, independently reconstruct the SAME P/Q and difference from two complete windows, explain invariant values/order and repair an inconsistently spaced scale.

focus.zh: 直接舍入与估算
focus.en: Direct rounding and estimation

rationale.zh: Q4核原数直接舍入与足量；新Q8逐行重建邻居、中点、距离与所需精度，19,995到十和99,950到百的中点连续进位亲生成，不以不同精度结果相异判错，原精确值保留。另B03-L05-Q5对199m/302m、P52-L02-Q5对1.24km/2.67km分别先舍入各量再估合计，并区分精确合计，补齐多量估算子目标。
rationale.en: Q4s audit direct rounding and sufficiency. New Q8s generate neighbours, midpoint, distances and requested precision, including actual halfway carries at19,995/tens and99,950/hundreds, retaining exact inputs and distinguishing valid different precisions. B03-L05-Q5 and P52-L02-Q5 additionally round EACH of199m/302m or1.24km/2.67km before estimating sums, distinguishing approximate from exact totals.

focus.zh: 十进制换组守恒
focus.en: Conserved value in base-ten exchanges

rationale.zh: 原Q5保换组守恒；新Q9从单位值100/10/1与实际数量表亲画同块数不同值的320/302或430/403，并双向换1百/10十，核新块数14/16、总值不变与内部零。
rationale.en: Original Q5s retain exchange conservation. New Q9s use given100/10/1 unit values and type counts to draw equal-block-count but unequal-value320/302 or430/403 diagrams, exchange in BOTH directions and check14/16 new blocks, invariant totals and placeholders.

focus.zh: 整体与部分
focus.en: Wholes and parts

rationale.zh: B03把原有书与新增书合成整体；B06保持9+未知部分=24的关系，解释问号位置改变时为何用加或减。两处都要求重新生成结果或理由，保留整体、部分及逆向核查。 新B06/P51各Q1生成合并、拿走、未移物的比较、整体已含已知部分四种图式，并独立预测新增1的变化。
rationale.en: B03 combines existing and newly received books into a whole. B06 keeps 9+unknown part=24 and explains why moving the unknown changes the required operation. Both regenerate an answer or argument using whole-part structure and an inverse check. New B06/P51 Q1s generate combining, removal, unchanged-object comparison and included-part models, plus an independent one-more prediction.

focus.zh: 比较中的差
focus.en: Differences in comparisons

rationale.zh: B05从同一人数图读出公交10与步行8的差2；B06比较17m与9m得差8，并由Mina有9张且比Noah多4张反求Noah的5张。比较不要求拿走物体，“多”也不能机械触发加法。 新两组Q1在拿走和未移动两组中分别画同一减法的不同含义，保留两组原量与差/总量区分。
rationale.en: B05 reads a difference of two between bus count ten and walking count eight on one chart. B06 compares 17m with 9m, then works backwards from Mina having nine cards, four more than Noah, to Noah having five. Comparison need not remove objects, and the word more does not mechanically imply addition. New Q1s draw different meanings of the same subtraction for removal versus two unmoved groups, retaining original amounts and separating difference from combined total.

focus.zh: 等组与阵列
focus.en: Equal groups and arrays

rationale.zh: B03纠正6×(5+3)只给一行加3的错误，须把余下的3重复六行；B06把4cm×3cm的区域解释为三行、每行四个1cm²方格，共12cm²。两处把等组或阵列连接到乘法，而不是把组数与每组量相加。 新两组Q2亲画阵列并说明换行列后的角色，按实际2/4/7或3/5/9修不等组，并区分零组与有组每组零。
rationale.en: B03 repairs counting the remaining three only once in 6×(5+3), instead of repeating them across six rows. B06 interprets a 4cm by 3cm region as three rows of four 1cm² cells, totalling 12cm². Both connect equal groups or arrays to multiplication rather than adding group count and group size. New Q2s generate arrays and swapped row/column roles, repair unequal 2/4/7 or 3/5/9 groups, and distinguish zero groups from existing empty groups.

focus.zh: 平均分与包含
focus.en: Sharing and grouping

rationale.zh: P51先把24张卡分四行求每行6张，再将25张按每袋6张核查四满袋余1张，复现平均分与包含两种未知角色。P61把3/4L平均给两人得每人3/8L，再区分2L按每份3/4L的8/3份、两满份和余1/2L。两个后续单元都含两种除法意义；完整卡片与可分液体的范围及“份”“升”不能混淆。 新两组Q3用29/6或38/7及整除、零总量分别求分享/满箱/全部容器，余数正才加箱，另可分液体保精确分式及单位。
rationale.en: P51 shares 24 cards into four rows to find six per row, then groups 25 cards six per bag to check four full bags and one card left. P61 shares 3/4L between two people to get 3/8L each, then distinguishes 8/3 portions of size 3/4L from two full portions and 1/2L left. Both later units use sharing and grouping; respect indivisible cards versus divisible liquid and distinguish portion counts from litres. New Q3s use 29/6 or 38/7, exact-divisibility and zero-total cases to distinguish sharing, full boxes and minimum all-item containers, adding a box only for positive remainder and retaining exact divisible-liquid shares.

focus.zh: 用乘法核查除法
focus.en: Checking division with multiplication

rationale.zh: B03用201×5=1005及21×5=105检查商的占位零；P55从4x=5求精确因数5/4，又解释0x=0不能唯一确定x、0x=5无解。两处用乘法关系核查逆向恢复因数，后者明确保留非零除数条件，不能由乘回成立就允许除零。 新两组Q4逐行核非零、等因数、零组、零每组与双零，保两种商角色及相同字面式，亲自给出两个不同的□值满足0×□=0，说明反推不唯一，不能据此允许除零。
rationale.en: B03 checks quotient placeholders with 201×5=1005 and 21×5=105. P55 recovers exact factor 5/4 from 4x=5 and explains why 0x=0 does not determine a unique x while 0x=5 has no solution. Both use multiplication to check recovered factors; the latter explicitly retains the nonzero-divisor condition rather than treating a multiplication check as permission to divide by zero. New Q4s audit nonzero, equal-factor, zero-group, zero-size and double-zero rows, retain quotient roles despite identical expressions, and generate distinct zero-product witnesses without authorising zero division.

focus.zh: 按数量关系选运算
focus.en: Choosing operations from relationships

rationale.zh: B06解释四盒每盒6张、合计送出5张应为4×6−5，4×(6−5)改变送出对象；P51从预算3000与十八套每套125生成3000−18×125=750。两处按数量角色决定先求等组总量，再从整体扣除，而不是见数就加减或按关键词猜。 新两组Q5依未知量和单位分别选择四种运算，再构造预算内的整数两物品采购修改，核成本、超额与余额，允许多种有效方案。
rationale.en: B06 explains why four boxes of six cards with five given away in total requires 4×6−5, while 4×(6−5) changes what is removed. P51 constructs 3000−18×125=750 from a budget and eighteen identically priced sets. Both choose operations from quantity roles: form an equal-group total, then subtract from a whole. New Q5s select all four operations from unknown roles/units, then construct integer two-item budget repairs, checking costs, excess and balance while accepting multiple valid plans.

focus.zh: 进退位与等值换组
focus.en: Regrouping with conserved place value

rationale.zh: 两组分别要求508−279、267+158和602−358、386+247的百十个换组及逆查。跨零退位与连续进位均须解释每次等值交换，不能只交最终数值。新增两组Q1还逐列生成最终进位、千位跨零顶行、零结果及倒减反例的逆查。
rationale.en: The two sets require place-value exchanges and inverse checks for 508−279, 267+158 and 602−358, 386+247. Both regrouping across zero and successive carries require conserved-value explanations, not merely final numbers. New Q1s also generate the final carry, a thousands-level across-zero row, a zero result and an inverse rejection of column reversal.

focus.zh: 乘法事实与拆分策略
focus.en: Multiplication facts and decomposition

rationale.zh: P51把九排18拆为九排20减九排2，用10+8再查；P52把七盒16拆为七盒10加七盒6，用20−4再查。两处重新调用乘法事实，说明每组的余部也须重复，保留加法与减法两种拆分。新增Q2移动同阵列切线含两端空块，区分右块与总量、零行与空行，并亲算只加倍一个因数和两个因数的不同结果。
rationale.en: P51 decomposes nine rows of eighteen into nine twenties minus nine twos, checked using ten plus eight. P52 decomposes seven sixteens using ten plus six, checked using twenty minus four. Both retrieve multiplication facts and explain why every group repeats both parts, covering additive and subtractive strategies. New Q2s move the same array cut including empty edges, distinguish partial/whole and no/empty rows, and generate one-factor versus two-factor doubling.

focus.zh: 两位乘法的面积分拆
focus.en: Area partitions for two-digit multiplication

rationale.zh: 两处分别画24×13与32×21的四块面积，标十位所代表的实际边长，求312与672 cm²并反查。必须四块无重叠无缺口，不把十位数字当个位，不能仅靠别的算法算出同一积充当面积模型。新增Q3亲画统一比例的四区，合成横带部分积，反推错误高度，另求长度和与周长，并保留两项零宽面积。
rationale.en: Both require four labelled area partitions for 24×13 and 32×21, giving 312 and 672 cm² and an inverse check. Tens represent actual side lengths. Complete nonoverlapping coverage and place values are required; a product from an unrelated algorithm is insufficient. New Q3s generate four regions with a common scale, horizontal partial products, the erroneous height, side sum and perimeter, including two zero-width regions.

focus.zh: 长除法占位与余数
focus.en: Long-division placeholders and remainders

rationale.zh: 1027按5装袋与1213按6装盒都须在商的十位保留0，解释余量换小单位，给完整组数和余数，并核5×205+2或6×202+1及余数界限。零占位、落位与余数语义在两个单元都重新生成。新增Q4逐位核开头零与中间零、少于一盒与零总量，区分满盒/全部最少盒/精确商，并亲造余数过大的恒等式再修复。
rationale.en: Grouping 1027 by five and 1213 by six both requires a zero tens digit, an exchange into smaller units, full-group counts and remainders. Check 5×205+2 or 6×202+1 and remainder bounds. Both units regenerate placeholder, division-step and remainder meanings. New Q4s generate every unit row, leading/internal zeros, below-one-box and zero totals, full/minimum-all/exact quotients, and an identity with an oversized remainder that must be repaired.

focus.zh: 估算筛查与精确核验
focus.en: Estimation screens and exact checks

rationale.zh: P51用200×20估198×21，再用上界排除41580并精确拆分得4158；P52用600−300估602−298，再核304+298=602。都给“接近估数却仍错误”的反例，保留估算不是精确证明的边界。新增Q5同时生成加乘减的舍入、原数端点与可靠界限（减法交叉），筛外部与近邻候选，保单位；自创并修订50元方案，比较近似与精确余额。
rationale.en: P51 estimates 198×21 using 200×20, rejects 41580 with an upper bound, and exactly decomposes to 4158. P52 estimates 602−298 using 600−300 and checks 304+298=602. Both include a nearby but wrong counterexample, distinguishing estimation from exact proof. New Q5s generate addition/product/difference rounding and operand bounds, cross subtraction endpoints, screen outside/nearby candidates with units, and invent then repair a fifty-dollar plan with estimated/exact balances.

focus.zh: 整体、等份与分数数量
focus.en: Wholes, equal shares and fraction amounts

rationale.zh: P53从四等份条生成5/4并解释改分母须同步改份数；P54解释小饼与大饼的两个一半不能直接当成一个小饼，又把1m换成5/5m求余3/5m。两单元都保持同一整体、等份单位和所取份数，扩展到一整体边界与超过一。新Q1生成取走/剩余互补，含零/全部；分母保原整体，不改成余格数。
rationale.en: P53 generates 5/4 from quarter strips and explains why changing partition size also changes part count. P54 explains why halves of different-sized cakes cannot be called one small cake and rewrites one metre as 5/5m before subtracting 2/5m. Both retain whole, equal-share unit and selected count, including the one-whole boundary and amounts above one. New Q1s generate removed/remaining complements including zero/all with the original denominator.

focus.zh: 分母要求等份
focus.en: Denominators require equal parts

rationale.zh: P53纠正三块不等大仍各标1/3；P51、P52都须说明每个整体内部等分，再比较单位分数及不同整体。不是只数块数，也不把不同整体的相同比例当相同实际量。新Q1从不等长等宽纸带求各段分数，生成真正四等份修图与长度。
rationale.en: P53 repairs labelling three unequal regions as thirds. P51 and P52 require equal partitions within each whole, then compare unit fractions and changed wholes. Piece count alone is insufficient, and equal fractions of different wholes need not be equal amounts. New Q1s compute unequal strip shares and generate genuine quarters and lengths.

focus.zh: 同整体单位分数比较
focus.en: Comparing unit fractions of a common whole

rationale.zh: P51比较同一米的1/2与1/5，P52比较同一升的1/3与1/4；两处都解释等份越多一份越小，再用不同整体下实际相等的例子核查适用条件。新Q2合成二/四个四分之一，求三种单位份的厘米数；大整体四分之一实际更长不翻转数值1/4<1/2。
rationale.en: P51 compares halves and fifths of one metre; P52 compares thirds and quarters of one litre. Both explain why more equal shares make each smaller and check the common-whole condition using equal actual amounts from different wholes. New Q2s join two/four quarters and compute half/third/quarter lengths; a longer physical quarter does not reverse numerical 1/4<1/2.

focus.zh: 分数数轴的单位与区间
focus.en: Units and intervals on fraction number lines

rationale.zh: J71从−3/4按每格1/4向右走两格到−1/4，区分移动与终点；J75用半单位网格描(3/2,−1/2)并投影读回。两处都需由分数单位数区间、定位而非数刻度点；后者在两条轴上迁移。新Q3列全刻度与区间数，重等分保同一P，修不均纸尺，并区分1/3与三位显示0.333。
rationale.en: J71 moves two quarter-unit intervals from −3/4 to −1/4 and distinguishes movement from endpoint. J75 plots (3/2,−1/2) on half-unit grids and reads back projections. Both count fractional-unit intervals to locate values, not tick marks; the latter transfers the idea to two axes. New Q3s enumerate ticks, repartition while preserving P, repair unequal spacing and distinguish exact thirds from a three-place display.

focus.zh: 十进小份与小数等值
focus.en: Decimal subunits and equivalence

rationale.zh: P52把4百分之一换40千分之一并解释0.040=0.04；P62须以每百分之一解释0.6=60%，再把0.375与37.5/100连起来。两处都按小份单位保持数量，不能靠添零或添百分号的外观。新Q4亲画原百格板，生成0/100边界、两种小数单位、占位/尾零的不同删法及同单位比较。
rationale.en: P52 converts four hundredths to forty thousandths and explains 0.040=0.04. P62 explains 0.6=60% using hundredths and connects 0.375 to 37.5/100. Both preserve amount through subunit meaning rather than appending zeros or percent signs by appearance. New Q4s generate hundred grids including zero/full, decimal units, contrasting zero deletions and common-unit comparison.

focus.zh: 小数钱数与找零
focus.en: Decimal money and change

rationale.zh: P52由NZ$4.80分四份得1.20，并算5−2.35−1.20=1.45；P57核6−2.40−3=0.60、7.80比7短0.80，且解释整盒实际付款。保留百分之一元的位值、末零等值、合价与找零，模型金额均虚构。新Q5分清完整元、小数部分几分与总分，先估价再用整数分精算找零反查，自编有效方案；真实价签以后另记。
rationale.en: P52 shares NZ$4.80 into four amounts of 1.20 and calculates change 5−2.35−1.20=1.45. P57 checks change 0.60, a shortfall of 0.80 and full-carton payment. Both retain cent place values, equivalent final zeros, combined costs and change. Prices are fictional. New Q5s separate whole dollars, decimal-part cents and total cents, estimate then compute/check exact change and invent valid plans. Real observations remain separate.

focus.zh: 长度、起点与单位换算
focus.en: Length, origins and unit conversion

rationale.zh: 两处都由非零尺起点求端点差，平移到零点核验，并在cm与mm间双向换算；6.5cm=65mm、85mm=8.5cm。明确读的是物理长度而非终点位置或屏幕像素。新Q1另核零长度、厘米间隔与刻度点、混合米厘米、毫米到米及米到千米，全部先写单位关系再换回核。
rationale.en: Both subtract nonzero ruler endpoints, translate to zero as a check and convert in opposite directions: 6.5cm=65mm and 85mm=8.5cm. They distinguish physical length from endpoint position and screen pixels. New Q1s additionally generate zero length, interval/tick counts, mixed metre/centimetre conversion and metre/kilometre equivalents with inverse checks.

focus.zh: 周界长度与面积的区别
focus.en: Boundary length versus area

rationale.zh: P56逐边核2×4与3×3矩形的周长均12cm而方格数8与9；J72由长n+2、宽n逐边推出4n+4cm，并与n(n+2)cm²区别。两处都要数完整周界而非两条相邻边或内部格数。新Q2逐边生成完整周界，另算正方形、三角形、由半周长反求缺边；用同周长不同面积的实际数值检验。
rationale.en: P56 checks the complete twelve-centimetre boundaries of 2×4 and 3×3 rectangles despite different areas. J72 derives 4n+4cm from all sides of a rectangle of length n+2 and width n, contrasting n(n+2)cm². Both require the full boundary rather than two adjacent sides or interior cells. New Q2s trace every side, find square/triangle perimeters and a missing rectangle side, and compute equal-perimeter/different-area cases.

focus.zh: 方格覆盖与面积守恒
focus.en: Cell coverage and conserved area

rationale.zh: P56用8与9个单位格区分同周长不同面积，并以不重叠切拼解释三角形覆盖；P61把同一单位框细分成3×4格，只选交叠6格得1/2，解释部分选择而非整框。从单位平方格迁移到单位框分格，均须只计实际覆盖、保留原整体。新Q3从原已覆盖列号生成空格、整图旋转后的空格坐标与面积，重排同格数却不同周长；再改变单位格边长亲算实际面积，并核清空与重涂。
rationale.en: P56 counts eight versus nine unit cells despite equal perimeters and explains triangle area by rearrangement without overlap. P61 partitions the same unit frame into 3×4 cells and selects six overlap cells, giving 1/2, explaining selected coverage rather than the bounding frame. Both retain the whole and count only covered area, transferring from square units to subcells of a unit frame. New Q3s reconstruct holes and rotated coordinates, rearrange the same cells to different perimeters, recompute enlarged-cell areas and check cleared/repainted coverage.

focus.zh: 角的开口与图形定义
focus.en: Angle openings and shape definitions

rationale.zh: 两处都从四等边四直角判断旋转后的正方形仍属于长方形；分别核四分之一圈90°与半圈180°，并解释60°角延长或缩短线臂仍60°。同时区分圆的曲线边界与0条直边、三角形的3条直边，补足角度、包含式分类和朝向不变性，不能以只算一个角覆盖整个宽标签。新Q4逐个分类0至180的边界，比较整图与单臂转动、同向与反向净转向，给长方形逆命题及三角形全称的反例，不凭图像外观证明。
rationale.en: Both classify a rotated four-equal-sided, four-right-angled shape as both square and rectangle. They check quarter turns of 90° and half turns of 180° and explain why extending or shortening a 60° angle leaves its opening fixed. Both also distinguish a circle’s curved boundary and zero straight sides from a triangle’s three straight sides. Evidence covers angles, inclusive classification and orientation invariance, not merely one angle calculation. New Q4s classify angle boundaries, distinguish whole/one-arm turns and net directions, and generate rectangle/triangle counterexamples without treating appearance as proof.

focus.zh: 图表原数值、刻度与缺测
focus.en: Chart values, scales and missing observations

rationale.zh: P57区分从38起画时40与44的原值和显示高度2与6；P68纵轴上限翻倍仍须读12、18、缺测、24，并求指定两天36人次。两单元都重新使用轴起点、单位与刻度，明确缺测不能当零、显示高度不能直接当人数。新Q5从原区间数还原互斥类别与零人数，自画两种刻度、合计/指定和/差；另给10张独立ID纸卡自编分类与图，查重并限定结论。
rationale.en: P57 distinguishes values forty and forty-four from displayed heights two and six above a baseline of thirty-eight. P68 retains records twelve, eighteen, missing and twenty-four after doubling the axis maximum and sums two specified days to thirty-six visits. Both use origin, units and scales; missing is not zero and plotted height is not the count. New Q5s reconstruct exclusive counts including zero, draw both scales and distinct totals/comparisons, then classify ten unique paper-card IDs, draw their charts and check duplicates and inference limits.

focus.zh: 已知未知与量纲
focus.en: Knowns, unknowns and quantity units

rationale.zh: P52区分3瓶与每瓶0.5L，不能把瓶数当升数相加；P55明确定义每袋未知x和袋外已知2支，列3x+2=20；P56面积前先统一4m与50cm。三个单元要求识别量的角色和单位，先确定所求再算，不是见数全相加。新Q1从原信息卡区分直接读全长与求剩余，统一混合长度、定位问号和重复计入的部分，鸟数改变不改长度关系。
rationale.en: P52 distinguishes three bottles from 0.5L per bottle. P55 defines unknown x per bag and two known loose items before forming 3x+2=20. P56 unifies four metres and fifty centimetres before finding area. These tasks identify roles, units and the requested quantity before calculation rather than adding every number. New Q1s distinguish reading a given from finding remaining, convert mixed lengths, place the unknown and reject double-counting an included part or adding birds.

focus.zh: 条形图表达三种关系
focus.en: Bar models for three relationships

rationale.zh: 两处均须亲画整体—部分、同起点比较和等组条，标已知未知与单位并反查；P51用42、17、三袋，P52迁移到2.4L、0.9L、三份。相同差值不代表相同故事，等组不能画成不等段。新Q2移动整体/部分、比较三量与等组的未知，生成各个反向关系及零段、零差、每袋零张图；同图共用尺度，不把像素当实物尺。
rationale.en: Both require drawing whole-part, aligned-comparison and equal-group bars with knowns, unknowns, units and checks. P51 uses forty-two, seventeen and three bags; P52 transfers to 2.4L, 0.9L and three portions. Equal differences need not represent the same story, and equal groups require equal bar sections. New Q2s move unknowns through whole/parts, all comparison roles and equal groups, reconstruct inverse checks and draw zero parts, gaps and per-bag counts without positive zero widths.

focus.zh: 中间量与两步计划
focus.en: Intermediate quantities and two-step plans

rationale.zh: P52先求三条布总长再从4m扣除，以及先合价再找零；P57先求整包购买总量或总价，再求剩料、余额或短缺。两单元都保持中间量的单位与前后依赖，短缺取正量而非把预算负余额写成答案。新Q3分别重建乘后减、加后乘、减后除与乘后加的中间量和单位，比较总送/每盒送、全部送完与全部留下的已知零；不背所有题先乘。
rationale.en: P52 forms the total length of three strips before subtracting from four metres, and combines costs before giving change. P57 forms purchased mass or cost before finding leftovers, balance or shortfall. Both preserve intermediate units and dependencies; a shortfall is reported as a positive amount. New Q3s generate intermediates and units for multiply/subtract, add/multiply, subtract/divide and multiply/add plans, distinguish total from per-box removal, and determine zero remaining or zero bags.

focus.zh: 信息是否足够且相关
focus.en: Sufficient and relevant information

rationale.zh: P56给三角形底8、高5及无关斜边6，解释面积用垂直高；P57区分今天主要方式与最喜欢、样本与全校，并在整包购买前核库存和拆零条件；P68不捏造缺测人数。复现“无关数据可不用”与“缺条件不能乱补”两个子目标。新Q4逐问选择价格/余钱/质量所需卡号，以两个可行质量补全证明原资料不能唯一确定；补质量再计算，改问年份差时原年份变相关，不将缺测当零。
rationale.en: P56 uses base eight and perpendicular height five rather than an irrelevant sloping side six. P57 distinguishes observed travel from preference and a sample from the school, and checks stock and whole-pack conditions. P68 refuses to fabricate missing counts. Both ignoring irrelevant inputs and identifying missing conditions recur. New Q4s select goal-specific fact IDs, demonstrate underdetermined mass with two compatible completions, calculate only after mass is supplied and make the previously unused year relevant to a changed question.

focus.zh: 说明关系并检查结果
focus.en: Explain relationships and check results

rationale.zh: P51指出改括号改变乘法作用量并用加回核2750；P52解释不同小数单位不能直接相加，又用0.333×3=0.999检验精确性；P56用实际格数与单位解释同周长不同面积。解释题全部仍须人审，正确末值或关键词不自动证明推理完整。新Q5比较裸数、正确末值配错误关系与完整解释，亲算错误式并以反向关系核卡数/钱数，另改送出为收到、用单位格逐行核面积；假想纸卡不作实测。
rationale.en: P51 explains how inserted brackets change a multiplication quantity and checks 2750 by addition. P52 explains incompatible decimal subunits and checks precision with 0.333×3=0.999. P56 uses actual cells and units to distinguish equal perimeters from equal areas. All explanations remain human-reviewed; a final value or keyword does not establish valid reasoning. New Q5s compare bare answers, invalid reasoning with a correct final value and full explanations; reconstruct inverse card/money checks, change giving to receiving and verify square-unit area by row sums without claiming real observations.

focus.zh: 整数混合运算与中间量
focus.en: Whole-number mixed operations and intermediates

rationale.zh: P68由整数人数求18×4+10、24÷4×12，并由160−16−100核可用余额；J71扩展到带符号整数的同级乘除次序与分组。都保留每个中间量和原式结构，不能只按出现顺序随意改括号；运算意义扩展不等于跳过原整数运算。新Q1另生成三条大数完整等值链、两种拆算与位值核查，比较擅改除数分组及零因数/被除数/除数，并以独立预算保单位。
rationale.en: P68 forms 18×4+10 and 24÷4×12 from integer counts and checks a balance using 160−16−100. J71 extends the same ordered arithmetic and grouping to signed integers. Both preserve intermediate quantities and expression structure; extending signs does not remove the underlying whole-number arithmetic. New Q1s generate full mixed-operation chains, two product strategies, quotient place checks and a budget, distinguishing changed divisor grouping and three different zero roles.

focus.zh: 括号、同级运算与结构
focus.en: Brackets, equal precedence and structure

rationale.zh: P65比较3(n+2)与3n+2，并用3(x+2)=5的两条精确路径保留括号整体；J71用−2²与(−2)²、−6÷2×(−3)说明底数及同级乘除。两个单元都必须说明原式范围，后者显式复现乘除同级从左到右，不能擅改除数。新Q2从原八行亲写括号作用范围、乘除/加减同级、右括号及嵌套链，再把乘数改1比较偶然同值与原反例，不把一次代入当一般证明。
rationale.en: P65 distinguishes 3(n+2) from 3n+2 and preserves the bracketed whole along two exact paths for 3(x+2)=5. J71 distinguishes −2² from (−2)² and handles −6÷2×(−3). Both explain scope; the latter explicitly retrieves equal-precedence multiplication and division from left to right without silently changing a divisor. New Q2s reconstruct eight whole-expression chains, including right/nested brackets and both same-level pairs, then compare a matching multiplier-one special case with the original counterexample.

focus.zh: 因数、倍数与平方因数
focus.en: Factors, multiples and square factors

rationale.zh: 两处都完整列36的九个不同正因数，平方因数6不重计；与另一个数求共同整除，再列不同周期的正倍数求同现。因数和倍数方向、不同因数计数及零倍不等于正倍数均须解释。原36平方去重证据保留；新Q3完整列48/60成对因数、交换阵列、保试装余量与精确商，并从前八正倍数继续到第九/十项，区分有限因数和无限倍数。
rationale.en: Both list the nine distinct positive factors of thirty-six without counting six twice, find shared divisors with another number, and list positive multiples for coinciding periods. They require factor/multiple direction, distinct counts and the distinction between zero and positive multiples. Earlier square-factor evidence remains. New Q3s generate complete 48/60 factor pairs, swapped arrays, trial remainders and exact quotient relationships, then continue beyond eight displayed positive multiples.

focus.zh: 用正因数定义质合数
focus.en: Prime and composite by positive factors

rationale.zh: 两处分类0、1、2及新的奇质数与奇合数，须列正因数并给奇偶规则的反例。17与19的完整性用小因数配对检查说明，不把一次试除失败当质数证明；0、1与偶质数边界都保留。新Q4对47/53逐个排完小因子至6/7并证明界限，对49/25保失败试除与非平凡见证，明确自身整除与1×P矩形不能证明合数。
rationale.en: Both classify zero, one, two and new odd primes and composites using positive factors and counterexamples to parity claims. Completeness for seventeen and nineteen is explained by small factor pairs, not one failed division. Neither zero nor one is prime or composite, while two remains the even prime. New Q4s exhaust smaller-factor candidates through 6/7 for 47/53 and justify completeness, contrasting failed trials with 49/25 nontrivial witnesses and rejecting self-division or a 1×P rectangle as composite proofs.

focus.zh: 最大公因数与最小正公倍数
focus.en: Greatest common factors and least positive common multiples

rationale.zh: P53求36与48最多12袋及6、10分钟周期下一次30min；P63求36与54最多18袋及9、12秒周期下一次36s。两处都证明最大共同整除与首个正共同倍数，不把零起点或任意一个可行候选充当最优值。新Q5以20/30或24/40分袋比较可行与最大，13/14或14/15周期从前八倍扩到首个共同点，另算含1、同数与互质三对边界，保正整数输入约定。
rationale.en: P53 finds twelve identical bags from thirty-six and forty-eight and thirty minutes for periods six and ten. P63 finds eighteen bags from thirty-six and fifty-four and thirty-six seconds for periods nine and twelve. Both justify the greatest shared divisor and first positive shared multiple, not merely any feasible candidate or the zero starting time. New Q5s compare feasible/greatest bag counts for 20/30 or 24/40, extend 13/14 or 14/15 periods beyond eight entries, and audit one, equal-input and coprime boundary pairs.

focus.zh: 千分位、占位零与换单位
focus.en: Thousandths, placeholders and changing units

rationale.zh: P56须把0.003个立方米解释为三个千分之一立方米并换3000cm³，也把0.6L换600cm³；P62由37.5/100恢复0.375、把0.008换0.8%。千分位与内部零在两单元实际参与生成数值，不仅出现相同位值标签。新Q1从四列重建千分之一总数、零的角色、改单列增量和同画宽不同单位的放大窗，并双向还原米毫米。
rationale.en: P56 interprets 0.003 cubic metres as three thousandths and converts to 3000cm³, also converting 0.6L to 600cm³. P62 recovers 0.375 from 37.5/100 and converts 0.008 to 0.8%. Thousandths and placeholder zeros actively determine answers in both units rather than merely sharing a tag. New Q1s rebuild four-place contributions, zero roles, one-place changes and labelled zoom windows, then recover metre/millimetre quantities.

focus.zh: 小数大小、舍入与精确值
focus.en: Decimal order, rounding and exact values

rationale.zh: P62比较0.375与错误0.00375，并区分精确1/3与舍入33.3%；J91用相邻百分位及中点平方比较决定√2约1.41与√0.999约1.00，含末零与跨位。J98再核1.41²不等2。保留比较、按目标位舍入及近似相同不证明精确相同。新Q2另核位值排序、标尺、跨9中点进位、二次舍入反例、同近似不同精确值及先各量舍入再估合计。
rationale.en: P62 distinguishes 0.375 from erroneous 0.00375 and exact one third from rounded 33.3%. J91 compares adjacent hundredths and midpoints to round √2 to 1.41 and √0.999 to 1.00, including a carry and trailing zeros. J98 checks that 1.41² is not two. These retrieve order, specified-place rounding and the distinction between approximate and exact equality. New Q2s generate place-based order and scales, halfway carries, double-rounding counterexamples, unequal originals with a shared approximation and separately rounded sum estimates.

focus.zh: 按同单位相加小数
focus.en: Adding decimals with common subunits

rationale.zh: P57先合2.40+3.00=5.40或2×2.40+3=7.80，再核预算；J71把−0.6+1.1转成−6/10+11/10=5/10。两个单元都按元的百分之一或十分之一对齐相加，后者扩展符号而不改变小数单位。新Q3完整对齐四列并逐列生成连续进位、不同小单位计数和逆运算，不能只给钱数合计。
rationale.en: P57 combines 2.40+3.00=5.40 or 2×2.40+3=7.80 before checking a budget. J71 rewrites −0.6+1.1 as −6/10+11/10=5/10. Both add common decimal subunits; extending signs does not alter the tenths or hundredths. New Q3s generate aligned columns, consecutive carries, matching-unit counts and inverse checks, rather than only a money total.

focus.zh: 小数减法与差的单位
focus.en: Decimal subtraction and units of difference

rationale.zh: P57在5.40与6之间求0.60余额、7.80与7之间求0.80短缺；J74以180−37.5=142.5°求邻补角；J71用−0.4−0.6=−1扩展有向差。不同情境都须同单位对齐，短缺大小与有向负余额不能混写。同一新Q3还按借位穿过两个0重组原量、逐列相减并加回；等值量相减的确定零与未知分清，题目保两个已有误解标签。
rationale.en: P57 subtracts 5.40 from six for a 0.60 balance and seven from 7.80 for a 0.80 shortfall. J74 calculates 180−37.5=142.5°; J71 extends to directed subtraction −0.4−0.6=−1. Subunits must align, and a positive shortfall is distinct from a signed balance. The same new Q3s also regroup across two zeros, subtract by columns and add back, distinguishing a determined zero difference from an unknown; both existing misconception tags are retained.

focus.zh: 小数乘整数与单位值
focus.en: Decimal times whole numbers and unit values

rationale.zh: P56用0.003×1000000、0.6×1000换单位，并由三倍0.8m求矩形面积2.4m²；P57将两包各2.40计4.80后加3，区别实际整盒付款与用量比例。既含十进缩放也含等组重复，小数点由单位值确定。新Q4亲画同尺度等组，以整数千分之一及重复加法核乘积，比较0组、4空组、1组和整数结果，不说乘法总增大。
rationale.en: P56 uses 0.003×1000000 and 0.6×1000 for unit conversion and three times 0.8 for area 2.4m². P57 repeats two costs of 2.40 before adding three and distinguishes full-carton payment from the fraction used. Both decimal scaling and equal-group repetition determine place value. New Q4s draw scaled equal groups and check integer thousandths/repeated addition, contrasting no groups, four empty groups, one group and whole-number products.

focus.zh: 小数除整数与精确份额
focus.en: Decimal divided by a whole number and exact shares

rationale.zh: P62以37.5÷100生成0.375，并用0.333×3=0.999说明三等份不能把有限近似当精确；P68以7.5÷5求1.5h，另以10÷1.5=20/3保留不能终止的精确商。前者的整数除数与乘回检查、后者原小数除整数均为实际任务，额外小数除数只作边界迁移。新Q5给精确份额和三位近似的合计偏差两方向，核零总量/禁止零份数、每份大于1及固定总量份数加倍后减半。
rationale.en: P62 generates 0.375 by 37.5÷100 and uses 0.333×3=0.999 to distinguish an approximation from exact thirds. P68 computes 7.5÷5=1.5h and retains exact 20/3 for 10÷1.5. Integer-divisor division and multiplication checks recur; the additional decimal divisor is a further transfer, not a replacement for the original operation. New Q5s compare exact fractions with rounded-display totals above and below the original, checking zero total/nonzero divisor, shares above one and halving after doubling share count.

focus.zh: 小数情境中的数量关系
focus.en: Quantity relationships in decimal contexts

rationale.zh: P57根据整包单价、数量与预算列总价和余额或短缺，不把用掉份额当可拆零付款；P63先按比例把2.4cm放大再由cm换km，且解释路线相加与屏幕缩放的限制。两处先选量与单位、列关系，再计算小数而非随意拼数。新Q6分别选择钱数、剪布、单价与等分关系，比较预算余额/正短缺/恰付，并为三类物品自编10元内正整数方案、估精算和反查，资料均假想。
rationale.en: P57 forms total costs, balances and shortfalls from pack quantities, prices and budgets without assuming fractional payment. P63 scales 2.4cm and converts centimetres to kilometres, explaining route addition and screen-scaling limits. Both choose quantities and units before forming and calculating decimal relationships. New Q6s choose money, cloth, unit-price and sharing relationships, distinguish surplus/positive shortfall/exact payment, and create checked positive whole-count plans for three fictional items within NZ$10.

focus.zh: 单位分数、整体与实际量
focus.en: Unit shares, reference wholes and actual amounts

rationale.zh: P61把12L与6L各等分三份，分别生成4L与2L的单位份额，再取两份得8L与4L；P62把10/40与20/80都化成1/4、25/100，实际标记数仍为10与20。两处区分分数单位、参考整体和带单位实际量，不能用相同涂色比例保证相同数量。新Q1另用实际格号生成不同形状同面积区域，再转移一格反查等分；绳段的比例、份数与实际米数分别生成，含单位分数形式与零分母条件。
rationale.en: P61 partitions twelve and six litres into thirds, obtaining unit shares of four and two litres before selecting two shares. P62 rewrites 10/40 and 20/80 as 1/4 and 25/100 while actual marked counts remain ten and twenty. Both distinguish fraction unit, reference whole and measured amount; the same shaded proportion does not ensure the same quantity. New Q1s generate equal-area regions of different shapes from cell IDs and transfer one cell to test equal shares. Rope proportions, counts and metres are generated separately, including unit-fraction form and invalid zero denominators.

focus.zh: 真分数、假分数与一的边界
focus.en: Proper and improper fractions at the one-whole boundary

rationale.zh: P61按固定1L画3/4、4/4、5/4，P65按固定1m画2/3、3/3、7/3；都须分类并数完整整体及剩余。两处主动解释分子等于分母也属假分数，“假”不代表量不存在，不能为容纳超过一而换整体。新Q2逐行生成完整升、余份与最少轮廓数，区分零量的空参考框，并计算只加倍分母导致量减半。
rationale.en: P61 draws 3/4,4/4,5/4 against one litre; P65 draws 2/3,3/3,7/3 against one metre. Both classify and count complete wholes and leftovers, explicitly including equality as improper without redefining the whole or calling the quantity unreal. New Q2s generate filled litres, remaining shares and minimum outlines for every row, separating a zero-amount guide from a filled whole and calculating the halving caused by changing only a denominator.

focus.zh: 带分数与假分数双向互化
focus.en: Converting mixed and improper fractions both ways

rationale.zh: P61在17/5与3 2/5、2 3/7与17/7之间双向核验；P65在10/3与3 1/3、4 1/5与21/5之间核验。两处都画固定单位，说明整数部分须换成分母个小份，不能只把整数加进分子。新Q3另生成整除、不足一、零及非最简真余数，修复值等价而余数≥1的候选，区分原分母余数、乘法误读和指定分母形式。
rationale.en: P61 checks 17/5 against 3 2/5 and 2 3/7 against 17/7 in both directions. P65 checks 10/3 against 3 1/3 and 4 1/5 against 21/5. Fixed-unit drawings explain how whole parts become denominator-sized collections of shares, rather than adding the whole count directly to the numerator. New Q3s generate exact-integer, below-one, zero and unsimplified proper remainders, repair an equal-valued form whose remainder exceeds one, and distinguish remainder units, multiplication misreading and a required denominator.

focus.zh: 等值分数保留原量
focus.en: Equivalent fractions retain the original amount

rationale.zh: P54须把2/3同时扩为8/12、1/4扩为3/12，并用另一共同分母24解释3/4−1/6的同量结果；P62须说明10/40=20/80=1/4=25/100以及375/1000=37.5/100。分子分母共同缩放、整体与所取量不变在两个单元都由解释任务主动重建，不能只改分母。新Q4用原涂色重新细分、分子及分母两类填空、反向分组、1/0倍数条件与开放生成另一等值式；实际整体翻倍时另算升数。
rationale.en: P54 rescales both numerator and denominator of 2/3 and 1/4 to twelfths and explains an alternative denominator of twenty-four for 3/4−1/6. P62 explains 10/40=20/80=1/4=25/100 and 375/1000=37.5/100. Both explanation tasks reconstruct common scaling and conserved amount rather than changing only a denominator. New Q4s repartition original shading, solve both blank roles, reverse grouping, distinguish factors one and zero and generate another valid equivalent fraction. Doubling the actual whole requires recalculating litres.

focus.zh: 等值不一定已经最简
focus.en: Equivalent does not necessarily mean simplest

rationale.zh: P61须把18/24L写3/4L，P65把等值候选21/35m写3/5m并乘回原式。两处实际要求最简分数；6/8、6/10等未约尽形式虽等值仍不满足形式要求，小数也不能冒充本题所要求的分数。新Q5以两种实际分组路径约尽，核非相邻互质与奇数仍可约的反例、同减不等值、整数与零的最简形式；保持升单位。
rationale.en: P61 must reduce 18/24L to 3/4L; P65 reduces candidate 21/35m to 3/5m and checks the original equation. Both explicitly require simplest fraction form. Equivalent 6/8 or 6/10 is unfinished, and a decimal does not meet the requested fraction representation. New Q5s use two grouping paths, check non-adjacent coprime and reducible odd cases, refute equal subtraction and generate integer/zero simplest forms while retaining litres.

focus.zh: 通分比较与整体条件
focus.en: Common-share comparison and reference conditions

rationale.zh: P61通分比较7/12与5/8，用24分之一；P65比较5/9与7/12，用36分之一。两处再改整体，实际量排序反转而分数数值排序不变；必须说清共同单位、分子分母共同缩放和参考整体。新Q6列全正倍数核最小共同分母，检验乘积非最小与分母和无效，补单位分数及泛化反例、等值比较；只改右整体并亲造未知整体三种结果，保km/m。
rationale.en: P61 compares 7/12 and 5/8 using twenty-fourths; P65 compares 5/9 and 7/12 using thirty-sixths. Both then change wholes, reversing actual-amount order while fraction-number order remains fixed. Explanations must name the common unit, rescale both numerator and denominator and retain reference wholes. New Q6s generate complete positive-multiple lists, distinguish a working nonleast product from an invalid sum, test unit/general fraction claims and equality, change only the right whole and construct all three orderings for unknown wholes, retaining km/metre units.

focus.zh: 同大小分数份相加
focus.en: Adding counts of like fraction shares

rationale.zh: P61说明三组各三个四分之一是九个四分之一、9/4L，不是9/12；P63须用14/5L+21/5L=35/5L=7L核总量。两处都以同大小份数合并、保留份单位，结果可超过一整体，不能相加或相乘分母改变每份大小。新Q1另亲画零加数、两整升与超过三升的和，核完整数/轮廓数及不同容量半壶的实际L，保原分母并逐项减回。
rationale.en: P61 explains that three groups of three quarters give nine quarters, or 9/4L, not 9/12. P63 checks total volume using 14/5L+21/5L=35/5L=7L. Both combine counts of like shares while preserving share size, including totals above one whole; changing the denominator changes the amount. New Q1s draw zero addition, an integer two-litre sum and a sum above three litres, check filled/minimum outlines and actual half-jugs of unequal capacity, retain denominators and subtract back.

focus.zh: 同单位减份数并加回
focus.en: Subtracting like shares and adding back

rationale.zh: P55从x+1/4=1反求x=3/4，把整体看作四个四分之一后去一份，并代回；J71同侧点距离由5/4−1/4=4/4=1，避免重叠部分重复计。两处都先保留同单位，再减份数；负点情境不把非负距离误写成有向差。新Q2另核零差、整数换份、原量超过一、减零不变和实物不足，划去不重切；不足不能调换或截成零。
rationale.en: P55 recovers x=3/4 from x+1/4=1 by viewing the whole as four quarters and removing one, then checks the equation. J71 obtains same-side distance from 5/4−1/4=1 without double-counting overlap. Both retain a common unit and subtract share counts, distinguishing distance from directed change. New Q2s generate zero differences, integer exchanges, originals above one and unchanged subtraction by zero, and refuse impossible removal without reversing or truncating. Crosses remove rather than resize pieces.

focus.zh: 不同分数单位先通分再加
focus.en: Unify fraction units before addition

rationale.zh: P65代回精确解时须算−1/3+2=−1/3+6/3=5/3，再乘3为5；J71以四分之一为共同单位算−3/4+1/2=−1/4并解释数轴。两个后续单元把原正分数通分结构延伸到有向量，仍须将整数或二分之一换成相同小份，不直接相加分子分母。新Q3以两个有效分母分别缩放两量，核指定分母与最简差别，亲画132份并计算混合km/m；已修正源Q1中文提示的整除方向。
rationale.en: P65 checks an exact solution using −1/3+2=−1/3+6/3=5/3 before multiplying by three. J71 unifies quarters in −3/4+1/2=−1/4 and explains the number line. Both extend the original positive-fraction structure to signed quantities, converting the integer or half into common shares rather than adding unlike numerators or denominators. New Q3s independently rescale both amounts using two valid denominators, distinguish required-denominator and simplest forms, generate 132-part counts and convert mixed kilometre/metre quantities. The source Q1 Chinese hint now states the correct divisibility direction.

focus.zh: 不同分母减法与逆向核查
focus.en: Unlike-denominator subtraction and inverse checks

rationale.zh: P65在x+2=5/3中求5/3−2=−1/3，并代回恢复5/3；J71比较−3/4−(−1/2)与−3/4+(−1/2)，通分后分别−1/4与−5/4，再加回原减数。两处保留原被减数、共同分母与原式核查，扩展负号但不改变单位。新Q4保原先后与两量，另做零差、整数原量、减零、正差超过一及不足量，使用两种共同分母和逐项加回。
rationale.en: P65 subtracts two from 5/3 to obtain −1/3 and adds back for verification. J71 contrasts −3/4−(−1/2) with −3/4+(−1/2), giving −1/4 and −5/4 after common-unit conversion, then adds back the original subtrahend. Both preserve the minuend, common unit and original check while extending signs. New Q4s retain operand order and amounts while generating zero differences, integer originals, subtraction by zero, a positive result above one and an insufficient-material case, using two common denominators and add-back checks.

focus.zh: 分数比例、实际量与加减关系
focus.en: Fraction proportions, measured amounts and additive relationships

rationale.zh: P61必须区分剩余1/2L与它占标准3/4L一份的2/3，且用2×3/4L+1/2L=2L恢复整体；P63的五个权重份每份是7/5L，按14/5L+21/5L核总量，不能把1/5总量误当1/5L。两处先确定比例的参照及实际单位，再形成部分合整体或整体减部分的关系，回应原课“全程比例与km不能直接混加”的子目标。新Q5以两步合并后使用、两次使用的两种计划、全程翻倍与实际km/比例、假想钱数及自编十二格活动，实际重建中间量和逆查。
rationale.en: P61 distinguishes 1/2L remaining from its ratio 2/3 of a standard 3/4L portion and reconstructs the whole using 2×3/4L+1/2L=2L. In P63 each of five weight shares is 7/5L, and 14/5L+21/5L checks the total; one fifth of the total is not 1/5L. Both establish ratio reference and measured units before combining parts or subtracting from a whole, retrieving the source lesson’s warning against mixing a route proportion with kilometres. New Q5s reconstruct intermediates and inverse checks for combining then using, two plans for two uses, a doubled route with actual kilometres and route fractions, fictional money and a generated twelve-cell activity.

focus.zh: 同一符号保持同一未知量
focus.en: One symbol keeps one unknown value

rationale.zh: P65解释n+n是两个相同的n，并对n=0、−2分别一致代入；J73处理5x+2=2x+11时两边的x都须为同一值3，代回均17。迁移从方框到字母、从一边重复到等式两边重复；换独立赋值可以换值，同一次代入不能把重复符号各挑一个数。新Q1逐行定义未知对象，生成不同位置、重复符号与零解，画图并核原左右值；同和不同值数对不能替代相同方框。
rationale.en: P65 explains that n+n contains two copies of the same n and substitutes zero and negative two consistently in separate cases. J73 uses the same x=3 on both sides of 5x+2=2x+11, obtaining seventeen each. The idea transfers from boxes to letters and from repetition on one side to both sides: independent assignments may differ, but repeated symbols within one assignment may not. New Q1s define every unknown object and generate varied positions, repeated symbols and a zero root with diagrams and original side values. A pair with the correct sum cannot replace identical boxes.

focus.zh: 等号两侧与等值步骤
focus.en: Equality of both sides and valid steps

rationale.zh: P65把2x=10单改为x=10后代回得20≠10，并解释同乘零虽相等却丢约束；J73把“移项”还原为两边同减2x、同减2、同除非零3。两单元都用具体左右值与可逆步骤说明等号的关系含义，不能把它当“接下来算”的箭头。新Q2按原两盘和三个候选重算四种同量操作的差，给单边反例、零候选巧合与第二次去框不足，修正不等值连等式。
rationale.en: P65 rejects changing only 2x=10 to x=10 by checking twenty versus ten, and explains information lost by multiplying both sides by zero. J73 expands transposition into subtracting 2x and two from both sides, then dividing both by nonzero three. Both use actual side values and reversible steps to treat equals as a relationship rather than a next-calculation arrow. New Q2s recompute four common actions for three candidates, compare one-sided counterexamples and a zero-candidate coincidence, refuse a second unavailable box removal and repair unequal chains.

focus.zh: 由构造或完整规则支持一般式
focus.en: General expressions justified by construction or a complete rule

rationale.zh: P65由三行各n与固定两块推出3n+2，解释增长三不足以说明总数；H07由首项1及每步2n+1核(n+1)²−n²，支持通项n²，并给前三项相同却第四项不同的两公式。两单元都区分序号、增长、固定项和一般依据，有限试值不替代完整规则。后者是具备先修后从图形构造到递推结构的远迁移。新Q3从实际边集合与两行点写两种一般式，算近远步，核首次偶合与空图边界；有限4/7/10记录另给完整不同续构造。
rationale.en: P65 derives 3n+2 from three rows of n and two fixed blocks, explaining why growth of three alone does not give a total. H07 checks (n+1)²−n² against the given increment 2n+1 and first term one, supporting n², and gives formulas agreeing on three terms but differing on the fourth. Both separate index, increment, fixed information and general justification. The latter is a later transfer from construction to recurrence once prerequisites are in place. New Q3s derive two expressions from actual edges and two-row counters, evaluate near/far steps, test first-term coincidences and the empty-diagram boundary, and supply different complete continuations of a finite 4,7,10 prefix.

focus.zh: 逆运算、精确解与退化边界
focus.en: Inverse steps, exact solutions and degenerate boundaries

rationale.zh: P65在3(x+2)=5中执行同除3、同减2的一步逆操作并代回精确−1/3，另解释乘零不保完整解集；J73通过3x=0、矛盾式、恒等式区分唯一零解、无解和全部允许值，并说明非零除数。两处均核原式，不把除零或−0.33近似数当精确求解。新Q4逐种选择有定义的逆操作，精确分数与近似候选代回分开；唯一零、零系数全满足/无解及除零未定义分别说明。
rationale.en: P65 performs individual inverse steps of division by three and subtraction of two in 3(x+2)=5 and checks exact −1/3, while explaining information lost by multiplication by zero. J73 distinguishes unique zero, no solution and all allowed values using 3x=0, a contradiction and an identity, retaining nonzero-divisor conditions. Both check the original relationship rather than allowing division by zero or substituting approximate −0.33 for an exact solution. New Q4s justify defined inverses and distinguish exact fraction substitution from approximate trials, separating unique zero, zero-coefficient all/none and undefined division.

focus.zh: 先列数量关系，再核情境允许性
focus.en: Model quantity relationships, then check contextual validity

rationale.zh: J73定义年龄或每袋数量，写x+(x+8)=30或3x+2=20，并区分原建模关系与最后解；J83定义两类票数或升数，写x+y=7及5x+3y=30，代回9/2、5/2后再核完整票数限制。两处都从量名、单位、固定项和范围建立等式，不把解值等式或擅自取整冒充原模型。新Q5从原量、每段长度、钱数与袋外散卡列原模型并核单位，比较同方程的连续长度与不可拆卡数，不用取整改题。
rationale.en: J73 defines ages or bag quantities and forms x+(x+8)=30 or 3x+2=20, distinguishing original modelling relationships from final solutions. J83 defines ticket counts or litres and forms x+y=7 and 5x+3y=30, then checks 9/2 and 5/2 against whole-ticket restrictions. Both build equations from quantities, units, fixed amounts and domains, not from solution statements or arbitrary rounding. New Q5s form original models for originals, per-piece lengths, money and extras outside bags, then contrast continuous length with indivisible cards under the same algebraic equation rather than rounding away the mismatch.

focus.zh: 长度、面积、体积的换单位
focus.en: Unit conversion in one, two and three dimensions

rationale.zh: P66分别解释2m、2m²、2m³换厘米单位的100、100²、100³因子，另核2L=2000cm³；J87从30cm边长重建0.3m、0.09m²、0.027m³=27L。两个单元都主动解释行、格、层及单位维度，不允许把面积单位改名成长单位。新Q1另生成经过dm的两级逆向链、分数升与零量，亲画m³/dm³/cm³层级、单子块占整体比例，区分观察层与总体。
rationale.en: P66 explains factors 100,100²,100³ for 2m,2m²,2m³ and checks 2L=2000cm³. J87 reconstructs 0.3m,0.09m²,0.027m³=27L from a thirty-centimetre side. Both actively explain rows, grids, layers and dimensions rather than renaming an area as a length. New Q1s generate inverse two-stage chains through dm units, fractional litres and zero, drawing the m³/dm³/cm³ hierarchy and a subunit’s fraction of the whole while separating layer observation from total quantity.

focus.zh: 长方形覆盖面积与单位
focus.en: Rectangle coverage area and units

rationale.zh: P66须逐面标4×3、4×2、3×2的矩形覆盖面积，J87须标六个3×3方形的单面9cm²并合计；两处均用长×宽及实际面数，不把周界或空间量作面积。J72进一步由长n+2、宽n推n(n+2)cm²及不同周长式。新Q2以混合边长和明确非单位方格重新覆盖，旋转对应，再逆求一边、主动对照同周长异面积和正方形数值偶合的不同单位。
rationale.en: P66 labels rectangular face areas 4×3,4×2,3×2; J87 labels square face areas 3×3 and counts actual faces. Both use length times width and square units rather than boundary length or volume. J72 further derives n(n+2)cm² and a separate perimeter expression from lengths n+2 and n. New Q2s cover mixed edge units with explicitly sized cells, match rotated coverage, recover an unknown edge and compare equal-perimeter/different-area shapes and square numerical coincidences with different units.

focus.zh: 用两份拼接解释三角形面积
focus.en: Explaining triangle area by joining two copies

rationale.zh: P66底10、高4且足点在边外，用两份拼接求20cm²；J87先由10²−6²得垂直高8，再将底9、高8的两份拼接求36m²。两处都须给无损拼接和一半的依据，解释斜边不等高；只代面积公式不满足任务。新Q3亲画外侧垂足与反射，再区分新增副本、保留半格；改选另一底、逆求高及混合单位放大各核对应关系。
rationale.en: P66 joins two triangles with base ten, height four and an external foot to obtain 20cm² per copy. J87 first derives height eight from 10²−6², then joins copies with base nine for 36m². Both require conserved-area rearrangement and the halving argument, distinguishing sloping side from perpendicular height; formula substitution alone is insufficient. New Q3s draw an external foot and reflection, distinguish adding a copy and retain half cells, then check a changed base, inverse altitude and mixed-unit scaling.

focus.zh: 平行底、垂直高与切拼
focus.en: Parallel bases, perpendicular height and rearrangement

rationale.zh: P66以切拼推平行四边形24cm²、两份梯形推21cm²；J87分别推28m²与26m²。两处都把梯形两底接成和、保留垂直高、还原一份，并核两底相等时与平行四边形公式相容及本课狭义命名约定。新Q4分别画左/零/右错移与切块对应，核切块和剩余；梯形半平方结果、交换/相等底及逆求底都由具体图与量生成。
rationale.en: P66 rearranges a parallelogram for 24cm² and pairs trapezia for 21cm²; J87 gives 28m² and 26m². Both add the parallel bases, retain perpendicular height and return from two copies to one, checking equal-base compatibility with the parallelogram formula and the stated exclusive naming convention. New Q4s draw left/zero/right shears with matching cut pieces and retained regions, then derive half-square trapezoid results, exchanged/equal bases and an inverse base from actual quantities.

focus.zh: 按行列层计单位立方体
focus.en: Counting unit cubes by rows, columns and layers

rationale.zh: P66按3列4行5层数60个1cm³块，并区分内部空两格时材料58cm³与外框60cm³；J87按2×3每层、4层求24m³并换24000L，拒绝用√29m对角线当体积。都须解释相同不重叠单位块的三维计数。新Q5另比较同数值内外尺寸的容量条件，按行层解释三棱加倍的八倍体积，再从体积与两边逆求高。
rationale.en: P66 counts sixty 1cm³ cubes in 3×4×5 layers and distinguishes 58cm³ of material with two empty internal cells from the 60cm³ bounding region. J87 counts four 2×3 layers for 24m³=24000L and rejects diagonal length √29m as volume. Both explain equal nonoverlapping unit-cube counts in three dimensions. New Q5s contrast equal numerical internal/external dimensions and capacity conditions, explain the eightfold effect of doubling three edges through layers, and recover height from volume and two edges.

focus.zh: 展开图、实际面与纸板面积
focus.en: Nets, actual faces and board area

rationale.zh: P66画4×3×2无盖盒有效展开图，逐面合40cm²，加盖后52cm²；J87画3cm立方体有效六面网，封闭54cm²、开口45cm²。两处限定单面纸板、忽略厚度与接边，实际每面只计一次，区别内部空间与长度。新Q6亲画指定完整网，分别求有盖/无盖外接框和空白，对比同面片面积窄纸的尺寸障碍；接缝预算不当任意纸形保证或全局最优。
rationale.en: P66 draws a valid net for an open 4×3×2 box, totalling 40cm² or 52cm² with a lid. J87 draws a valid net for a three-centimetre cube, giving 54cm² closed or 45cm² open. Both state one-sided board area, ideal thickness/tab assumptions, count actual faces once and distinguish internal space and lengths. New Q6s draw the specified one-piece net, calculate closed/open bounding frames and blanks, test a narrow equal-panel-area sheet by dimensions, and separate seam budgets from arbitrary-shape guarantees or a global optimum.

focus.zh: 频数、有效记录与样本范围
focus.en: Frequencies, valid records and sample scope

rationale.zh: J76从0、0、6、6数两个6得相对频数1/2，并从八邀五答给5/8回答率、解释抽样框与偏差；J88逐编号保留十二行、A5缺失、有效A五/B六及有依据纠错；H08保不同ID同值、仅合并同次重复，四个有效长度均值21cm。复现计数分母、零与缺失、重复身份和结论范围，而非把无回应当一个数值零。新Q1逐ID审核原始分类/错录/未录入，保留更正现有行与加入新人的不同动作，主动生成零其他、缺失与结论边界。
rationale.en: J76 counts two sixes among 0,0,6,6 for relative frequency 1/2 and gives response rate 5/8, explaining frames and bias. J88 retains twelve identified rows, missing A5, valid group counts five and six and justified correction. H08 retains distinct equal-valued IDs, merges only a confirmed duplicate and uses four valid lengths for mean 21cm. These retrieve count denominators, zero versus missing, identity and scope. New Q1s audit source classifications, wrong entries and unentered rows by ID, distinguish correcting an existing record from adding a person, and generate zero-Other, missing and scoped conclusions.

focus.zh: 总量均分与实际观测
focus.en: Fair-share totals versus actual observations

rationale.zh: P67把2、3、3、4、28的完整40分钟均分五份得8，另保留1、2、2的精确均值5/3，并与实际中位数3区别；J76把末条8改50或0时按完整总量72或22除五，解释异常值与中位数变化。两个单元都使用总量÷有效条数，均值不是每条实际值，不能为结果好看删真实记录。新Q2亲移卡保总量、零与条数，分数均值乘回检近似；另区分全零、已观测均值/完整缺失均值，并由总均值主动造不同分布。
rationale.en: P67 shares the full forty minutes in 2,3,3,4,28 into five for mean eight and retains exact 5/3 for 1,2,2, distinguishing the median three. J76 replaces eight by fifty or zero and divides totals seventy-two or twenty-two by five, explaining outliers and median changes. Both use total over valid count, without treating the mean as every actual value or deleting valid observations for a preferred result. New Q2s move cards while retaining total, zeros and count, multiply exact means back to test approximations, distinguish all-zero and observed-only versus incomplete means, and generate distinct distributions from one summary.

focus.zh: 真实时间间距、变化与缺测
focus.en: Actual time spacing, changes and missing observations

rationale.zh: P66由0、1、4、6h的温度记录画图、用1:3:2横向间距，核1到6h经过5h、已测温差2°C；J87由0、2、3、7min画高度图，间距2:1:4，核2到7min增6mm且真零不等于缺测。两处都主动作图并说明示意线不证明未测过程、缺测不填零或无条件插值、末次增加不保证未来。新Q3从实际时刻/温度自画双尺度，完整生成分段有向变化与正降低量；原表、独立缺测分支与实测零分支分别画，造可能路径和未来反例而不冒充实测。
rationale.en: P66 plots temperatures at 0,1,4,6h with 1:3:2 spacing and checks five elapsed hours and 2°C endpoint change. J87 plots heights at 0,2,3,7min with 2:1:4 spacing, checking five minutes and a 6mm increase while retaining an observed zero. Both actively construct graphs and reject unlabelled interpolation, zero-filling, inferred unmeasured paths and guaranteed future increase. New Q3s draw both scales from actual time/value pairs and generate signed segment changes and positive fall amounts, distinguish original, independent missing and observed-zero branches, and construct possible paths/future counterexamples without treating them as measurements.

focus.zh: 图示尺度、统计量与证据范围
focus.en: Plot scales, summaries and evidence scope

rationale.zh: P68改轴上限仍保原人数，解释缺测与人次范围；J75区分轴比例改变的视觉斜率与带单位变化率；J88解释箱段宽度不直接给人数比例，并在极差与IQR排序不同时限定“更稳定”的指标。多个单元要求回原值、单位、数据范围与摘要定义，不以图形外观直接推广总体或因果。新Q4亲画零基线与截断图，核原比与显示比、两天人次与不同人数；只给调查作答数不能推出任何回答意见，重写有依据且有范围的事实。
rationale.en: P68 retains counts after changing the axis maximum and explains missing data and visit scope. J75 distinguishes visual steepness from unit-based rates. J88 rejects interpreting box widths as head-count proportions and qualifies stability when range and IQR order groups differently. These tasks return to values, units, scope and summary definitions rather than inferring populations or causes from appearance. New Q4s construct zero/truncated plots, compare original and displayed ratios and visits versus distinct people, reject inferring any opinions from response counts alone, and rewrite a supported scoped fact.

focus.zh: 配方同比与整包装预算
focus.en: Recipe scaling and whole-package budgets

rationale.zh: P66按10/4缩放A80/B120mL配方，分别补足整瓶、付款10.80比预算10短0.80；J87按6/4缩放A120/B80，付款11比预算11.50余0.50。两处都核配方比例、零库存、每种最少够用整包装、实际付款与余料，明确不能按只用掉的份额付可拆零价格。新Q5核边界前三个份数的需求、最少整包与台阶付款，含预算刚好/短缺/剩余和独立非零库存分支；余料不是退款，各单位不合并。
rationale.en: P66 scales A80/B120mL by 10/4, buys sufficient whole bottles and finds payment 10.80 exceeds budget ten by 0.80. J87 scales A120/B80 by 6/4 and finds payment eleven leaves 0.50 from 11.50. Both check recipe ratios, zero stock, least sufficient whole packages, actual payment and leftovers rather than paying only for the fraction consumed. New Q5s check requirements, least sufficient packs and stepwise payment across three serving counts, including exact/short/surplus budgets and an independent nonzero-stock branch, without refunding leftovers or adding unlike units.

focus.zh: 相同分数量的重复相加
focus.en: Repeated equal fractional amounts

rationale.zh: P67四组3/5m与J74五段7/8cm都须在固定单位条内数小份，分别得12/5m与35/8cm，解释把组数乘进分母为何只保留一组量，并主动核零组和一组。 新两组Q1重画假分数每组量与整数组数，先估范围，区分两种零量情形与数值交换后的情境角色。
rationale.en: P67 counts four groups of 3/5m and J74 five segments of 7/8cm on fixed-unit strips, obtaining 12/5m and 35/8cm. Both explain why multiplying the denominator by group count merely preserves one group, and check zero and one groups. New Q1s reconstruct improper per-group quantities, whole group counts, bounds, distinct zero contexts and the roles after swapping factors.

focus.zh: 固定单位格中的分数乘法
focus.en: Fraction multiplication in fixed unit grids

rationale.zh: P67用4×5单位网格重建3/4的2/5=3/10及5/4的2/5=1/2；J74用3×7网格重建2/3的3/7=2/7及4/3的3/7=4/7。两处强制画重叠、保留原整体，并核0与1因子，不是只做乘分子分母。 新两组Q2用两个大于一的因子重画扩展网格、四整体边界、等面积非必正方、正量与零量变化及约分依据。
rationale.en: P67 uses 4×5 unit grids for 2/5 of 3/4=3/10 and of 5/4=1/2; J74 uses 3×7 grids for 3/7 of 2/3=2/7 and of 4/3=4/7. Both require overlap drawings, an unchanged original whole and zero/one factors, rather than just multiplying numerators and denominators. New Q2s draw both factors above one, four-whole limits, equal-area nonsquare cells, positive/zero effects and justified cancellation.

focus.zh: 求一个量的几分之几
focus.en: A fraction of a measured amount

rationale.zh: P62将35%=7/20用于80L与40L，重求28L与14L并核部分/整体；P63将7L按2:3的五份分，每权重份7/5L，A取两份14/5L、B取三份21/5L，核总量与比例。两个单元都固定具体整体、先定单位份再取份，不把比例直接当升数。 新两组Q3对实际整体和选份数作独立修改，核精确选量与余量、零与全取，并区分连续量和不可分整卡。
rationale.en: P62 applies 35%=7/20 to 80L and 40L, generating 28L and 14L and checking part/whole. P63 splits 7L into five ratio shares, each 7/5L, then takes two for A=14/5L and three for B=21/5L and checks total and ratio. Both fix a measured whole, define the unit share and take the required shares rather than treating a ratio as litres. New Q3s independently change whole or selected share count, check exact selected/remainder conservation, zero/all and continuous versus indivisible contexts.

focus.zh: 分数总量平均分给整数份
focus.en: Sharing a fractional total among whole-number groups

rationale.zh: P67将3/5L平均给四杯得3/20L，J74将5/6m平均分三段得5/18m；均要求在固定整体内进一步均分小份，乘回恢复总量，并核0总量与正整数份数。不是只从非整数商推断使用了平均分模型。 新两组Q4把超过一米的总带逐小份细分，数全部和每人小份，核一人、零总量、零人数及舍入不守恒。
rationale.en: P67 shares 3/5L among four cups for 3/20L each; J74 shares 5/6m into three segments for 5/18m each. Both require subdividing fixed-whole shares, inverse checks, zero-total and positive whole-number group conditions, rather than inferring sharing from a non-integer quotient. New Q4s subdivide improper totals, count total/per-person pieces and check one person, zero total/count and rounding nonconservation.

focus.zh: 按分数标准量测份数
focus.en: Measuring portion counts using fractional standards

rationale.zh: P67以2/5L量3L得15/2标准份，7满份余1/5L=半标准份；J74以3/8m量2m得16/3标准段，5满段余1/8m=1/3标准段。两处画固定单位、核标准大于1的商小于1边界、乘回并区分实际余量与标准份比例。 新两组Q5补恰好量尽、单位标准、零总量，并与同总量的平均分享对照所求份数和每人量。
rationale.en: P67 measures 3L with 2/5L standards for 15/2 equivalents, seven full portions and 1/5L left, half a standard portion. J74 measures 2m with 3/8m standards for 16/3 equivalents, five full segments and 1/8m left, one third of a standard segment. Both draw fixed units, check standards above one, multiply back and distinguish measured remainders from fractions of a standard. New Q5s add exact exhaustion, unit standards and zero totals, then contrast measured counts with per-person shares of the same total.

focus.zh: 用乘法关系解释倒数除法
focus.en: Explaining reciprocal division through multiplication

rationale.zh: P67与J74分别由q×2/3=3/5、q×7/4=5/6推9/10及10/21；J71由含负除数关系推3/2。都要求指出原非零除数、乘它的倒数消成1、反查、拒绝倒被除数，区分零被除数可定义与零除数无解或不唯一。 新两组Q6先画共同小份再细分证明非最小公分母也合法，由ad与bc小份推ad/(bc)，连接原除数倒数并区别相反数及零边界。
rationale.en: P67 and J74 derive 9/10 and 10/21 from q×2/3=3/5 and q×7/4=5/6; J71 derives 3/2 with a negative divisor. Each identifies the original nonzero divisor, cancels it using its reciprocal, checks by multiplication, rejects inverting the dividend and distinguishes a valid zero dividend from no-solution/non-unique zero-divisor cases. New Q6s construct and refine common pieces, allow nonleast denominators, derive ad/(bc) from piece counts and connect the original divisor reciprocal, opposites and zero conditions.

focus.zh: 每百份与指定整体
focus.en: Per hundred and the specified whole

rationale.zh: J75比较9/60与21/140均15%，J76比较14/80与35/200均17.5%；都必须画同长但不同实际总量的条，说明等比例不等实际个数及百分率分母。 新P65/P68-Q1亲画3.75/7.5格中的部分面积、200/400张中一张的低于1%对照，改整体而保标记、逆求同率新张数，并核零/全/空集合及125%的对象范围。
rationale.en: J75 compares 9/60 with 21/140, both 15%; J76 compares 14/80 with 35/200, both 17.5%. Each requires equal-length bars representing different actual totals and an explanation of per-hundred denominators and unequal counts. New P65/P68 Q1s draw partial cells within 3.75/7.5 and one-card rates below 1% in 200/400-card sets, change whole at fixed marked count, recover counts at a fixed rate and distinguish zero/all/empty collections and contexts for 125%.

focus.zh: 小数与百分数保值互化
focus.en: Value-preserving decimal-percent conversion

rationale.zh: J75主动生成0.0625=6.25%，并区分0.0625%=0.000625；J76重建0.045=4.5%与错误0.045%=0.00045。两处都解释系数乘100与百分号除100配合，而非只添符号。 新两组Q2补小于1%与超过100%的等值图、反向小数、十分之一位值链及0=0%例外。
rationale.en: J75 generates 0.0625=6.25% and distinguishes 0.0625%=0.000625. J76 reconstructs 0.045=4.5% versus 0.045%=0.00045. Both explain coefficient scaling together with division by one hundred rather than appending a sign. New Q2s add below-one-percent and above-100% equivalent diagrams, reverse decimal forms, tenths chains and the zero exception.

focus.zh: 分数百分率的精确与近似
focus.en: Exact and approximate fraction percentages

rationale.zh: J75把1/6写成16又2/3%，再近似16.7%；J76把2/7写成28又4/7%，再近似28.6%。都须用除100与乘回或交叉乘说明舍入后不再精确，保留等号和约等号区别。 新两组Q3重画终止与循环结果的部分格、跨整体与0/200%，用等值扩分反驳只改分母，并检完整百分数系数。
rationale.en: J75 writes 1/6 as exactly 16 2/3% and approximately 16.7%; J76 writes 2/7 as exactly 28 4/7% and approximately 28.6%. Both require inverse or cross-product checks showing why rounded values are not equal to the original. New Q3s draw terminating/recurring partial cells, extended frames and zero/200%, reject denominator-only conversion and check the complete percent coefficient.

focus.zh: 百分率作用在具体整体
focus.en: Applying a percentage to a specified amount

rationale.zh: J75从80L、120L各取12.5%得10L、15L；J76从40kg、100kg各取7.5%得3kg、7.5kg。均画或说单位份、保留量纲、部分除整体核验，并核0%及不同整体。 新两组Q4保精确非整数连续量与余量，核125%需求、零整体不可反查占比及不可分卡的限制。
rationale.en: J75 takes 12.5% of 80L and 120L for 10L and 15L. J76 takes 7.5% of 40kg and 100kg for 3kg and 7.5kg. Both require unit shares, dimensions, inverse ratios and zero-percent/different-whole checks. New Q4s conserve exact nonintegral amounts and remainders, check 125% requirements, reject reverse ratios to zero wholes and respect indivisible cards.

focus.zh: 由百分部分恢复整体
focus.en: Recovering a whole from a percentage part

rationale.zh: J75由18L对应12.5%恢复144L，J76由3.6kg对应7.5%恢复48kg。都须建立部分率对应、乘回核验，解释乘百分率会再次取部分，以及0%导致不唯一或条件矛盾。 新两组Q5反求125/150%时更小的正参考、40%的非整数整体，并用自编双见证区分零率/零量三个分支。
rationale.en: J75 recovers 144L from 18L at 12.5%; J76 recovers 48kg from 3.6kg at 7.5%. Both establish the part-rate correspondence, multiply back, explain why multiplication takes another part and distinguish non-unique or inconsistent zero-percent cases. New Q5s recover smaller positive references at 125/150%, nonintegral wholes at 40% and classify three zero cases with two generated positive witnesses.

focus.zh: 变化基数与百分点
focus.en: Change bases and percentage points

rationale.zh: J75以120元先降再涨25%得112.50，J76以200元先涨再降10%得198；都逐步解释基数改变。另分别比较25%到40%的15个百分点/60%相对增长，与10%到15%的5个百分点/50%相对增长，保留原比例分母。 新两组Q6补八折/七五折的保留率与减少率、精确恢复25%/33又1/3%的新基数以及0%和全额降价边界。
rationale.en: J75 decreases then increases 120 dollars by 25% for 112.50; J76 increases then decreases 200 by 10% for 198, explicitly changing each base. They separately derive fifteen percentage points versus 60% growth from 25% to 40%, and five points versus 50% growth from 10% to 15%, using original-rate denominators. New Q6s distinguish retained 80/75% from reductions, recover exact new-base restoration rates of 25%/33 1/3% and check zero-rate/full-discount boundaries.

focus.zh: 比的顺序与整体参照
focus.en: Ratio order and whole reference

rationale.zh: J81从18和30重建A:B=3:5、反向5:3及A占全部3/8；J82从14和35给2:5、5:2及2/7。两处主动区分后项与合并总量、保留量名与顺序。 新P68/J75-Q1先统一m/cm，重画顺序、合长份额和差，检同倍后差及零前后项的不同域。
rationale.en: J81 reconstructs A:B=3:5, reverse 5:3 and part-of-total 3/8 from eighteen and thirty. J82 gives 2:5,5:2 and 2/7 from fourteen and thirty-five. Both actively distinguish the second quantity from the combined whole and retain names and order. New P68/J75 Q1s match m/cm before reconstructing order, whole share and difference, then compare doubled differences and zero first/second-term domains.

focus.zh: 等值与最简整数比
focus.en: Equivalent and simplest whole-number ratios

rationale.zh: J81用最大公因数6将18:30约成3:5，否定未最简9:15及同减6；J82用7将14:35约成2:5，否定未最简4:10及同减7。均要求共同非零缩放、互质与交叉乘，不能只认可等值数值。 新两组Q2由十分之一和另一共同小单位计数，重建小数及分数项的最简比、非公因数和零缩放边界。
rationale.en: J81 reduces 18:30 by greatest common factor six to 3:5, rejecting unfinished 9:15 and subtraction of six. J82 reduces 14:35 by seven to 2:5, rejecting unfinished 4:10 and subtraction of seven. Both require common nonzero scaling, coprime terms and cross-products rather than mere numerical equivalence. New Q2s count tenths and alternative shared units, reconstruct decimal/fractional simplest ratios and check nonfactors and zero scaling.

focus.zh: 权重分配与允许量
focus.en: Weighted allocation and allowed amounts

rationale.zh: J81把11L按3:5分为33/8与55/8L；J82把13m按2:7分为26/9与91/9m。都画等权重份、核和与原比，再区分连续量、不可拆整数件及零总量的0:0未定义。 新两组Q3给出和正确却比例错误的均分反例，同量加倍权重重画细份，并构造有效整卡总数的分配。
rationale.en: J81 allocates 11L in ratio 3:5 as 33/8 and 55/8L; J82 allocates 13m in ratio 2:7 as 26/9 and 91/9m. Both draw weighted shares, check sum and ratio, then distinguish continuous amounts, indivisible integer objects and undefined actual 0:0 at zero total. New Q3s refute equal splits with a correct total, redraw refined doubled weights at fixed supply and construct feasible whole-card allocations.

focus.zh: 同比表的成对缩放
focus.en: Paired scaling in ratio tables

rationale.zh: J81主动生成B=(5/3)A的四行表，比较3:5到6:10与6:8；J82生成B=(7/2)A表，比较2:7到4:14与4:9。两处核整对同乘、交叉乘、列名及零行可对应但不可除0。 新两组Q4主动生成分数倍与反向给B求A的表，核单零行及正确B固定加1后的非恒比。
rationale.en: J81 generates four rows for B=(5/3)A and contrasts 3:5→6:10 with 6:8; J82 generates B=(7/2)A and contrasts 2:7→4:14 with 4:9. Both require paired scaling, cross-products, named columns and zero-row correspondence without dividing by zero. New Q4s generate fractional-multiplier rows and recover A from B, checking one-zero rows and varying quotients after a fixed extra litre.

focus.zh: 地图比例尺、路线与显示
focus.en: Map scales, routes and display

rationale.zh: J81从1:25000折线6cm得1.5km，二倍印图改1:12500；J82从1:40000折线5cm得2km，四倍改1:10000。都核同单位、指定路线及图示标尺同步缩放；J94另反求2km在1:50000原图为4cm并讨论原图与屏幕条件。 新两组Q5补非半厘米原图路线、反求、1/2与1/4线性缩印及原图两厘米图示标尺的独立核查。
rationale.en: J81 converts a six-centimetre bent route at 1:25000 to 1.5km and a double-size print to 1:12500. J82 converts five centimetres at 1:40000 to 2km and a quadruple print to 1:10000. Both retain units, route and synchronised graphical scaling. J94 inversely maps 2km at 1:50000 to four centimetres and explains paper/screen conditions. New Q5s add non-half-centimetre routes, inverse mapping, half/quarter-size prints and an independent two-centimetre graphic-bar check.

focus.zh: 正比例规则的充分依据
focus.en: Evidence for a direct-proportion rule

rationale.zh: 两组Q3均从已给完整B=kA规则解释所有正输入的恒比及零对应，另用非零截距直线和平方规则分别否定“直就够”与“过零就够”。J75进一步核y=kx+b及有限试值不能证明恒等。不是从几行偶合点直接宣布整体正比例。 新两组Q6画同数据不同纵轴范围，换L/mL的常数与定义域，反求连续水量并区别整卡不能任意插值。
rationale.en: Both Q3 tasks use a supplied complete B=kA rule to justify constant ratios for every positive input and zero correspondence, contrasting nonzero-intercept lines and squaring. J75 further checks y=kx+b and why finite agreeing trials do not prove an identity. A few coinciding table rows are not treated as proof of the full rule. New Q6s plot identical data on different vertical ranges, convert L/mL coefficients and domains, invert continuous quantities and reject automatic interpolation for indivisible cards.

focus.zh: 摄氏参照与负读数
focus.en: Celsius reference and negative readings

rationale.zh: J81与J82须画摄氏零两侧，解释负读数有效、零非最低且每格一度不因稀疏标字改变；J73反求升5到2的原读数−3°C并核允许范围；J75从−4每时升1.5的局部模型重求−1°C并承认负值有效。 新P67/J75-Q1在稀疏标数的一度刻度自主读−6/−8°C，辨间隔与线、负号和三种零记号，并举窗外合理读数。
rationale.en: J81 and J82 draw both sides of Celsius zero and explain valid negative readings, zero not being a minimum and unchanged one-degree intervals under sparse labels. J73 recovers −3°C from a rise of five to two and checks its domain. J75 recomputes −1°C from a local −4 plus 1.5-per-hour rule and retains valid negative readings. New P67/J75 Q1s independently read −6/−8°C on sparsely labelled one-degree scales, distinguish intervals/ticks, signs and zero notations, and construct a reasonable reading beyond the window.

focus.zh: 数轴方向、区间与零
focus.en: Axis direction, intervals and zero

rationale.zh: J81从零向左数七区间至−7，J82数九至−9，都强制标单位、方向与零的整数/非正非负分类，稀疏标签不冒充步数。J75由每格2、向左3格生成−6，进一步区别屏幕格与数值单位。 新两组Q2从零逐步生成−6/−8及邻数，数6/8间隔与7/9条线，扩窗保单位并举原窗外整数，区分按钮边界与整数范围。
rationale.en: J81 counts seven leftward intervals from zero to −7; J82 counts nine to −9. Both label units and direction, classify zero and distinguish sparse labels from movement count. J75 generates −6 from three leftward intervals of two, further distinguishing displayed cells from numerical units. New Q2s generate −6/−8 and neighbours, count six/eight intervals versus seven/nine ticks, extend the window with fixed units and construct an integer beyond the original button limit.

focus.zh: 负数按位置比较
focus.en: Ordering negatives by position

rationale.zh: J81排序−7、−2、0、2，J82排序−9、−3、0、3，均须画位置并解释不能只比无符号数码；J71主动在−2.5与−2.05中选更靠右的−2.05。两负数靠零较大与跨零顺序都被重新生成。 新两组Q3同时给大小、相等及跨零关系，生成正数反例，保留“两负数”近零较大的限定及温度负号。
rationale.en: J81 orders −7,−2,0,2 and J82 orders −9,−3,0,3, requiring positions rather than unsigned-digit comparisons. J71 actively selects −2.05 as the rightward larger value over −2.5. Both same-side negative order and order across zero are regenerated. New Q3s reconstruct larger/smaller, equality and cross-zero order, generate positive counterexamples, and retain the two-negative restriction and signed temperature readings.

focus.zh: 跨零、变化与终点
focus.en: Crossing zero, change and endpoint

rationale.zh: J81由−4加7或减−7到3，J82由−6加10或减−10到4，都核箭头、逆操作、终点/变化/距离、反向、只到零及加零。J71以分数扩展相同结构，J75从(−2,−1)分别跨零到(3,2)，不把方向直接当终点正负。 新两组Q4各八独立行，核加减带符号项、向右仍负、两阶段跨零、恰零、不动、扩窗到±18及逆操作，区分终点/变化/距离。
rationale.en: J81 moves from −4 by adding seven or subtracting −7 to three; J82 moves from −6 by adding ten or subtracting −10 to four. Both check arrows, inverse operations, endpoint/change/distance, reversal, merely reaching zero and adding zero. J71 extends the structure to fractions; J75 crosses both coordinate zeros from (−2,−1) to (3,2). New Q4s each supply eight independent rows: signed addition/subtraction, rightward yet negative endpoints, staged zero crossing, reaching zero, staying still, expanded windows to ±18 and inverse checks, distinguishing endpoint/change/distance.

focus.zh: 绝对值、相反数与距离
focus.en: Absolute value, opposite and distance

rationale.zh: J81画±5，J82画±8，均解释同距不等位置、正数相反数与绝对值不同、|0|=0；再求同侧−5到−2为3、−8到−3为5，否定一律相加到零距离。J71将同样原则迁移到负分数与反向变化。 新两组Q5求一般两点同侧和跨零距离、反向变化与原数/相反数/绝对值，并逆构造同距两点、零和负距离边界。
rationale.en: J81 draws ±5 and J82 ±8, distinguishing equal distances from equal positions, opposite from absolute value, and |0|=0. They compute same-side distances three from −5 to −2 and five from −8 to −3, rejecting automatic sums of distances to zero. J71 extends the same principles to negative fractions and reversed changes. New Q5s reconstruct arbitrary same-side/cross-zero distances and reversed changes, distinguish value/opposite/absolute value, and generate equal-distance points with zero and negative-distance boundaries.

focus.zh: 同一字母一致代入
focus.en: Consistent substitution for one letter

rationale.zh: J72把x=−2一致代入x²及−x²并区别底数；J82将x=0、1分别代入原多项式与错误因式，得到0处巧合、1处12与14的反例。都保留每次同字母同值与原运算，不能凭一次吻合宣称恒等。 新J71/J73-Q1逐处同值代入负数/零/半数，构造乘积与拼数反例、不同字母同值、纯数与完整片数域，并区分表达式/赋值/条件。
rationale.en: J72 consistently substitutes x=−2 into x² and −x² while retaining base scope. J82 substitutes zero and one into a polynomial and proposed factors, finding coincidence at zero but twelve versus fourteen at one. Both preserve the assigned value and operations, rejecting identity claims based on one match. New J71/J73 Q1s substitute negatives, zero and halves consistently, construct product/concatenation and equal-value/different-letter examples, distinguish pure-number/count domains and expression/assignment/condition roles.

focus.zh: 完整构造支持第n项
focus.en: A complete construction supports the nth term

rationale.zh: J81按三行n加固定2推3n+2，第5幅17；J82按四行n加固定1推4n+1，第6幅25。都画前两幅、指出固定项与幅号正整数，有限给数不唯一；H07用两个明确公式在前三项吻合、第四项不同强化反例。 新两组Q2从总数反求合法与非法正整数幅号、求超十幅窗口的第17/23幅，并构造两种完整延续检验前缀证据。
rationale.en: J81 derives 3n+2 from three rows of n plus two fixed tiles, giving seventeen in figure five. J82 derives 4n+1 and twenty-five in figure six. Both draw initial figures, identify fixed terms and positive integer indices, and explain non-unique continuations from finite data. H07 provides two explicit formulas agreeing initially but differing at the fourth term. New Q2s invert valid and invalid positive-integer indices, compute beyond the ten-figure display at stages 17/23 and construct two complete continuations to test finite-prefix evidence.

focus.zh: 括号分组与表达式结构
focus.en: Grouping and expression structure

rationale.zh: J72须把−2乘3x与−4的每项，解释常数也受外部因子；J81须把−2x乘x与−3，并以正长度2x(x+3)解释两块面积。两处重新解析完整括号与每项重复，核零因子、符号和图示正长度范围，不只比较末值。 新两组Q3画零时完整袋框/固定块，生成每袋与袋外总式、两个少量数、减法顺序及两种折半次序，区分通式与当前总值。
rationale.en: J72 distributes −2 across both 3x and −4, explaining why the constant also receives the factor. J81 distributes −2x across x and −3 and models positive-length 2x(x+3) as two areas. Both actively parse whole groups and repeated terms, checking zero factors, signs and positive-length diagram conditions rather than final values alone. New Q3s draw retained zero-count boxes/extras, construct per-bag/overall expressions, repeated differences, subtraction order and two halving orders, distinguishing a general expression from a current total.

focus.zh: 可逆变形保留全部限制
focus.en: Reversible transformations retain all constraints

rationale.zh: J73还原5x+2=2x+11每步两边操作，说明乘零或单边改变丢解集信息；J83保留一式作可逆行替换，具体展示用零倍原第一式使(1,0)成为新组伪解。两处都要求原式代回、非零可逆条件及反例，不由新式成立倒推原限制。 新两组Q4用负系数精确解，逐枝核四种同做的逆、单边假解、乘零新增候选及三种零系数关系，保全部解而非一次平衡。
rationale.en: J73 restores both-side operations for 5x+2=2x+11 and explains information loss from multiplication by zero or unilateral change. J83 retains one equation for reversible row replacement and explicitly shows a zero coefficient introducing spurious pair (1,0). Both require original checks, nonzero reversibility and counterexamples rather than inferring original validity from a weakened relation. New Q4s solve negative-coefficient equations exactly, check inverses of four equal actions, a one-sided false solution, an additional zero-multiplication candidate and three zero relations, distinguishing full solution preservation from one balance.

focus.zh: 含括号方程的等值步骤
focus.en: Equivalent steps in bracketed equations

rationale.zh: J73将−3(x−2)=2x+1逐项展开、两边变形到x=1并代回，核系数抵消时不能除零；J83完整代入y=7−x形成2x+(7−x)=11，再合并求x=4、回代y=3并核两原式。两处必须保留括号整组与原限制，不能只交答案。 新两组Q5以−2/3、−1/6双路径解及原式代回，精确比较近似3.99/4.98，另解先乘后加分支和唯一零解。
rationale.en: J73 expands −3(x−2)=2x+1 term by term, transforms both sides to x=1 and checks, retaining the no-division-by-zero boundary after cancellation. J83 substitutes the whole y=7−x to form 2x+(7−x)=11, solves x=4, recovers y=3 and checks both originals. Both require whole-group brackets and original constraints rather than just an answer. New Q5s obtain −2/3 and −1/6 through two valid paths, check originals against approximate 3.99/4.98, then solve multiply-before-add inverse branches and unique zero-solution cases.

focus.zh: 圆心、半径、直径与弦
focus.en: Circle centre, radius, diameter and chord

rationale.zh: J91以半径5、弦6与直径10区分端点和过圆心；J92用半径13、弦10、直径26换构型。两处须画图解释任意半弦不是半径、旋转保定义，并有合法坐标构型供核对。 新J91/J92-Q1由直径5/7反求半径2.5/3.5，并以另圆直径2/3反驳跨圆比较，区分弦/直径合类、重合与显示点状不等零。
rationale.en: J91 distinguishes endpoints and centre incidence using radius five, chord six and diameter ten; J92 changes to radius thirteen, chord ten and diameter twenty-six. Both require a drawing, explain why half an arbitrary chord is not a radius and retain definitions under rotation, with valid coordinate witnesses. New J91/J92 Q1s invert diameters five/seven to radii 2.5/3.5 and refute cross-circle comparisons with separate diameters two/three, retaining chord/diameter inclusion, coincident labels and appearance versus zero.

focus.zh: 理想圆周率与有限测量
focus.en: Ideal pi and finite measurements

rationale.zh: J91生成31.4/10=3.14与62.9/20=3.145，J92生成18.9/6=3.15与25.1/8=3.1375。均解释C/d而非C/r、同单位、误差与近似，区分模拟和实测，有限表不证明π的精确值或无理性。 新两组Q2由cm/mm原读数双向统一单位、算错误半径商和未换单位小十倍，核零/负长度及半周/拉伸条件。
rationale.en: J91 generates ratios 3.14 and 3.145 from the given readings; J92 generates 3.15 and 3.1375. Both explain C/d rather than C/r, matching units, errors and approximations, distinguish simulation from measurement and reject exact-value or irrationality claims from a finite table. New Q2s match cm/mm readings in both common units, reconstruct erroneous radius quotients and tenfold unmatched-unit errors, and check zero/negative lengths and incomplete/stretched wraps.

focus.zh: 周长、直径与精确π
focus.en: Circumference, diameter and exact pi

rationale.zh: J91由半径3/2cm求直径3及精确3πcm，再按3.14近似9.42cm；J92由直径7/2m求半径7/4及精确7π/2m、近似10.99m。都解释漏2或多2错误、边界长度与等号/约等号。 新两组Q3反求同3.14约定的21.98/28.26周长，算无滑动多整周并亲描半圆弧与含直径整边框，保混合精确式。
rationale.en: J91 goes from radius 3/2cm to diameter three and exact 3πcm, approximating 9.42cm. J92 goes from diameter 7/2m to radius 7/4 and exact 7π/2m, approximating 10.99m. Both explain missing/doubled factors, boundary-length units and equality versus approximation. New Q3s invert calculated circumferences 21.98/28.26 under the same 3.14 convention, compute multiple no-slip turns and distinguish semicircular arcs from complete borders with a diameter, retaining mixed exact expressions.

focus.zh: 扇形重排的守恒与极限
focus.en: Sector rearrangement, conservation and limits

rationale.zh: J91画r3的12片，J92画r5的8片，均须保留真实弧边及每片面积，解释内弦虚线不等于全部材料，有限图非精确矩形；细分时底趋半周πr、高趋r，给9πcm²或25πm²。不是仅代πr²便认作拼接解释。 新两组Q4由直径6/10求面积、比较实际放大与显示放大，并以8/64原片跟踪保面积和有限辅助界。
rationale.en: J91 sketches twelve sectors at radius three and J92 eight at radius five. Both retain curved pieces, distinguish inner chord guides from all material and explain why finite rearrangements are not exact rectangles. Refinement gives limiting base πr and height r, leading to 9πcm² or 25πm²; formula substitution alone is insufficient. New Q4s derive areas from diameters six/ten, compare actual with display scaling, and track conserved pieces through eight/64 sectors with finite guide limits.

focus.zh: 圆柱展开、材料与空间
focus.en: Cylinder nets, material and space

rationale.zh: J91以r3h8画侧面、底，求无盖57πcm²、封闭66πcm²、体积72πcm³；J92以r2h6求28πm²、32πm²、24πm³，并解释侧面积同系数24π不等体积。两处核实际面数、内部尺寸、无底不能直接盛水与薄板假设。 新两组Q5分开理想薄壁面片与另厚壁容器，量化内外尺寸误差、只加倍高的非二倍封闭面积及cm³/mL，保无底和纸张尺寸限制。
rationale.en: J91 draws side and base for r3,h8, obtaining open area 57πcm², closed 66πcm² and volume 72πcm³. J92 uses r2,h6 for 28πm²,32πm² and 24πm³, explaining why lateral-area coefficient 24π does not equate area and volume. Both check face counts, internal dimensions, the need for a base to hold water and thin-board assumptions. New Q5s separate ideal thin-wall faces from a thick-walled container, quantify inner/outer errors, height-only changes to closed area, and cm³/mL, retaining baseless and sheet-dimension restrictions.

focus.zh: 中位位置与完整众数
focus.en: Median position and all modes

rationale.zh: J91保留2,2,4,6,6,10求中位5、众数2与6；J92保留0,0,3,5,5,11求中位4、众数0与5，改尾值后重算。均须平均中间两条、不去重、全报并列，并区分无众数与众数为0。 新J93/J94-Q1保五个ID排序求奇数中位与完整众数，实算两端平均/去重后的错误13/2，并亲造偶数未观察中位例。
rationale.en: J91 retains 2,2,4,6,6,10 for median five and modes two and six. J92 retains 0,0,3,5,5,11 for median four and modes zero and five, then recomputes after a tail change. Both average the middle pair, retain duplicates, report every tied mode and distinguish no mode from mode zero. New J93/J94 Q1s order five original IDs for odd medians/all modes, calculate erroneous extremes/deduplicated medians 13/2 and construct an even-count unobserved-median example.

focus.zh: 按问题选择统计摘要
focus.en: Choosing a summary for its purpose

rationale.zh: J91核尾10改40后均值5变10、中位仍5；J92尾11改41后均值4变9、中位仍4。两处分别解释均分总量、中间位置和常见值，核实异常保留并限制样本结论；J76另给尾改0导致中位也改变的边界。 新两组Q2从无序类别频数求名称众数，反驳任意编码的数值平均；另以0/1/3或0/2/3等待生成精确4/3或5/3均分，保零与不同问题。
rationale.en: J91 changes the tail from ten to forty, moving mean five to ten while median stays five. J92 changes eleven to forty-one, moving mean four to nine while median stays four. Both explain equal sharing, middle position and frequency, retain verified extremes and limit sample conclusions. J76 also changes a tail to zero, showing that the median can change. New Q2s report nominal-category modes and reject arbitrary-code numerical means, then reconstruct exact 4/3 or 5/3 equal-share waits from 0/1/3 or 0/2/3, retaining zero and distinct purposes.

focus.zh: 等可能须有机制依据
focus.en: Equiprobability needs mechanism assumptions

rationale.zh: J76须列公平独立硬币/骰子的基本路径，解释合并事件不等可能及零分支；J97须按编号有序对权重比较颜色类别并区分完整模型与有限样本；H24按16等可能串重算恰2正6/16，否定五类正面数等权。机会来自基本机制，不来自类别名称数量或样本巧合。 新两组Q4从均匀角度的半圆/三等分条件先重求A/B理论机会，再与完整假想记录分开，零次/零命中和下次不补偿均检查。
rationale.en: J76 lists fair independent coin/die paths, distinguishing unequally weighted grouped events and zero branches. J97 weights colour categories by numbered ordered pairs and distinguishes a full model from a finite sample. H24 recomputes exactly two heads as six of sixteen equiprobable strings, rejecting equal weights for five head-count categories. Mechanisms, not category names or sample coincidence, justify chance. New Q4s first derive A/B theory from uniform-angle half-circle/equal-third assumptions, then separate full fictional records, no trials, zero hits and unchanged next-trial chances.

focus.zh: 有限事件的分子、分母与条件
focus.en: Finite-event numerator, denominator and conditions

rationale.zh: J76重建和2的1/36与和7的1/6、两红一蓝放回/不放回概率；J97列3红2蓝不放回20编号有序对，颜色RR/RB/BR/BB权重6/6/6/2。都保等可能非空基本空间及零分支；H24将P(A)=0事件仍有无条件概率与不能以A作普通条件分母区分，强化零事件不等于可除0。 新两组Q3按原ID合并A或B与B或C，实查重叠导致5/4或7/5错误，重数交集、非空零事件、空袋与移走一枚A后的条件。
rationale.en: J76 reconstructs probabilities 1/36 for sum two and 1/6 for sum seven and compares replacement conditions for two red and one blue.
