J97 counts twenty numbered ordered pairs with colour weights 6,6,6,2. Both retain nonempty equiprobable basic spaces and zero branches. H24 distinguishes a zero-probability event from an invalid ordinary conditional denominator, reinforcing that a zero event does not permit division by zero. New Q3s form ID unions of A-or-B and B-or-C, expose overlap sums 5/4 or 7/5, recount intersections, nonempty zero events, empty bags and the bag after one A is removed.

focus.zh: 记录频率与理论机会
focus.en: Recorded frequency versus theoretical chance

rationale.zh: J93由10轮8异色重算4/5，再异色9/11离理论3/5更远；J94由9轮4RR得4/9，再RR得1/2离理论1/3更远，都核完整两抽轮为分母、零轮未定义、独立模型无补偿及来源。J97另生成29/50与追加后61/110，不改成理论或平均批率；H33区分已舍入正态理论68.27%与有限频率。已有较近后续单元的主动反例，不只依靠高中迁移。 新两组Q4从十/十二条原记录重数A/B，保末八条累计号3/5不替全批，画前三点与追加变远反例，区分零命中/零次及给定/程序/实测。
rationale.en: J93 recomputes 4/5 from eight different-colour rounds in ten, then 9/11 farther from theoretical 3/5. J94 recomputes 4/9 then 1/2 farther from theoretical 1/3. Both use complete two-draw rounds as denominators, retain undefined zero-round frequency, independent no-compensation and source conditions. J97 adds 29/50 and 61/110 without replacing records by theory or averaging batch rates; H33 distinguishes rounded normal-theory 68.27% from finite frequencies. Earlier later-unit tasks supply active counterexamples alongside advanced transfer. New Q4s recount A/B over ten/twelve records, retain latest-eight starting indices three/five without replacing the full batch, plot initial points and an added-trial counterexample, distinguishing zero hits/no trials and given/software/observed sources.

focus.zh: 速度平均的时间范围
focus.en: Time scope for average speed

rationale.zh: J91去程4km移动40停20，分别6与4km/h，往返8km/80min得6；J92去程6km移动45停15，分别8与6，往返12km/90min得8。均逐个写同范围分子分母、换小时、乘回并否定不同用时的速度直接平均。 新两组Q1亲画累计路程图，逆求停留35/60min及9/2km，重算往返15/2或56/9km/h，核等时特例、零及净位置不等路程。
rationale.en: J91 separates moving and elapsed averages six and four for four kilometres with forty moving and twenty stopped minutes, then averages eight kilometres over eighty minutes for six. J92 similarly gives eight and six, then eight for twelve kilometres over ninety minutes. Both state matched scopes, convert hours, multiply back and reject arithmetic means over unequal durations. New Q1s construct cumulative-distance plots, invert stops 35/60min and distance 9/2km, recount return-trip averages 15/2 or 56/9km/h, and check equal-time exceptions, zero and displacement versus distance.

focus.zh: 同一任务的恒定工作速率
focus.en: Constant work rates for the same job

rationale.zh: J91由同一60L任务的20/30min得3+2L/min、12min，改总恒流4后15min；J92由同一72L的24/18min得3+4L/min、72/7min，改总恒流5后72/5min。均须核各泵供量、精确时间与无干扰条件，不能把用时相加或默认合作就除2。 新两组Q2由原率算已装35、剩25/37及追加/总时间，核一泵零、双泵零、零时刻、满后自动停与真实条件改变。
rationale.en: J91 derives 3+2L/min and twelve minutes from a sixty-litre job taking twenty/thirty alone, changing to fifteen under a specified total constant rate four. J92 derives 3+4L/min and 72/7min for seventy-two litres, changing to 72/5min under total rate five. Both check individual contributions, exact time and no-interference assumptions rather than adding durations or automatically halving. New Q2s compute 35 filled, 25/37 remaining and additional versus total time from original rates, checking one/both pumps off, time zero, automatic shutoff and changed real conditions.

focus.zh: 预算、预留与折扣参照
focus.en: Budget, reserve and discount base

rationale.zh: J91先从120预留12得可用108，只把花园原门票48乘0.75，再加整组往返与午餐；J92从150预留30得可用120，同样辨票价基数与原预算。都逐项核费用、可用不等式与整组/每人，不把预留当打折费用或账户有余额就算满足要求。 复用J75/J76百分数Q6亲算连续同率不同基数；新两组Q4列账户/可用余额，独立核0/100%折扣、零预留与不足一分需舍入约定。
rationale.en: J91 reserves twelve from 120 for spendable 108, discounts only original garden tickets forty-eight by 0.75 and adds group return travel and lunch. J92 reserves thirty from 150 for spendable 120 and distinguishes ticket bases from budget. Both check each cost, spendable inequality and per-group/per-person roles rather than discounting the reserve or treating any account balance as compliance. Existing J75/J76 percent Q6s reconstruct sequential changes on different bases. New Q4s distinguish account balance/headroom and independently check 0/100% discounts, zero reserve and the need for a sub-cent rounding rule.

focus.zh: 图表记录、多步费用与未知
focus.en: Chart records, multi-step costs and unknowns

rationale.zh: J91由12/缺测/18/0重求3/4/0包及已知三日费51，J92由7/0/缺测/13重求2/0/4包及已知费30。都亲画图、换轴而不换原量、逐日买足整包加固定费、区分人次/不同个体/缺测，并拒绝补零、完整总量与因果外推。 新两组Q3保缺测/零、截轴与原值，求原基数增长1/2、撤固定费反求人数、逐日必收费及恰整包/多一人边界。
rationale.en: J91 uses 12/missing/18/0 visits to obtain three/four/zero packs and known-day cost fifty-one. J92 uses 7/0/missing/13 for two/zero/four packs and cost thirty. Both draw charts, rescale without changing data, buy enough whole packs daily, add fixed costs and distinguish visits, people and missing values, rejecting imputed zeros, full totals and causal extrapolation. New Q3s retain missing/zero, truncated axes and records, derive original-base growth 1/2, undo fixed charges to recover visits and check daily fees plus exact-pack/one-extra boundaries.

focus.zh: 旅行计划的联合限制与取舍
focus.en: Joint trip constraints and tradeoffs

rationale.zh: 两组均要求列两路线×两活动四方案的完整整组价与总时长，含午餐、机动、往返及折扣。J91只有A花园108/200和A展馆104/240满足108元/240min；J92只有A花园108/180和A展馆102/210满足120元/210min。须任选可行并说明钱/时间取舍，不以最低价单目标替代联合可行性。 新两组Q4亲画09:00至13:00逐段时刻，缩210min与加一人分支重算，另生成直达步道230min方案，不以单目标或唯一解代两条约束。
rationale.en: Both require a four-plan table for two routes and two activities, including lunch, buffer, return travel and discounts. J91 admits only A/garden 108/200 and A/museum 104/240 under 108 dollars/240min. J92 admits A/garden 108/180 and A/museum 102/210 under 120 dollars/210min. Each requires a feasible choice and a money/time tradeoff rather than cheapest-price selection alone. New Q4s construct segment times from 09:00 to 13:00, recheck independent 210min/one-extra-person changes and generate a 230min direct-trail alternative without replacing joint constraints with one goal or a unique-answer claim.

focus.zh: 有理数等值、相反数与倒数
focus.en: Rational equivalence, opposite and reciprocal

rationale.zh: J83在同单位轴定位−5/4、−1.25、−10/8，J84定位−7/2、−3.5、−21/6。都重建同点等值、相反数和0、负倒数积1，核零有相反数却无倒数，不靠去负号。 新两组Q1规范负分母、以整数比容纳整数零，重建有限截断/明确无限循环之差1/3000或1/1500，并比较负小数顺序、双相反与等分单位。
rationale.en: J83 locates −5/4,−1.25,−10/8 on one fixed-unit axis; J84 uses −7/2,−3.5,−21/6. Both regenerate equivalent positions, opposite/sum-zero and negative-reciprocal/product-one relations, including zero’s opposite but no reciprocal. New Q1s normalise negative denominators, include integers/zero as integer ratios, derive finite-versus-infinite-repeat gaps 1/3000 or 1/1500 and check negative-decimal order, double opposites and equal-unit subdivisions.

focus.zh: 有理数有向差与距离
focus.en: Rational signed changes and distances

rationale.zh: J83由−7/6到−1/3生成变化±5/6、距离5/6，改+1/3跨零距3/2；J84由−9/8到−1/4生成±7/8、距离7/8，改+1/4距11/8。都画反向与实际路径，解释同侧重叠、同绝对值不等位置、|0|。 新两组Q1由原X/Y求有向差与距离，独立重建重合点、零端点与反射Y后跨零距离，四等分改八等分不改单位。
rationale.en: J83 generates changes ±5/6 and distance 5/6 from −7/6 to −1/3, versus 3/2 across zero. J84 generates ±7/8 and 7/8, versus 11/8 across zero. Both draw paths and reversal and explain same-side overlap, equal magnitudes at different positions and |0|. New Q1s reconstruct signed differences/distances from X/Y, independently checking coincident/zero endpoints and reflected-Y crossing distances while quarters-to-eighths refinement preserves units.

focus.zh: 带符号分数相加的两种模型
focus.en: Two models for signed fraction addition

rationale.zh: J83用同整体十二分之一和数轴解释−5/6+3/4=−1/12；J84用二十四分之一解释−7/8+5/6=−1/24。两处强制相消与数轴双过程、减回、向右却仍负及同整体单位，不能只交末值。 新两组Q2用共同十二/二十四份求四种加减，另亲算同号、相反、零与有限小数及两种合法加法交换结合。
rationale.en: J83 explains −5/6+3/4=−1/12 in common-whole twelfths and on an axis; J84 uses twenty-fourths for −7/8+5/6=−1/24. Both require cancellation and axis models, inverse checks and a negative endpoint despite rightward movement, retaining the same whole. New Q2s use common twelfths/twenty-fourths for four signed sums/differences, then generate same-sign, opposite, zero and finite-decimal cases and two justified addition orders.

focus.zh: 减负分数与加负分数
focus.en: Subtracting versus adding a negative fraction

rationale.zh: J83比较减−3/4得−1/12与加−3/4得−19/12；J84比较减−5/6得−1/24与加−5/6得−41/24。都保首项、改运算并取整个减数相反数，画箭头、差加回原减数，核减0及增大仍负。 新两组Q2亲算减正、减负、减零、零减与跨零，加回原减数并比较不同减法括号，保首项和精确值。
rationale.en: J83 contrasts subtracting −3/4 for −1/12 with adding it for −19/12; J84 contrasts −1/24 with −41/24. Both retain the first term, rewrite the operation and whole subtrahend, draw arrows, add the original subtrahend back and check zero and increased-yet-negative values. New Q2s calculate positive/negative/zero subtrahends, zero minuends and crossing zero, add back ORIGINAL subtrahends and compare changed subtraction brackets while retaining the first term.

focus.zh: 负因子缩放、反射与非零除法
focus.en: Negative scaling, reflection and nonzero division

rationale.zh: J83由5/6乘−2/3反射缩放得−5/9，再由q乘−2/3为−5/6推5/4；J84对应得−21/32与商7/6。都解释数轴缩放不等于负份实物重复、原除数与负倒数、乘回、除法可放大及零除数无解/不唯一。 新两组Q3生成七因子映射与正大/负小除数，分数值顺序与幅距，算三负积，并由分配律推负一映射而非背符号。
rationale.en: J83 reflects/scales 5/6 by −2/3 for −5/9 and solves q×(−2/3)=−5/6 for 5/4. J84 obtains −21/32 and quotient 7/6. Both distinguish numerical scaling from physical copies, divisor from negative reciprocal, inverse checks, enlargement and no-solution/non-unique zero divisors. New Q3s build seven factor maps, divide by positive-large/negative-small divisors, separate order from magnitude, compute three-negative products and derive the minus-one map by distributivity.

focus.zh: 幂底数与混合运算结构
focus.en: Power bases and mixed-operation structure

rationale.zh: J83区分−3²与(−3)²，逐步算−8÷2×(−3)+1/2为25/2，错加分母括号变11/6；J84以−4²、(−4)²及另一混合式得17/3、错式7/6。均保每步未算部分、同级从左到右、精确分数及零除数停止。 新两组Q4保完整分数括号乘法、另分配核算、内外减子式、负分数平方/立方及同级加减，外乘零不救内部零除数。
rationale.en: J83 distinguishes −3² from (−3)² and calculates −8÷2×(−3)+1/2=25/2 versus an invented-denominator result 11/6. J84 uses −4²,(−4)² and a different mixed expression for 17/3 versus 7/6. Both retain untouched parts, left-to-right equal precedence, exact fractions and stopping on zero divisors. New Q4s retain complete bracketed fractional products, independently distribute, evaluate nested subtraction, signed fractional squares/cubes and left-to-right subtraction, and reject using an outside zero to rescue internal zero division.

focus.zh: 代入保底数、符号与一般关系
focus.en: Substitution retains bases, signs and general relations

rationale.zh: J81用b=2、x=1否定漏中项式，解释x=0巧合不足；J82将x=0、x=1一致代入原多项式与错误因式，0处都6而1处12与14。都保每个字母同值、底数与外部运算，区分有限试值和完整恒等推导。 新两组Q1保x/y独立分数赋值，完整重代得11/12或−13/36，仅改y后得−5/12或77/36；保外负号并对有限吻合另给反例。
rationale.en: J81 uses b=2,x=1 to refute a missing-cross-term expression despite coincidence at zero. J82 consistently substitutes zero and one into a polynomial and proposed factors, obtaining six at zero but twelve versus fourteen at one. Both retain assignments, bases and outside operations and distinguish finite trials from identity derivations. New Q1s consistently substitute separate fractional x/y assignments for 11/12 or −13/36, then change only y for −5/12 or 77/36, retaining outside minus signs and counterexamples to finite-agreement claims.

focus.zh: 按字母指数合并并保留零
focus.en: Collecting by exponents and retaining zero

rationale.zh: 两组Q7按平方、一次、常数收集完整差式、保每项系数，否定x²和x因一次同值就同类，并主动将A−A写0。J81由四对乘积合ax与bx为(a+b)x，不把平方项合入一次。 新两组Q2保九原ID与完整字母指数，重建分数系数/xy-yx/同次数异字母类型与零抵消，不靠某次同值分组。
rationale.en: Both Q7 tasks collect complete differences by square, linear and constant terms, retain coefficients, reject term classification by one matching input and write A−A as zero. J81 combines ax and bx into (a+b)x after four products without merging square and linear terms. New Q2s retain nine original IDs and each letter exponent, reconstructing fractional coefficients, xy/yx, equal-degree unlike types and cancellation without grouping by a coincident numerical value.

focus.zh: 外部因子覆盖每项
focus.en: An outside factor applies to every term

rationale.zh: Q7将负1覆盖被减式每项，Q8将非零公倍数覆盖包括整数的每项再展开负括号；J81核−2x(x−3)及正长度面积范围，J82逆分配6x(x+2)并核x=0仍成立。不是只改首项或偷偷除去零因子。 新两组Q3把负分数因子连三项，包括常数，另与H合并并核0/1/−1/正反因子；原式等值不代完成展开。
rationale.en: Q7 distributes −1 across every subtracted term; Q8 applies a nonzero common multiple to every term including integers and expands negative brackets. J81 checks −2x(x−3) and positive-length model bounds; J82 reverses distribution to 6x(x+2), retaining x=0 rather than cancelling a possibly zero factor. New Q3s connect negative fractional factors to all three terms including constants, collect with H and check 0/1/−1/opposite factors, distinguishing equivalent originals from finished expansion.

focus.zh: 整式差、逐项符号与加回
focus.en: Polynomial difference, term signs and adding back

rationale.zh: J83生成2x²−7x+10，J84生成2y²+6y−10。均将第二式整体取反、保第一式、按类收集、加回原第二式，再代负1得到19或−14，核A−A全消为0。 新两组Q2独立重求分数系数双变量A+B/A−B/嵌套A−(B−C)/A−A，并把差加原B逐类还原，保每项来源。
rationale.en: J83 generates 2x²−7x+10 and J84 2y²+6y−10. Both negate the whole second expression, retain the first, collect by type, add the original second back and substitute negative one for nineteen or −14, checking A−A=0. New Q2s independently reconstruct fractional two-variable sums, differences, nested A−(B−C) and A−A, adding original B back by type while retaining every source term.

focus.zh: 由数量组成生成一般式
focus.en: Generating expressions from quantity structure

rationale.zh: J81由高2x、宽x+3生成两块面积2x²、6x和2x(x+3)，区分负代数项与负宽度；J92出口由宽x、长x+1、面积2cm²生成原模型，求根1/−2后筛正长度并给单位。都重建变量、组成和范围，不拿一次代值当一般关系。 新两组Q4按原收费/整单与逐本优惠/袋装/正分数长方形亲建一般式，核零价格或组费、不同n域及周长面积的单位和1/2或3/2样例。
rationale.en: J81 generates areas 2x² and 6x and expression 2x(x+3) from positive lengths, distinguishing negative algebraic terms from negative widths. J92’s exit builds the original area model from width x,length x+1 and area 2cm², solves one and −2, then filters positive lengths with units. Both reconstruct variables, composition and domain rather than substituting a single value for a general relation. New Q4s derive group charges, order/per-item discounts, bag totals and positive-fraction rectangles, checking zero prices/fees, distinct n domains, perimeter/area units and samples 1/2 or 3/2.

focus.zh: 原式检验与解集范围
focus.en: Original checks and solution-set scope

rationale.zh: J83用同一数对核两原式，(2,5)只过一条、(4,3)都过；J92逐值联系左=右与左−右=0、区别矛盾/恒等，并用x=0原式检查反驳除x丢根。不能把一个候选通过当全域恒等或完整解集。 新J83/J92第1卡分别重建精确分数原式左右值与近似差，另分唯一零、矛盾和恒等，完整性靠可逆步骤而非单次代入。
rationale.en: J83 checks each pair against both originals: (2,5) passes one and (4,3) both. J92 relates equality to a zero difference for each value, distinguishes contradiction/identity and checks x=0 to refute a lost root after division by x. One candidate passing does not establish an identity or complete solution set. New J83/J92 card ones reconstruct exact fractional original-side values and rounded discrepancies, then distinguish unique zero, contradiction and identity; completeness follows from reversible steps rather than one passing trial.

focus.zh: 可逆两边操作与分支条件
focus.en: Reversible both-side operations and branch conditions

rationale.zh: Q8逐项同乘非零12、同减合并、同除非零系数并原式核验；J83保留原行及非零替换系数，反驳零倍丢条件；J92除x前分零与非零分支。都重建保解条件，不只背移项变号。 新两组第2卡以负分数同乘及逆操作保解，另以零乘新增候选、零除未定义、单侧碰巧同解与另一方程反例、除变量失零分支区分规则与实例。
rationale.en: Q8 multiplies every term by nonzero twelve, subtracts/collects, divides by a nonzero coefficient and checks the original. J83 retains an original row and nonzero replacement coefficient, refuting zero-factor information loss. J92 branches zero and nonzero before division by x. Each reconstructs solution preservation rather than a sign-changing mnemonic. New card twos use a negative fractional multiplier and its inverse, then separate zero-multiplication extra candidates, undefined zero division, one-sided coincidental equality versus a counterexample, and a lost variable-zero branch.

focus.zh: 完整括号与一次方程
focus.en: Whole brackets in linear equations

rationale.zh: J83展开4(x−2)−3(x+1)+12=2求x=1，J84展开6(y+1)−4(y−2)+12=3求y=−23/2。都说明每项符号、两边可逆步骤、精确解、原式检查及系数抵消后的恒等/矛盾，不除零。 新两组第3卡把负分数连到每个完整项，分别求2/3或−3/4，并对错中间式的−7/3或7/4候选重代最初括号两边给反例。
rationale.en: J83 expands 4(x−2)−3(x+1)+12=2 to x=1; J84 expands 6(y+1)−4(y−2)+12=3 to y=−23/2. Both justify every sign, reversible both-side steps, exact solution, original check and identity/contradiction after coefficient cancellation without zero division. New card threes connect a negative fractional factor to every term, solve for 2/3 or −3/4, and refute erroneous-intermediate candidates −7/3 or 7/4 by checking both original bracketed sides.

focus.zh: 常数分母逐项去分母
focus.en: Clearing constant denominators term by term

rationale.zh: Q8从分母3/4/6或2/3/4的原式选非零公倍数12，强制整数项也乘、负因子覆盖整括号，再代回x=1或y=−23/2。明确常数分母固定非零，没有额外排变量0，不隐藏变量分母条件。
rationale.en: Q8 chooses nonzero common multiple twelve for constants 3,4,6 or 2,3,4, explicitly multiplying integer terms and whole negative groups before substituting x=1 or y=−23/2. Fixed nonzero denominators add no variable-zero exclusion and hide no variable-denominator condition.

focus.zh: 保留原数量关系的模型
focus.en: Models retaining original quantity relationships

rationale.zh: J83定义票数/升数x,y，重建总量x+y=7与金额5x+3y=30，再核精确数对和范围；J92出口由宽x、长x+1、面积2生成原模型、完整根分支、正长筛选及cm单位。都展示模型两侧数量来源，不能只交解值或移项零式。 新两组第4卡先构造精确年龄和/差、两人同过年数的未来倍数、完整包/散卡及长度/温度/零总量/非负价格的原关系，再求解筛选；另自创不同可行分数年龄与不可行整包模型。
rationale.en: J83 defines x,y as tickets/litres, regenerates total x+y=7 and cost 5x+3y=30 and checks the exact pair and domain. J92’s exit constructs an original area model, complete root branches, positive-length filtering and centimetre units. Both show quantity sources rather than only solved values or a zero form. New card fours construct original age-total/gap, whole future-age multiple, pack/extras and length/temperature/zero-total/nonnegative-price relations before solving/filtering, then invent a different feasible fractional-age and impossible-whole-pack pair.

focus.zh: 等式成立与情境允许分别核
focus.en: Separate validity from contextual admissibility

rationale.zh: J83的(9/2,5/2)原等式都成立，却只允许连续升数而非整数票；J92出口−2通过面积等式却违正长度，1两关均过；J85区分连续非负排水和整包整数域。均先核原式再核情境，不舍入造解或把域外代数值叫原方程无解。 新两组第4卡逐情境保代数解、原式检验和域，正分数长度、非负分数年龄、负温与零组可行，分数整包与负价格不行；具体舍入反例不得改原条件。J85直接题已补三个原条件。
rationale.en: J83’s (9/2,5/2) satisfies both equations but is allowed for continuous litres rather than integer tickets. J92’s exit has −2 passing the equation but failing positive lengths while one passes both; J85 distinguishes nonnegative continuous drainage from integer packs. All check original relations and context separately, without rounding into a false solution or confusing inadmissibility with no algebraic solution. New card fours retain algebraic roots, original checks and contextual domains: positive fractional lengths, nonnegative fractional ages, negative temperatures and zero groups are valid, while fractional packs and negative prices are not. Concrete rounding counterexamples retain the original givens. J85 now supplies its three original condition sets.

focus.zh: 点线射线、角与不变量
focus.en: Points, lines, rays, angles and invariants

rationale.zh: J93画AB四种对象及∠COD37°，J94画PQ及∠RST128°。两处都标端点、无限方向、射线反序与角中间顶点，解释点无大小、屏幕裁切非端点、同向延长和整体旋转保角，不只认名称。
rationale.en: J93 draws four AB objects and angle COD37°; J94 uses PQ and RST128°. Both label endpoints, infinite directions, reversed rays and middle-letter vertices, distinguishing geometric points from ink, clipping from endpoints and angle invariance under extension/rotation rather than merely naming objects.

focus.zh: 对顶、邻补与反例
focus.en: Vertical/adjacent supplementary angles and counterexamples

rationale.zh: J93从交角42°求138/42/138，J94从57°求123/57/123；都须画两条真直线与反向射线，由两个180°和同减共同角证明对顶相等，并给互补非邻接、相等非对顶反例。
rationale.en: J93 derives 138/42/138 from a 42° crossing and J94 123/57/123 from 57°. Both draw actual straight lines and opposite rays, prove vertical equality by subtracting a common angle from two 180° sums and give supplementary-nonadjacent and equal-nonvertical counterexamples.

focus.zh: 平行前提、角对与逆判
focus.en: Parallel premises, angle pairs and converse criteria

rationale.zh: 两组Q3具体定位上右θ、下右α、上左下β、上右下γ，分别从52°或68°核同位、内错、同旁内；删平行后只保同交点对顶/邻补，α不定；反向用指定同位相等判平行并说明不许循环。
rationale.en: Both Q3 tasks fix upper top-right θ, lower top-right α, upper bottom-left β and bottom-right γ, starting at 52° or 68°. They justify corresponding, alternate and same-side pairs, retain only local vertical/straight relations after removing parallelism and use the specified corresponding equality conversely without circular reasoning.

focus.zh: 辅助平行线与三角形内外角
focus.en: Auxiliary parallels and triangle interior/exterior angles

rationale.zh: J93由A48、B67推C65、外角115，J94由38、79推C63、外角117。两处强制过C作AB平行线，标内错角组成平角，再比较两个180°和推出外角，不能只代背出的内角和。
rationale.en: J93 derives C65° and exterior115° from A48°,B67°; J94 derives C63°,exterior117° from 38°,79°. Both construct through C a parallel to AB, identify alternate angles making a straight angle and compare two 180° sums for the exterior theorem, rather than merely substituting a memorised sum.

focus.zh: 严格存在条件与双重分类
focus.en: Strict existence and two classification axes

rationale.zh: J93固定4、7给3<c<11，J94固定5、9给4<c<14，都解释端点退化、核三条边不等式、给不等边例，并用45/45/90同时等腰直角及至少两边相等定义解释等边包含。先验存在而非给假三角形贴名称。
rationale.en: J93 derives 3<c<11 for fixed sides four/seven and J94 4<c<14 for five/nine. Both explain degenerate endpoints, check all inequalities, classify a scalene example and use 45/45/90 for simultaneous isosceles/right classifications and equilateral inclusion under the at-least-two-equal definition. Existence precedes classification.

focus.zh: 已知、辅助构造与完整理由链
focus.en: Givens, auxiliary constructions and linked reasons

rationale.zh: 两组Q3区分局部条件与缺失的平行前提、明确逆判不循环；Q4必须写辅助平行→内错角→平角→内角和→外角的完整链；Q5先排退化存在失败。J86进一步逐条列公共边、构造、全等判据及对应结论。实际生成论证，不把卡片顺序正确当自由证明完成。
rationale.en: Both Q3 tasks distinguish local facts from missing parallel premises and prevent circular converses. Q4 requires a full chain from auxiliary parallel through alternate and straight angles to the interior sum and exterior theorem, while Q5 excludes degenerate nonexistence first. J86 further enumerates common sides, constructions, congruence criteria and corresponding conclusions. These generate arguments rather than treating card order as completed free proof.

focus.zh: 有序坐标、象限与轴
focus.en: Ordered coordinates, quadrants and axes

rationale.zh: J93主动描P(−6,3/2)、Q(0,−1)，J94描P(−3/2,6)、Q(−1,0)，都说明x先y后、四象限符号、零坐标与原点不属象限，交换P两项变第四象限另点，改变视窗不改数据。
rationale.en: J93 plots P(−6,3/2),Q(0,−1); J94 plots P(−3/2,6),Q(−1,0). Both explain x-before-y, all quadrant signs, axis/origin exclusions, a distinct quadrant-IV point after swapping entries and unchanged data under window changes.

focus.zh: 按各轴刻度描点并投影读回
focus.en: Plotting by axis-specific scales and reading projections

rationale.zh: J93横格2纵格1/2，P须左3格上3格却坐标−6、3/2；J94横格1/2纵格2，同样格数却坐标−3/2、6。两处亲画投影读回及轴上Q，分格数、单位数与显示像素，不仅说出给定坐标。
rationale.en: J93 uses horizontal intervals two and vertical halves: three left/three up gives (−6,3/2). J94 reverses scales for (−3/2,6) with the same cell counts. Both explicitly draw, project back and plot an axis point, distinguishing cells, units and pixels rather than copying the supplied pair.

focus.zh: 同行配对、连线与输入域
focus.en: Paired rows, connections and input domains

rationale.zh: J93由完整水量规则生成(0,12)/(2.5,7)/(6,0)，J94由摄氏规则生成(0,−3)/(2,0)/(4,3)，都按同行点作图、给定连续规则才域内连线，整卡输入只画整数点。J88进一步解释分列排序毁掉记录配对、缺失不补零、无直线趋势不等于无关系。
rationale.en: J93 generates paired water rows (0,12),(2.5,7),(6,0); J94 temperature rows (0,−3),(2,0),(4,3). Both graph paired points, justify continuous connections only from supplied rules and restrict card counts to integer points. J88 further explains destroyed pairing after separate sorts, missing values not being zeros and no linear trend not meaning no relationship.

focus.zh: 变化率、截距与规则依据
focus.en: Rate, intercept and rule evidence

rationale.zh: J93解释V=12−2t的−2L/min和12L，J94解释T=−3+1.5t的1.5°C/h和−3°C，非零截距均非正比例；两处解释m=0常数在J75广义与J85一次约定中的区别，有限观测不能证明未给规则。J85另比较2x、2x+3、常数及x²。
rationale.en: J93 explains −2L/min and twelve litres in V=12−2t; J94 explains 1.5°C/h and −3°C in T=−3+1.5t. Nonzero intercepts prevent direct proportion. Both distinguish zero-slope constants under the J75 and J85 conventions and reject proving an unspecified rule from finite observations; J85 further contrasts 2x,2x+3,constants and x².

focus.zh: 现实变量的单位、范围与局部模型
focus.en: Units, domains and local contextual rules

rationale.zh: J93核水0至6min连续、排空后负量域外及卡片整数；J94核0至4h摄氏负读数有效与整卡离散。两处给率/初值单位、同一关系的显示变换与有限观测范围。J85核固定费/排空/整包，J98核只改宽与统一缩放各约束是否仍成立，不将代数可算当情境可用。
rationale.en: J93 checks continuous water time zero to six, negative amounts outside the domain and integer cards. J94 checks valid negative Celsius readings on zero-to-four hours versus discrete cards. Both retain rate/initial units, display-versus-rule changes and finite scope. J85 checks fixed fees, emptying and whole packs; J98 checks constraints under width-only versus uniform scaling, distinguishing algebraic outputs from admissibility.

focus.zh: 总体、抽样框、方法与单次样本
focus.en: Population, frame, method and one realised sample

rationale.zh: J97解释八张卡恰一半不能认证覆盖与每次代表；H27用目标均值2、固定选A/B均值0说明重复便利设计方差0仍有偏；H34明确一次误差0不同于设计期望无偏，并要求目标总体、抽样框、未响应和测量。复现方法、覆盖、样本波动与结论范围，不以大样本或一次接近认证代表性。
rationale.en: J97 explains why eight cards with exactly half successes do not certify coverage or every realised sample. H27 contrasts target mean two with fixed A/B mean zero: repeated zero-variance selection can stay biased. H34 separates one zero error from design-unbiased expectation and explicitly checks population, frame, nonresponse and measurement. These retrieve method, coverage, sampling variability and scope rather than certifying representativeness from size or one close result.

focus.zh: 中心、分散、形状与图示范围
focus.en: Centre, spread, shape and graphical scope

rationale.zh: J88在同中位5下比较极差A26>B10而IQR(A)=3/2<IQR(B)=7，必须指明指标、保尾值和共同数轴；H08以0,0,0,4,4,4对称却双峰反驳正态套用；H33说明组距改外观、有限频率和模型假设不同。不能把同中心、对称或好看图形当相同分布或普遍机制。
rationale.en: J88 compares equal medians five but range A26>B10 and IQR A3/2<B7, requiring named metrics, retained tails and a common axis. H08 uses symmetric yet bimodal 0,0,0,4,4,4 to refute an automatic normal assumption. H33 distinguishes bin-dependent appearance, finite frequencies and model conditions. Equal centres, symmetry or attractive graphs do not establish identical distributions or mechanisms.

focus.zh: 异常记录、摘要重算与保留
focus.en: Unusual records, recomputed summaries and retention

rationale.zh: J91核10改40后均值5到10、中位5，再独立改原尾0后中位3；J92核11改41后均值4到9、中位4，再独立改0后中位3/2、唯一众数0。两处保六条记录，说明核实异常不能为好看删除，中位数并非永不变；J88另核保30的极差/IQR指标差异。
rationale.en: J91 changes ten to forty for mean five→ten with median five, then separately changes the original tail to zero for median three. J92 changes eleven to forty-one for mean four→nine with median four, then separately to zero for median 3/2 and only mode zero. Both retain six records, reject deleting verified extremes for appearance and show the median can change. J88 further retains thirty while distinguishing range and IQR.

focus.zh: 编号基本结果与事件权重
focus.en: Numbered elementary outcomes and event weights

rationale.zh: J93树任务强制算3红2蓝放回25/不放回20编号有序对及颜色9/6/6/4与6/6/6/2权重；J94用2红1蓝得9/6对及4/2/2/1与2/2/2/0。两处不合并不同编号/先后、不把颜色名数当分母，J97/H24另核受限列举及硬币串等可能而计数类不等权。
rationale.en: J93 requires twenty-five/twenty numbered ordered pairs with colour weights 9,6,6,4 versus 6,6,6,2 for three red/two blue. J94 uses nine/six pairs with 4,2,2,1 versus 2,2,2,0 for two red/one blue. Both retain identity/order and reject category-count denominators. J97/H24 further check constrained enumeration and equiprobable coin strings versus unequally weighted head-count classes.

focus.zh: 条件分支、路径与试验重置
focus.en: Conditional branches, paths and trial resets

rationale.zh: 两组Q8必须亲画放回/不放回两棵树、逐支写条件分母、沿路乘、互斥路相加核1；J93不放回RR3/10而非9/25，J94抽唯一蓝后BB0不属可发生空间。都区分编号路径与颜色合并，轮内移走、轮间恢复及有限记录不保证补偿。
rationale.en: Both Q8 tasks explicitly draw replacement/no-replacement trees, label conditional denominators, multiply along paths and add disjoint paths to one. J93 obtains no-replacement RR3/10 rather than 9/25; J94 excludes BB after the only blue ball is removed. Both distinguish numbered paths from colour groups, remove within rounds, restore between rounds and reject compensation guarantees.

focus.zh: 单项式的系数与重复因子
focus.en: Monomial coefficients and repeated factors

rationale.zh: J95由(−3x²y)(2xy²)逐因子数出−6x³y³；J96由(−2ab²)(5a²b)数出−10a³b³。两处解释每个字母次数、系数符号，区分乘法加指数与不同次数相加，明确零变量可代且未除变量。
rationale.en: J95 counts repeated factors in (−3x²y)(2xy²) for −6x³y³; J96 uses (−2ab²)(5a²b) for −10a³b³. Both justify every exponent and sign, distinguish product exponents from adding unlike terms and retain zero variables because no variable division occurred.

focus.zh: 单项式覆盖括号每项
focus.en: A monomial reaches every bracket term

rationale.zh: Q1两组把外部单项式分别乘括号两项，得−6x³y³+12x³y或−10a³b³+6a²b²，原字母因子不丢。Q2同时强制正长度面积块对应及负赋值只作代数检查，复现分配的全项覆盖和图形范围，不画负小边。
rationale.en: Both Q1 tasks multiply the outside monomial into every term for −6x³y³+12x³y or −10a³b³+6a²b², retaining letter factors. Q2 further requires positive-length area pieces and purely algebraic checks for negative assignments, retrieving complete distribution and diagram bounds without negative sublengths.

focus.zh: 四对乘积与交叉项
focus.en: All four products and cross terms

rationale.zh: J95完整展开(2x+3)(x+4)=2x²+11x+12，J96展开(3t+2)(t+5)=3t²+17t+10，均须画四块、保两交叉项并核负1赋值时图的正长条件不适用但代数仍有效。不是只背系数或凭几次代入证明恒等。
rationale.en: J95 fully expands (2x+3)(x+4)=2x²+11x+12; J96 expands (3t+2)(t+5)=3t²+17t+10. Both draw four pieces, retain both cross terms and check negative-one assignments outside positive-length picture bounds while preserving algebra. Coefficients are derived, not memorised or inferred from finite trials.

focus.zh: 平方交叉项与重扣角块
focus.en: Square cross terms and doubly removed corners

rationale.zh: J95推(x−4)²=x²−8x+16，J96推(t−5)²=t²−10t+25，均用四对乘积和两条带重扣角块后补一次的图解释。零处漏中项式巧合不证明，分别代1或2给9与17/29反例，图域与代数全实域分开。
rationale.en: J95 derives (x−4)²=x²−8x+16 and J96 (t−5)²=t²−10t+25 using four products and strips with the corner restored once. Coincidence at zero does not validate a missing cross term: inputs one or two give nine versus seventeen/twenty-nine. Both separate picture bounds from the real algebraic domain.

focus.zh: 共轭交叉项相消与重排
focus.en: Conjugate cross-term cancellation and rearrangement

rationale.zh: Q4两组先列A²−AB+AB−B²，明确与差平方−2AB不同；再画去3²或4²角后两块刚性重排成长方形，解释每块面积保留与正长范围，边界代数零仍有效。不是只引用平方差名称。
rationale.en: Both Q4 tasks list A²−AB+AB−B² and contrast the −2AB in a square. They then draw rigid two-piece rearrangements after removing a 3² or 4² corner, retaining piece areas and positive-length bounds while accepting algebraic zero at the boundary, rather than merely citing a difference-of-squares name.

focus.zh: 整数公因数与共同最低次数
focus.en: Integer common factors and minimum shared exponents

rationale.zh: J95把12x³+18x²提6x²(2x+3)，J96把20t³−30t²提10t²(2t−3)。都解释系数最大公因数、字母最低次数，比较只提一半系数未完成与多提一次方出现变量分母，乘回及零赋值不因恒等分解被排。
rationale.en: J95 factors 12x³+18x² as 6x²(2x+3); J96 factors 20t³−30t² as 10t²(2t−3). Both justify numerical GCF and minimum exponent, contrast unfinished smaller coefficients with overfactoring into variable denominators, expand back and retain zero assignments in identities.

focus.zh: 反复检查平方差直到完成
focus.en: Rechecking difference-of-squares factors to completion

rationale.zh: J95将x⁴−81继续分成(x−3)(x+3)(x²+9)，J96将t⁴−256分成(t−4)(t+4)(t²+16)。均强制检查每个因式、声明整数范围保留平方和、完整乘回，并区分代数有效与去角图的正边条件。
rationale.en: J95 continues x⁴−81 to (x−3)(x+3)(x²+9); J96 continues t⁴−256 to (t−4)(t+4)(t²+16). Both recheck every factor, retain the sum of squares within integer coefficients, multiply all factors back and distinguish algebraic validity from positive-side diagram conditions.

focus.zh: 提公因数后核完整平方模式
focus.en: Checking full square patterns after common factors

rationale.zh: J95由3x²−18x+27提3再核成3(x−3)²，J96由2t²+20t+50提2再核2(t+5)²；两处逐项核中项双积及符号，拒绝只两端平方的错式，指出未把内部共同整数提外的形式仍未完成。
rationale.en: J95 removes three from 3x²−18x+27 before obtaining 3(x−3)²; J96 removes two before 2(t+5)². Both check the signed double product, reject end-squares-only claims and identify unfinished forms retaining a common integer inside a factor.

focus.zh: 整数配对的积与和及数域
focus.en: Integer factor-pair product/sum and number domain

rationale.zh: J95从和−1积−12筛−4与3，J96从和1积−20筛5与−4，均由完整展开给两条件、乘回、零常数先提变量。x²−2或t²−3无整数配对却有带√2/√3的实数因式，明确限定整数一次目标而不泛称不可分。
rationale.en: J95 filters −4,3 by sum −1/product −12; J96 filters 5,−4 by sum one/product −20. Both derive both conditions by expansion, multiply back and factor the variable first for zero constants. Although x²−2 and t²−3 have no integer pairs, real factors involving √2/√3 exist, making the integer-linear target explicit rather than universal nonfactorability.

focus.zh: 反例、完整展开与完成形式
focus.en: Counterexamples, full expansion and finished form

rationale.zh: J95检查(x+1)(x+12)与x²+7x+12在0相同而1处26/20不同；J96检查(t−1)(t−20)与t²−9t+20在0相同、1处0/12不同。都完整展开核中项、给正确因式，并完成5(x²−16)或4(t²−25)，不以一次吻合或根列表替代乘积。
rationale.en: J95 finds agreement at zero but twenty-six versus twenty at one for a proposed product; J96 finds agreement at zero but zero versus twelve at one. Both fully expand cross terms, supply correct factors and finish 5(x²−16) or 4(t²−25), rejecting single-match evidence or replacing a product with root lists.

focus.zh: 同一数对同时核原关系
focus.en: The same ordered pair must satisfy both originals

rationale.zh: J95同对(7,2)核数量9与金额41，J96同对(3/2,19/2)核11L与47元；各有只保总量而违原价的伪解。Q10再区分唯一、无解、重合无限沿线与竖直/水平交点，两个方程不是自动独立。
rationale.en: J95 checks pair (7,2) against count nine and cost forty-one; J96 checks (3/2,19/2) against eleven litres and forty-seven. Each includes a spurious pair passing only retained totals. Q10 then distinguishes unique, none, coincident-line infinity and vertical/horizontal intersections; two equations are not automatically independent.

focus.zh: 整段代入、回代与剩余限制
focus.en: Whole-expression substitution, back-substitution and retained constraints

rationale.zh: J95将y=9−x整段替入3y，J96将y=11−x替入4y，各保完整括号、求x再回y并核两原式。Q9零倍替换及Q10同线说明重复条件只剩一条线，不是所有数对，防止把0=0当成丢掉其他原式的理由。
rationale.en: J95 substitutes the entire y=9−x into 3y and J96 y=11−x into 4y, retaining brackets, solving x, recovering y and checking both originals. Q9’s zero replacement and Q10’s coincident lines retain a line constraint rather than all pairs, preventing 0=0 from discarding other originals.

focus.zh: 保留原行与非零自系数替换
focus.en: Retained rows and nonzero self-coefficient replacement

rationale.zh: J95保总量行、金额行减3倍它得2x=14；J96保总量行、金额行减4倍它得2x=3。两处必须用另一保留行恢复y，并给零倍自身替换后(9,0)或(11,0)过新组却原价45≠41或66≠47的反例，说明可逆所需自身系数非零。
rationale.en: J95 retains the total row and subtracts three copies from cost for 2x=14; J96 subtracts four for 2x=3. Both recover y using the retained row and show zero-self-coefficient replacements admit (9,0) or (11,0), contradicting original costs forty-five versus forty-one or sixty-six versus forty-seven. Reversibility needs a nonzero coefficient on the replaced row itself.

focus.zh: 直线交集、精确点与图窗
focus.en: Line intersections, exact points and windows

rationale.zh: J95四系统分别(3/2,3/2)、整条x+y=3、无解、(2,−1)；J96分别(7/2,3/2)、整条x+y=5、无解、(−1,2)。都亲画线并原式核，完整有序点不舍入、同线非全平面、竖直线有效、有限图窗不裁原实数解域。
rationale.en: J95’s four systems give (3/2,3/2), the full line x+y=3, no solution and (2,−1); J96 gives (7/2,3/2), the full line x+y=5, none and (−1,2). Both draw and check originals, retain exact ordered points, exclude the whole plane for coincident lines, accept vertical lines and distinguish display windows from real solution domains.

focus.zh: 数量与金额两条原模型及允许性
focus.en: Two original quantity/cost models and admissibility

rationale.zh: J95从9整件、单价5/3与总41生成x+y=9、5x+3y=41，改价40时精确分数对不允许取整修复；J96从11L、单价6/4与47生成x+y=11、6x+4y=47，分数升允许但整件解释不允许。两处先定义变量/单位/域，写原数量两侧后求解核验，不只交最终数对。
rationale.en: J95 generates x+y=9 and 5x+3y=41 from nine whole items and prices five/three, then rejects rounding a fractional pair after price forty. J96 generates x+y=11 and 6x+4y=47 from litres and prices six/four, admitting fractional litres but not whole-item reinterpretations. Both define variables, units and domains and generate original quantity relations before solving, rather than submitting only a pair.

focus.zh: 实数解集的方向与端点
focus.en: Real solution sets: direction and endpoints

rationale.zh: H01从错图重画x≤5/2的实心向左并核9/4、边界与3；H02重画x>−7/3的空心向右并通分核−9/4、边界与−5/2。均说明有限整数列表不能代表包括非整数的完整实数集合。
rationale.en: H01 corrects a diagram to closed left shading for x≤5/2 and checks 9/4, the boundary and three. H02 corrects x>−7/3 to open right shading and checks −9/4, the boundary and −5/2 by common denominators. Both distinguish finite integer samples from full real sets including nonintegers.

focus.zh: 正数缩放与完整集合
focus.en: Positive scaling and the full solution set

rationale.zh: 两组分别同乘正倒数2/5与4/3得x≥−6/5及x<−8/3，必须说明正缩放保序、原式代数核一解一非解与边界包含性，再画完整集合，不能只写边界数或看右侧负号翻转。
rationale.en: The tasks multiply by positive reciprocals 2/5 and 4/3 for x≥−6/5 and x<−8/3. They require positive order preservation, original checks of a member/nonmember and boundary inclusion, then the full set rather than a boundary number or reversal based on a negative right side.

focus.zh: 负数反射与未知符号分支
focus.en: Negative reflection and unknown-sign cases

rationale.zh: H01算(−3/2)(−4)=6与2(−4)=−8，H02算(−2)(−3)=6与(5/2)(−3)=−15/2；均从数轴反射解释反序，分类未知k正/负/零且保留≤中的等号，零缩放丢信息不能作等价逆步。
rationale.en: H01 compares products six and negative eight; H02 compares six and −15/2. Both explain reversal by number-line reflection, classify unknown k as positive/negative/zero, retain equality inclusion and identify zero scaling as information loss rather than a reversible equivalence.

focus.zh: 完整分子与带符号逆操作
focus.en: Whole numerators and signed inverse operations

rationale.zh: H01解(x−2)/3≥(x+1)/2得x≤−7；H02解(x+3)/4>(2x−1)/3得x<13/5。均标正公分母不翻转、全括号分配、负系数除法翻转，核原式解/非解/边界并画完整实数解集。
rationale.en: H01 solves (x−2)/3≥(x+1)/2 for x≤−7; H02 solves (x+3)/4>(2x−1)/3 for x<13/5. Both label positive denominator clearing, full-bracket distribution and negative division reversal, then check members, nonmembers and boundaries in the originals and draw full real sets.

focus.zh: 交集、单点、空集与数量域
focus.en: Intersection, singleton, empty set and quantity domain

rationale.zh: 两组在3/2或−2处比较闭闭单点与严格/闭端空集；预算2n+1≤8或3n+2≤12与非负求交，再区别可分升数上界7/2或10/3与整袋{0,1,2,3}。进4袋分别花9或14超预算，必须核全部条件而非并集或舍入边界。
rationale.en: Both compare a closed singleton at 3/2 or −2 with an empty strict/closed intersection. Budgets 2n+1≤8 and 3n+2≤12 intersect nonnegativity, then distinguish divisible-litre maxima 7/2 or 10/3 from whole bags {0,1,2,3}. Four bags cost nine or fourteen, exceeding budget; every condition is checked rather than unioning or rounding boundaries.

focus.zh: 规则参数、可变输入与单次输出
focus.en: Rule parameters, variable input and single output

rationale.zh: H01从给定仿射水量点求m=3L/min、b=1L与x4输出13L；H02温度点求m=−3°C/h、b=11°C与x2输出5°C。均区分固定参数/改输入/改规则，解释初值不是一次输出；m0常函数不归J85严格一次，题设给仿射性不是两观察证明。
rationale.en: H01 derives m=3 L/min,b=1 L and thirteen litres at input four; H02 derives m=−3°C/h,b=11°C and five degrees at two. Both distinguish fixed parameters, changed input and changed rules, and initial value from one output. Zero slope is constant outside J85 strict first degree; affine behaviour is given, not proved by two observations.

focus.zh: 同向差商及坐标单位
focus.en: Consistent directed differences and coordinate units

rationale.zh: 两组分别计算9/3=3L/min与−6/2=−3°C/h，反向同时变两差符号率不变，只反分母错误变号。必须写输出/输入单位并区分坐标变化率与不等轴比例的屏幕倾角，不能只背差商式。
rationale.en: The two tasks calculate 9/3=3 L/min and −6/2=−3°C/h. Reversing both differences leaves the rate unchanged, while reversing only the denominator wrongly changes its sign. They require output/input units and distinguish coordinate rate from screen angle under unequal axis scales.

focus.zh: 参数值、轴交点与受限域
focus.en: Parameter value, axis crossings and restricted domain

rationale.zh: H01的2x−5域[1,4]与H02的−3x+8域[1,3]要求区分b数值−5或8、域外延长点(0,−5)/(0,8)与实际x轴交点(5/2,0)/(8/3,0)，亲画闭线段。零输入不在域，不能宣称有实际y轴交点或记录过初值。
rationale.en: H01 restricts 2x−5 to [1,4] and H02 restricts −3x+8 to [1,3]. They distinguish numerical b values −5/eight, extension points (0,−5)/(0,8) and actual x-axis crossings (5/2,0)/(8/3,0), drawing closed segments. Zero is outside the domain, so no actual y-axis crossing or observed initial value may be claimed.

focus.zh: 两点独立性与仿射模型假设
focus.en: Independent point conditions and the affine assumption

rationale.zh: H01不同输入给常函数4，H02给2x+4；两组另有同输入不同输出的竖直线及重复一点的无限规则。学习者须给重复点两个不同规则并核回，不把Δx0一概判无解，也不把两观测拟合证明全域直线；候选类明含零斜率。
rationale.en: Distinct inputs give constant four in H01 and 2x+4 in H02. Each also includes a vertical pair and a repeated point allowing infinitely many rules. Learners supply and check two distinct repeated-point rules, distinguish zero-input-difference cases and avoid claiming that fitting observations proves global linearity; the candidate class explicitly permits zero slope.

focus.zh: 固定率、比值与过原点的区别
focus.en: Constant rate, ratio and origin crossing

rationale.zh: H01分类3x、3x+2、7、x²、0，H02分类−2x、−2x+5、−4、x²、0；按k/m非零约定说明常数与零例外，正输入1和2核非恒比，0/0不定义。负k仍可正比例；过原点或固定率各自不足，完整式才支持一般分类。
rationale.en: H01 classifies 3x,3x+2,7,x²,0; H02 uses −2x,−2x+5,−4,x²,0. Both apply nonzero k/m conventions, calculate ratios at positive inputs one/two and reject 0/0. Negative k may still be direct proportion. Origin crossing and fixed rate alone are insufficient; complete formulas support general classification.

focus.zh: 有界连续、排空分段与整包输入
focus.en: Bounded continuous, stopped-water and whole-pack domains

rationale.zh: 两组各比较已启动接送的率/固定费、有界排水后另停为0、整包卡片仅离散输入，核所有端点和域外输出。半包分别给3或5整数张仍输入不许，是比原半张输出更强的输入域反例；明确单位、模型题设与外推范围，不从输出整数倒推输入合法。
rationale.en: Each group compares activated-transport rates/fixed fees, bounded draining followed by a separate zero rule and whole-pack card inputs as discrete points. They check endpoints and outside outputs. Half packs give integer three or five cards but remain inadmissible inputs, a stronger domain example than fractional output alone. Units, given assumptions and extrapolation bounds are explicit; integer outputs cannot validate inputs.

focus.zh: 全等顺序与刚性运动
focus.en: Ordered congruence and rigid motions

rationale.zh: H05按ABC≅DFE生成3/4/5对应边，H06生成5/12/13对应边，均逐一列顶点边角，不随反射旋转改点名；保长保角与朝向分别讨论，非一倍缩放不保全等。
rationale.en: H05 generates corresponding lengths three/four/five and H06 five/twelve/thirteen from ABC≅DFE. Both list vertices, sides and angles without renaming after reflection/rotation, distinguish length/angle preservation from orientation and reject nonunit scaling as congruence.

focus.zh: 对应充分条件与SSA反例
focus.en: Corresponding sufficient conditions and SSA counterexamples

rationale.zh: 两组写SSS/SAS充分清单，指定AB/BC夹角B；SSA分别固定AB6/BC4与AB10/BC6、A30°，由距离得AC=3√3±√7或5√3±√11，两正非退化值证一般不足，不否定有额外前提的特殊情形。
rationale.en: Both write corresponding SSS/SAS evidence and locate the included angle of AB/BC at B. For A=30°, lengths AB6/BC4 or AB10/BC6 yield AC=3√3±√7 or 5√3±√11. Two positive nondegenerate possibilities disprove general SSA sufficiency without denying special cases with extra premises.

focus.zh: 两角一边的身份与尺度
focus.en: Angle-side identity and scale

rationale.zh: H05/H06在各自两三角形图上生成ASA及AAS充分清单，说明边是否夹在所列两角之间，用180减两角补第三角支持有效互换；用AAA可任意放大说明角不能固定大小，与同题SSS/SAS和SSA的适用性分开。
rationale.en: H05/H06 generate ASA/AAS evidence on their own triangle diagrams, identify whether the side is included between the listed angles and derive the third by subtraction from 180° to justify another valid list. Enlargement under AAA exposes missing size information, separate from the SSS/SAS and SSA cases.

focus.zh: 等腰性质与逆向证明
focus.en: Isosceles properties and converse proofs

rationale.zh: 两组由等腰及顶角40/70、角平分线和公共AD用SAS证明底角及底边平分，底角70/55；逆向只给底角相等则改AAS证明腰等，必须列不同已知，不先借待证性质或图形对称。
rationale.en: Both use equal legs, apex forty/seventy, a constructed bisector and common AD for SAS, deriving equal base angles seventy/fifty-five and bisected base. The converse starts only with equal base angles and uses AAS for equal legs, requiring a different premise list without borrowing the goal or visual symmetry.

focus.zh: 定义性质与完整逆判
focus.en: Definitions, properties and complete converse tests

rationale.zh: H05/H06分别用底6/4与8/4的坐标等腰梯形算AD²=BC²为5/13，反驳一组平行加另一组相等。两处辨两组平行定义、各性质及三类完整逆判，强调同一组平行且等和两对角线互相平分，不能只取半条件。
rationale.en: H05/H06 calculate isosceles-trapezium examples with bases six/four or eight/four and equal leg squares five/thirteen. They refute mixing a parallel pair with a different equal pair, distinguish definitions and properties from three full converse tests and require the same parallel/equal pair and mutual diagonal bisection.

focus.zh: 自由证明的依赖与非循环
focus.en: Free-proof dependencies without circularity

rationale.zh: 两组仅从AB∥CD、BC∥AD画AC，逐行给BAC=DCA、BCA=DAC的内错角依据、AC公共、ASA的ABC≅CDA与AB=CD，明确顺序。另指出借AB=CD证明自身的SSS句循环且证据未足，卡片合法顺序不替代自己生成完整证明。
rationale.en: Both start only from opposite parallel sides, draw AC and generate alternate-angle reasons, common AC, ordered ASA congruence ABC≅CDA and AB=CD. They expose a proposed SSS sentence as circular and incomplete and explicitly distinguish valid card order from producing a free proof.

focus.zh: 共同平移与非原点轴反射
focus.en: Common translation and nonorigin-axis reflection

rationale.zh: H05三点同移(−3,2)及另从原图反射x1，H06同移(2,−3)及反射y−2。亲算三像点、PQ差向量/√20长度，点像中点落轴及轴上固定；叉积10变−10或6变−6辨反向，反射规则2−x或−4−y不套原点轴。
rationale.en: H05 translates three points by (−3,2) and separately reflects the original in x=1; H06 uses (2,−3) and y=−2. Both calculate image points, displacement and √20 length, midpoint-on-axis and fixed-axis conditions. Determinants change ten to negative ten or six to negative six, retrieving orientation reversal and correct nonorigin-axis formulas.

focus.zh: 减中心旋转加中心与半转
focus.en: Subtract, rotate, add centre and half-turns

rationale.zh: H05以O(1,2)、P(4,3)逆90°得(0,5)，H06以O(−2,1)、P(1,3)顺90°得(0,−2)，都强制先减中心、转相对位移再加中心，核√10/√13距离；另算半转及二次回原位置，解释2O−P和运动转角不加内角。
rationale.en: H05 rotates P(4,3) anticlockwise about O(1,2) to (0,5); H06 rotates P(1,3) clockwise about O(−2,1) to (0,−2). Both subtract the centre, rotate displacement, add it back and check √10/√13 radius. Separate half-turn calculations return to the original after two turns, explaining 2O−P and why motion angle does not increase interior angles.

focus.zh: 同外框减同四块的一般证明
focus.en: General equal-frame minus equal-pieces proof

rationale.zh: 两组实际画两种四块重排，给中央c正方形角依据及无叠缺，(a+b)²−2ab一般推a²+b²=c²；H05代5/12核289−120=169取13，H06代8/15核529−240=289取17，数值只是核例，面积不作边长。
rationale.en: Both draw two four-piece rearrangements, justify central-square angles and no overlap/gaps, and derive a²+b²=c² generally from (a+b)²−2ab. H05 checks 289−120=169 with length thirteen; H06 checks 529−240=289 with length seventeen. Numbers check examples rather than prove generality, and area is not length.

focus.zh: 已知直角、精确长度与单位
focus.en: Given right angles, exact lengths and units

rationale.zh: H05矩形3cm/50mm先化3/5cm得√34cm，H06的40mm/7cm化4/7cm得√65cm；另由斜边13腿5或斜边17腿8减平方得12/15。须给直角依据、平方cm²/开方cm与正根，不能减长度或用图猜直角。
rationale.en: H05 converts rectangle sides three cm/fifty mm to three/five cm for √34 cm; H06 converts forty mm/seven cm to four/seven cm for √65 cm. Separate given hypotenuse/leg pairs thirteen/five or seventeen/eight yield twelve/fifteen by subtracting squares. Both require right-angle premises, square/root units and positive length, not subtracting lengths or guessing angles.

focus.zh: 先存在、后最长边与逆推
focus.en: Existence before longest-side converse reasoning

rationale.zh: H05/H06各先审四组无序正长与严格三角不等式，分别由5/12/13、8/15/17的平方相等及另构直角/SSS证明逆定理；退化1/2/3或2/3/5不分类。另用有效锐钝三元组说明不等只先否定直角，角分类还需固定两边夹角/对边比较性质。
rationale.en: Each audits four unordered triples for positivity and strict existence. The 5/12/13 or 8/15/17 case uses exact squares, a constructed right triangle and SSS for the converse. Degenerate 1/2/3 or 2/3/5 is not angle-classified. Further valid acute/obtuse triples show that unequal squares first exclude right angles; classification also needs the fixed-two-sides angle/opposite-side comparison property.

focus.zh: 四分位约定、重复与须线
focus.en: Quartile conventions, repeats and whiskers

rationale.zh: H08/H27各对五项按奇数排除/包含中位数算不同四分位，再对九项保负号与重复，分别画最小最大版和1.5IQR须线版。须端是围栏内实际观测，30/31另标异常候选，围栏不当须端或删值令；箱段宽不是人数比例。
rationale.en: Each task calculates different quartiles under odd-sample exclusion/inclusion, then retains negative/repeated values in nine-item minimum/maximum and 1.5IQR whisker plots. Whiskers reach actual in-fence observations; thirty/thirty-one are marked separately. Fences are not endpoints or deletion orders, and box-segment widths are not headcounts.

focus.zh: 指标限定与IQR非绝对免疫
focus.en: Measure-qualified spread and nonimmune IQR

rationale.zh: 两处原九项A/B同中位5/6，原极差6/10、IQR2/8；A尾值改30/41后极差29/39而IQR2，说明全跨度与中部可相反。从原A独立重设同尾值0，重排后IQR3，反驳永不受影响；保全部已核记录与同轴同单位，不删出想要的结论。
rationale.en: Both nine-item A/B pairs share median five/six, with original ranges six/ten and IQRs two/eight. Changing A’s tail to thirty/forty-one yields range twenty-nine/thirty-nine but IQR two, separating total and middle spread. Independently resetting the original tail to zero changes IQR to three, disproving immunity. All verified records remain, with common axes and units rather than deletion to preference.

focus.zh: 完整配对、缺失与非线性形状
focus.en: Complete pairs, missingness and nonlinear shape

rationale.zh: 两组各保五ID数对画U形散点，另有缺失y的ID6只排该项成对分析不造0。分列排序会造原来不存在的(0,0)或(−2,1)，须自己给反例；编号不当路径连接，中心交积和0仍有U形，不误称无关系、独立、总体形状或因果结论。
rationale.en: Each plots five ID-preserved U-shaped pairs and excludes a missing-y sixth ID only from that paired analysis without zero imputation. Separate sorting invents absent pairs (0,0) or (−2,1), which learners identify. IDs are not a path. Zero centred cross-product sum coexists with a U shape, not proving no relationship, independence, population shape or causation.

focus.zh: 混杂、观察与改进设计
focus.en: Confounding, observation and improved design

rationale.zh: H08/H27飞行资料分别给A60cm/B80cm释放且未随机分配，要求指出高度混杂、更多点/更直趋势/按高度分组不自动证明因果或排尽混杂。下一轮固定条件、随机分配折法、重复记录；区别总体随机抽样和处理随机分配，参与材料因果不自动普推。
rationale.en: Both flight datasets give unequal release heights A60/B80 cm without random allocation. Learners identify height confounding and explain why more points, straighter trends or height grouping do not automatically establish causation or remove every confounder. They improve conditions, allocation and repeated records while distinguishing random sampling for population scope from random treatment allocation and avoiding automatic generalisation.

focus.zh: 相连PPDAC、可追溯清理与有限结论
focus.en: Connected PPDAC, traceable cleaning and bounded conclusions

rationale.zh: 两处从带单位ID表写完整PPDAC：40/50mm转4/5cm留痕，缺A6不补0，只并已核同次重复B3而保不同ID同值。有效A5/B6，排除法中位4/5或5/6、IQR4/2，报告本批B中位较大、中部较窄，列不能回答的因果/总体问题及后续设计，而非只写缩写或导出当通过。
rationale.en: Each writes connected PPDAC from an ID/unit table: logged conversion of forty/fifty mm to four/five cm, no zero for missing A6, merging only the confirmed same-occasion B3 duplicate while retaining equal values under different IDs. Effective n is five/six; exclusion medians are four/five or five/six and IQRs four/two. Reports bound conclusions to this batch, name unanswerable causal/population questions and improve design rather than only listing initials or treating export as approval.

focus.zh: 所有平方根与非负主根
focus.en: All square roots versus principal root

rationale.zh: 两组分别列16/25、0、负16/25的实数根集，区分√a与外负号；a−4/−5具体给√(a²)=|a|，无实值不当0也不悄改数域。
rationale.en: Both list real roots for sixteen/twenty-five, zero and the negative value, separating the principal-root symbol from an external minus. Inputs −4/−5 demonstrate √(a²)=|a|. No real value is neither zero nor a silent change of number domain.

focus.zh: 有理反例、无理证明与数轴
focus.en: Rational counterexamples, irrational proof and real line

rationale.zh: 两处把√9、√(1/4)、循环小数写整数比，再用最简分数同整除反证√2/√3无理；亲用直角斜边构数轴点，区分精确数与像素，有限小数前缀不证无理。
rationale.en: Both express √9,√(1/4) and a recurring decimal as integer ratios, then prove √2/√3 irrational by forced common divisors of a reduced fraction. Right-triangle construction locates the positive real point while distinguishing exact values from pixels and finite displays from irrationality proofs.

focus.zh: 平方块、绝对值与外负号
focus.en: Square pieces, absolute value and external minus

rationale.zh: H03化√72−√8为4√2、−√75为−5√3，以四块3面积解释2√3；H04化√108−√12为4√3、−√50为−5√2，以九块2面积解释3√2。均用负a核|a|√b并保持外负号与面积/边长区别，完成共轭有理化。
rationale.en: H03 simplifies √72−√8 to 4√2 and −√75 to −5√3, using four area-three pieces for 2√3. H04 uses √108−√12=4√3 and −√50=−5√2, with nine area-two pieces for 3√2. Both check negative a in |a|√b, retain external signs, separate area from length and complete conjugate rationalisation.

focus.zh: 每个根式及非零分母条件
focus.en: Each radical’s domain and nonzero denominators

rationale.zh: 两组根式乘需各被开方数非负，商分母严格正；√1+√1反例否定直接合加，√(−1)不可先合积绕实数域。分别有理化1/(√3+√2)与1/(√5−2)，说明上下同乘及因子、原分母非零并乘回1。
rationale.en: Both require nonnegative radicands for products and a strictly positive denominator radicand for quotients, refute merged addition with √1+√1 and reject bypassing undefined real √(−1). They rationalise 1/(√3+√2) or 1/(√5−2), checking shared multiplication, nonzero factors/original denominator and product back to one.

focus.zh: 平方夹界、中点舍入与精确性
focus.en: Squared brackets, midpoint rounding and exactness

rationale.zh: H03以整数平方夹√2于1.41/1.42，H04夹√3于1.73/1.74，再平方中点决定两位。另√50/√15一位舍入7.1/3.9不同截断7.0/3.8；保1.00格式尾零，√(25/16)=1.25精确与无理近似分开，给误差界及非负前提。
rationale.en: H03 brackets √2 by 1.41/1.42 and H04 √3 by 1.73/1.74 using integer squares, then squares midpoints to round. Additional √50/√15 rounds to 7.1/3.9 rather than truncated 7.0/3.8. Both retain 1.00 precision, distinguish exact √(25/16)=1.25 from irrational approximations and state error bounds/nonnegative premises.

focus.zh: 左减右零点与实际次数
focus.en: Left-minus-right zeros and actual degree

rationale.zh: 两组逐实数说明左=右等价差0、零点为输入，合并表面二次项后3=0/−4=0无解、0=0全实数，区别非零常数次数0和零多项式无最高非零项，不凭出现x²判二次。
rationale.en: Both explain pointwise equivalence of equal sides and zero difference, with zeros as inputs. Apparent square terms cancel to impossible 3=0/−4=0 or all-real 0=0. Nonzero constants have degree zero; the zero polynomial has no highest nonzero term. An x² appearance does not determine degree.

focus.zh: 零因子完整分支与非零除法
focus.en: Complete zero-factor branches and nonzero division

rationale.zh: H03纠正x(x−5)=0除x漏0，完整{0,5}；H04纠正x(x+4)=0，完整{−4,0}。各代原式并用零乘积说明穷尽，若相除须先单列x0分支，非只列几次代入吻合。
rationale.en: H03 corrects division by x in x(x−5)=0 for complete set {0,5}; H04 uses x(x+4)=0 for {−4,0}. Both check originals and justify exhaustive zero-product branches; division requires a separate zero case rather than relying on finite successful trials.

focus.zh: 带符号配方与图外代数解
focus.en: Signed completing squares and roots outside pictures

rationale.zh: H03解x²+8x=9同加16得{−9,1}，H04解x²−6x=7同加9得{−1,7}。画正长度面积块但明确不添原实数域限制，负解代回；以带符号半系数平方补齐，不画负宽正面积。
rationale.en: H03 adds sixteen to x²+8x=9 for roots {−9,1}; H04 adds nine to x²−6x=7 for {−1,7}. Both draw positive-length area pieces without importing picture restrictions into the real equation, check negative roots and use the signed half-coefficient square rather than negative geometric widths.

focus.zh: 配方推公式与负a分支交换
focus.en: Formula derivation and negative-a branch exchange

rationale.zh: 两处从非零a逐步除a、移常数、同加(b/2a)²得到Δ/(4a²)，√(4a²)=2|a|后解释负a只交换±完整集，核−2x²+4x+6或−3x²−6x+9两根；不声称|a|=a，保Δ负/零与a0限制。
rationale.en: Both derive the formula through division by nonzero a, moving the constant and adding (b/2a)². After √(4a²)=2|a|, negative a only exchanges the complete ± branches, checked with −2x²+4x+6 or −3x²−6x+9. They do not assert |a|=a and retain negative/zero Δ and a=0 restrictions.

focus.zh: 不同实根数、窗外与降次
focus.en: Distinct real-root counts, off-window roots and degree loss

rationale.zh: H03用9/11窗外两根、重根3、无实根x²+4，H04用−7/−10、重根−4、x²+9，按Δ正/零/负解释不同根数。a0时改审一次/恒等/矛盾，不凭b²正推两根，视窗[−4,4]不能定全实域。
rationale.en: H03 uses off-window roots nine/eleven, repeated three and x²+4 with none; H04 uses −7/−10, repeated −4 and x²+9. Both connect distinct counts to Δ signs and separately classify a=0 as linear/identity/impossible, without treating positive b² or a [−4,4] window as a full-domain root count.

focus.zh: 原卡数来源与实根后的整数域
focus.en: Original card quantities and integer feasibility after real roots

rationale.zh: 两组分别画两/三方阵与总7/8张，保2x²=7或3x²=8原数量等式，解±√14/2或±2√6/3再交非负整数，无可行方案却非无实根。输入取1和2时数量分别为2与8或3与12均不合，舍入不能修复原模型。
rationale.en: Both draw two/three square arrays and totals seven/eight, retaining 2x²=7 or 3x²=8 as original quantity equations. Candidates ±√14/2 or ±2√6/3 intersect no nonnegative integers: infeasible arrays despite real roots. Inputs one/two give counts two/eight or three/twelve, so rounding cannot repair the model.

focus.zh: 平方非负、开口与非恒斜率
focus.en: Nonnegative squares, opening and nonconstant rate

rationale.zh: 两处2(x−3)²−2与−3(x+2)²+5用平方≥0推开口和值域，单位输入变化2/6或−3/−9证明a不是固定斜率；a0退常数，不能保唯一顶点或二次身份。
rationale.en: Both use nonnegative squares in 2(x−3)²−2 and −3(x+2)²+5 for opening/range. Unit-input changes two/six or −3/−9 refute a constant slope. At a=0 the rule is constant, losing quadratic identity and a unique vertex.

focus.zh: 平方为零的顶点与任意对称距离
focus.en: Zero-square vertex and arbitrary symmetric offsets

rationale.zh: 两组亲解平方0得顶点(3,−2)/(−2,5)与轴x3/x−2，纠括号符号左右误读；一般代h±d均ad²+k说明任意距离对称，a0时不能宣称唯一轴/顶点。
rationale.en: Both set the square to zero for vertices (3,−2)/(−2,5) and axes x=3/x=−2, correcting bracket-sign shift errors. Substituting h±d yields ad²+k for arbitrary symmetric offsets. At a=0 neither a unique axis nor vertex may be asserted.

focus.zh: 三式全展开、外系数与可读特征
focus.en: Full expansion of three forms, scale and readable features

rationale.zh: 两组三式分别统一系数(1,−6,8)/(2,4,−6)，读截距、顶点轴与根，完整展开证所有输入同。另乘2保根但改零输入输出16/−12，说明同根不代表同函数、外系数不能丢。
rationale.en: The form triples expand to coefficients (1,−6,8)/(2,4,−6), reading intercepts, vertex/axis and roots while proving identity for all inputs. Doubling preserves roots but changes zero-input outputs to sixteen/−12, showing equal roots do not imply equal functions and outside scale must remain.

focus.zh: 原交点与差图零点的纵坐标
focus.en: Original intersections versus difference-graph outputs

rationale.zh: H03原x²=3交点纵3而差图纵0，根±√3，1.73平方非3；H04原2x²=5纵5而差图纵0，根±√10/2，1.58给4.9928。均列精确有序点及负根，用零乘积分支证完整，不混两图或凭视窗。
rationale.en: H03 original x²=3 intersections have output three while the difference graph has zero, roots ±√3, and 1.73 fails exact squaring. H04 uses 2x²=5 with outputs five/zero, roots ±√10/2 and approximation 1.58 giving 4.9928. Both list exact ordered points and negative roots with exhaustive zero-product branches, not mixed graphs or window evidence.

focus.zh: 原正边域与受限最优证明
focus.en: Original positive-side domain and constrained optimum proof

rationale.zh: 两组从周长24/28推x(12−x)/x(14−x)，保正边0<x<12/14，配方全域最大36/49。再限1≤x≤5或2≤x≤6，顶点不可用；任意允许x距中心至少1，故最大35/48在右端，核长7/8及cm²，非只试样点。
rationale.en: Both derive x(12−x) or x(14−x) from perimeter twenty-four/twenty-eight and positive-side domains, then prove global maxima thirty-six/forty-nine. Restrictions [1,5]/[2,6] exclude the vertex; every input is at least one from the centre, proving maxima thirty-five/forty-eight at the right endpoint, with lengths seven/eight and cm², rather than sample trials.

focus.zh: 同向对应与正倍率
focus.en: Consistent correspondence and positive scale

rationale.zh: 两组ABC∼DFE按A/D、B/F、C/E给目标/原图倍率3/2或2，算对应边9/2与6或10与24，再反向全部2/3或1/2。反射旋转不按屏幕重命名，k1允许，比例无单位且不混方向。
rationale.en: Both order ABC∼DFE by A/D,B/F,C/E and target/original scale 3/2 or two, deriving sides 9/2,six or ten,twenty-four. Reversing every ratio gives 2/3 or 1/2. Rigid poses do not rename points, k=1 is allowed and scale is unitless with consistent direction.

focus.zh: AA充分与SSA一般不足
focus.en: AA sufficiency and general SSA insufficiency

rationale.zh: H22/H23由已知A=D、C=E直角明确AA得相似及第三角；另复用H05/H06的两SSA非退化分支AC=3√3±√7或5√3±√11。固定两边同长却第三边不同，若相似比只能1便矛盾，否定任意SSA充分，不否定另有特殊前提。
rationale.en: H22/H23 explicitly derive AA from given A=D and right C/E, then the third angle. H05/H06 supply two nondegenerate SSA alternatives AC=3√3±√7 or 5√3±√11. Equal fixed side pairs would force similarity scale one, contradicting unequal third sides. This refutes general SSA sufficiency without denying extra-premise special cases.

focus.zh: 嵌套图角依据与完整比例
focus.en: Nested angle premises and full proportions

rationale.zh: 两处D∈AB、E∈AC且DE∥BC，A共角与对应角给ADE∼ABC，完整AD/AB=AE/AC=DE/BC为3/5或4/7，算DE6/8cm并保同向对应，不从外观跳相似。
rationale.en: Both use D on AB,E on AC and DE∥BC, citing common A and corresponding angles for ADE∼ABC. Full AD/AB=AE/AC=DE/BC ratios 3/5 or 4/7 give DE six/eight cm, retaining direction and angle evidence rather than appearance.

focus.zh: 对应底高平方倍率与非均匀反例
focus.en: Squared base-height scale and nonuniform caution

rationale.zh: 两组亲作对应垂高，底与高均乘k，面积变9S/25或16S/49；另横2纵3矩形面积6倍不自动保证相似或统一对应比，保前提而不把面积比当长度比。
rationale.en: Both construct corresponding perpendicular heights, scaling base and height by k for areas 9S/25 or 16S/49. A rectangle with horizontal/vertical factors two/three has sixfold area without automatically guaranteeing similarity or one corresponding scale. Area and length ratios remain distinct.

focus.zh: 印图单位、同步比例条与局部标定
focus.en: Printed units, synchronous bars and local calibration

rationale.zh: H22印图1:25000路线4cm转1km，H23的1:40000路线3cm转6/5km；屏幕放2或3/2倍仍同实长，须同步比例条。若套印图尺错成2或9/5km，斜拍单处尺也不能保证全局各向倍率，说明模型假设而非只套比例。
rationale.en: H22 converts four cm at 1:25000 to one km; H23 converts three cm at 1:40000 to 6/5 km. Screen zoom two or 3/2 retains real length and requires the synchronous bar. Reusing the printed ruler wrongly gives two or 9/5 km, and one local ruler in perspective cannot certify global directional scale.

focus.zh: 垂弦全等、直径退化与整线距离
focus.en: Chord congruence, diameter degeneration and whole-line distance

rationale.zh: H22半径5弦6、H23半径13弦10，以公共OM和同圆半径斜边HL证半弦3/5，再求OM4/12。OM0直径直接中点不套退化HL；任意线点OX²=d²+MX²说明d与r比较的0/1/2交点，有向位置和非负距离分开，不依有限图窗。
rationale.en: H22 uses radius five/chord six and H23 radius thirteen/chord ten. HL from common OM and radius hypotenuses proves half-chords three/five, then OM four/twelve. At OM=0 use the diameter midpoint, not degenerate HL. OX²=d²+MX² gives zero/one/two line intersections from d versus r, separating signed positions from nonnegative distances and finite windows.

focus.zh: 不含顶点的弧与同异侧
focus.en: Vertex-excluding arcs and same/opposite sides

rationale.zh: 两组小弧100/140、大弧260/220，P/R在大弧得圆周角50/70，Q在小弧得130/110，均先标不含顶点的弧。同侧同弧等角、异侧总180，旋转保身份，顶点离圆或与端点重合不能直接套。
rationale.en: Minor/major arcs 100/260 or 140/220 give P/R angles fifty/seventy and opposite Q angles 130/110 after labelling arcs excluding vertices. Same-side equality and opposite-side 180° follow from the arcs; rotation preserves identity, while off-circle or endpoint vertices cannot use the rule.

focus.zh: 同外点同圆切线段的HL证明
focus.en: HL proof for same-point same-circle tangent segments

rationale.zh: 两处同外点P、同圆不同切点T/S先由相切得两直角，共OP斜边、半径相等HL证明PT=PS；r6/OP10得8，r8/OP17得15。缺相切、换圆/外点或P在圆上不保此非退化证明，比较有限线段而非无限直线。
rationale.en: Both use given same-circle tangency at T/S from one external P for right angles, common OP hypotenuse and equal radii, proving PT=PS by HL. Radius/OP six/ten yields eight; eight/seventeen yields fifteen. Missing tangency, another circle/point or on-circle P removes premises. The comparison concerns segments, not infinite lines.

focus.zh: 整圆份额、外边界及图形身份
focus.en: Whole-circle fractions, outer boundary and figure identity

rationale.zh: r6θ150给弧5πcm、面积15πcm²、周长5π+12；r10θ72给4π、20π、4π+20。由θ/360分别乘整圆周长/面积，区分弧弦、扇形弓形；360时半径为内缝不加，0亦退化，l+2r限定0<θ<360。
rationale.en: Radius six/angle150 gives arc5π cm,area15π cm²,perimeter5π+12; ten/72 gives4π,20π,4π+20. The θ/360 fraction multiplies whole circumference/area separately. Both distinguish arc/chord and sector/segment, omit internal radii for a full circle and restrict l+2r to 0<θ<360, with zero also degenerate.

focus.zh: 直径角、辅助高与自由理由链
focus.en: Diameter angles, constructed altitude and free proof chain

rationale.zh: 两组BC直径且A在圆上先得A直角，AB/AC6/8或5/12求BC10/13；构造AD垂直、D在BC给AA的ABD∼CBA，再列比求BD、AD、DC及核正量单位。任意E不能无依据加共圆，卡片合法先后不等于完整自由证明。
rationale.en: Both use diameter BC and on-circle A for the large right angle, then legs six/eight or five/twelve for BC ten/thirteen. Constructed AD and D on BC give ordered AA ABD∼CBA, deriving BD,AD,DC with positive quantities and units. Arbitrary E gains no concyclicity premise; valid card order does not replace a complete free proof.

focus.zh: 同锐角AA与换参照边身份
focus.en: Same-acute-angle AA and changing reference roles

rationale.zh: 两直角三角形同锐角给AA，对应O/A/H同乘正k，三商消k。H22以5/12/13、H23以8/15/17分别换A/B参照，O邻腿互换而H仍对直角，缺直角不能直接套本课边比。
rationale.en: Two right triangles sharing an acute angle give AA; positive k multiplies O/A/H and cancels from ratios. H22 uses5/12/13 and H23 uses8/15/17 to switch A/B references, swapping opposite/adjacent legs while the hypotenuse remains opposite the right angle. Absent that premise, these side formulas do not apply directly.

focus.zh: 三边比及未知分母反求
focus.en: Three ratios and solving an unknown denominator

rationale.zh: H22生成A的5/13、12/13、5/12和B互换，H23生成8/17、15/17、8/15和互换；邻直角边不包括斜边。新同角对边6/10由sin反求H78/5或85/4，不能固定“乘sin”，保原比例及单位。
rationale.en: H22 generates sine/cosine/tangent5/13,12/13,5/12 and switched B ratios; H23 uses8/17,15/17,8/15 and switches. Adjacent leg excludes the hypotenuse. New opposite lengths six/ten give hypotenuse78/5 or85/4 by solving the sine denominator, not blindly multiplying, with original ratios and units retained.

focus.zh: 锐角投影单调与正分母边界
focus.en: Acute projection monotonicity and denominator boundaries

rationale.zh: 两处固定H以O增/A减说明sin增cos减，并用O2/A2>O1/A2>O1/A1证tan增；tan60=√3>1，90邻边0未定义不钳大数。明确0<θ<90与sin/cos严格0..1，本题锐角域不被H04一般角定义取消，曲线有限采样非一般证明。
rationale.en: Both use fixed H with increasing O/decreasing A for sine/cosine variation and O2/A2>O1/A2>O1/A1 for increasing tangent. tan60=√3 exceeds one; at90 the adjacent denominator vanishes rather than becoming a large clipped value. Acute restrictions and strict sine/cosine bounds remain despite H04 general-angle definitions; finite curves do not prove the general claim.

focus.zh: 统一单位、锐角反函数与最终舍入
focus.en: Unified units, acute inverse functions and final rounding

rationale.zh: H22对9cm/邻120mm化9/12得tan3/4，H23的50cm/1.2m化0.5/1.2得5/12；DEG反函数角36.9/22.6到0.1°，中途不截断，反函数非倒数。sinθ1.2超界、cosθ0为被排90需审数据，不硬用计算器。
rationale.en: H22 converts opposite9cm/adjacent120mm to9/12 for tangent3/4; H23 converts50cm/1.2m to0.5/1.2 for5/12. DEG inverse tangent gives36.9/22.6° to0.1° without intermediate truncation, not reciprocal values. A sine ratio1.2 or cosine0 at excluded90° requires a model/data audit.

focus.zh: 坡度角度斜长与测高基面
focus.en: Gradient, angle, slope length and height datum

rationale.zh: 两坡3/4/5与5/12/13分别给75%/36.9°/5m、125/3%/22.6°/13m，类别单位分开。另同水平仪器1.2/1.5、水平距4/12及精确tan3/4或5/12求目标4.2/6.5m，独立于坡高；斜距/基面差要改关系，零水平距未定义、200%可为锐坡。
rationale.en: Ramps3/4/5 and5/12/13 yield75%/36.9°/5m or125/3%/22.6°/13m, keeping quantity types and units separate. Independent level-base height tasks add instruments1.2/1.5 to rises from horizontal4/12 and exact tangents3/4 or5/12 for targets4.2/6.5m. Slanted distance/base differences change the relation; zero run is undefined and200% can be acute.

focus.zh: 全模型乘积与样本吻合的不同
focus.en: Full-model product versus a matching sample

rationale.zh: H24由12等权编号格2/2/4/4算交1/6=1/3×1/2，H33由20格3/2/9/6算3/20=1/4×3/5，四类非等权。另各有限观察表恰吻合乘积仍不证真实独立；一次偏离也不证装置坏，模型全空间与样本/总体身份明确。
rationale.en: H24 calculates 1/6=1/3×1/2 from twelve equiprobable IDs with category counts 2/2/4/4; H33 calculates 3/20=1/4×3/5 from twenty IDs with counts 3/2/9/6. Categories are not equiprobable. Each also audits a matching finite observed table as insufficient for real independence, while a mismatch alone does not prove a faulty device.

focus.zh: 每支剩余袋与互斥路径和
focus.en: Remaining bag on each branch and disjoint-path sums

rationale.zh: 两组亲画放回/不放回两层树，3红2蓝给RR3/10、RB/BR各3/10，2红2蓝给RR1/6、RB/BR各1/3。第一颜色后重数第二袋分母与分子，异色为两条互斥顺序之和3/5或2/3，不把四字母串平均或复用放回分母。
rationale.en: Both draw replacement/no-replacement trees. Three red/two blue gives RR3/10 and RB/BR3/10 each; two red/two blue gives RR1/6 and RB/BR1/3 each. Second-bag counts change after the first colour. Different colours sum two disjoint orders to 3/5 or 2/3 rather than averaging colour strings or retaining replacement denominators.

focus.zh: 完整编号格、对角排除与一致顺序
focus.en: Complete ID grids, diagonal removal and consistent order

rationale.zh: H24编号格放回25、不放回20，颜色计数9/6/6/4与6/6/6/2；H33为16/12格，颜色4/4/4/4与2/4/4/2。实际生成格并排同编号对角线，R1R2与R2R1各保，不混无序分子和有序分母；H33放回颜色等权只是本袋特例。
rationale.en: H24 generates twenty-five/twenty ID cells with colour counts 9/6/6/4 and 6/6/6/2; H33 generates sixteen/twelve cells with counts 4/4/4/4 and 2/4/4/2. Same-ID diagonals are removed, reverse orders remain distinct and unordered numerators cannot use ordered denominators. Equal replacement colour weights in H33 are only a special case.

focus.zh: 一次结果、设计偏差与未回答
focus.en: One result, design bias and nonresponse

rationale.zh: H27对200人20回应15是须报本次75%及总体逻辑界15/200..195/200，未回应不记否，并区分随机抽样/分配与总体范围。H34以六编号0/6模型具体比较本次误差、完整框期望及只A框恒0偏差，框内扩样不补遗漏；偶然恰值不认证设计无偏。
rationale.en: H27 requires observed 75% from fifteen yes among twenty responses out of two hundred, logical population bounds 15/200..195/200 and no coding nonresponse as no, with sampling/allocation and generalisation separated. H34’s six-ID zero/six model compares single error, full-frame expectation and A-only constant-zero bias; larger within-frame samples cannot repair omissions and one exact result cannot certify unbiased design.

focus.zh: 完整轮次、恢复与有限模拟
focus.en: Complete rounds, restoration and finite simulation

rationale.zh: 两组轮内移球、轮后恢复原袋，理论异色3/5或2/3；虚构模拟4/5再5/6、5/6再6/7，整数通分比较到理论距离反而增大。分母完整两抽轮而非抽数，0轮未定义；不恢复改变重复模型，标种子有限伪随机不当真实装置资料或理论证明。
rationale.en: Both remove within rounds and restore the original bag between rounds, with theory 3/5 or 2/3. Fictional simulation changes 4/5 to 5/6 or 5/6 to 6/7; exact denominator comparisons show greater distance from theory. Frequencies use complete two-draw rounds, zero rounds are undefined and never restoring changes the repeated process. Labelled finite seeded simulation is neither real-device evidence nor a theory proof.

focus.zh: 面积结构的一般依据与数值核例
focus.en: General area structure before numerical checks

rationale.zh: 复用H05/H06的四同块两种重排：先证明同(a+b)外框、同四块无叠缺及中央角，推出一般c²=a²+b²，再代5/12和8/15核例，并明确几次数值不证明一般式。须把几何块与代数项对应，不只是代入某x碰巧相等。
rationale.en: H05/H06 reuse four-piece rearrangements: equal(a+b)frames,matching nonoverlapping pieces and central angles establish general c²=a²+b² before5/12 or8/15 numerical checks. Both explicitly reject finite trials as general proof and require geometric pieces to match algebraic terms rather than coincidental substitution.

focus.zh: 完整规则、离散输入与有限观察
focus.en: Complete rules, discrete inputs and finite observations

rationale.zh: 两组实际给完整水量折线，读三段内值7/6/3L或14/12/6L及暂停零率，端点包含、空后域外不延伸。另整包半包虽输出4整数仍不允许；两观测无函数族须给x/x²或2x/2x+(x−1)(x−2)两规则证预测不唯一，坐标率不依图窗。
rationale.en: Both provide actual complete water polylines,requiring segment queries seven/six/three or fourteen/twelve/six litres and a zero-rate pause,with included endpoints and no post-domain extension. Half-pack input remains invalid despite integer output four. Two observations without a function class need two matching rules,x/x² or2x/2x+(x−1)(x−2),to refute uniqueness. Coordinate rates do not depend on viewport.

focus.zh: 合法依赖而非唯一点击顺序
focus.en: Valid dependencies rather than one click order

rationale.zh: H28矩形x(x+2)=24候选−6/4筛正得4×6周20，H38的x(x+3)=28候选−7/4得4×7周22；另去返总时间均5h、独立总路程12/24km后均速12/5或24/5。须说明可独立准备与不能提前用的结论，保原式/单位/根全集，不强制唯一算法或把卡片顺序当完整证明。
rationale.en: H28 rectangle x(x+2)=24 filters roots−6/four to4×6,perimeter twenty; H38 x(x+3)=28 filters−7/four to4×7,perimeter twenty-two. Separate journeys have total time five hours and independently prepared distances twelve/twenty-four km,giving averages12/5 or24/5. Learners identify independent preparation and conclusions needing inputs,retain originals/units/complete roots,and avoid one mandatory algorithm or card-order-as-proof.

focus.zh: 反例否定、条件不足与按前提核验
focus.en: Refutation, insufficiency and premise-based verification

rationale.zh: 两组各自行三种审查：平方方程漏−3或零给实际反例；两观察同过却异预测的两完整函数给不唯一，非已证实际输出不同；已知直角5/12/13或矩形3/4/5正长度平方核验但cm²仍单位错。区分反驳/未知/本例核过，不能凭像素或答案像不像。
rationale.en: Each distinguishes three audits: missing−3 or zero is an actual counterexample to a complete root claim; two matching functions with different predictions prove nonuniqueness,not a known actual alternative output; a given5/12/13 right triangle or3/4/5 rectangle verifies positive length but cm² still fails units. Refutation,remaining uncertainty and this verified case differ; pixels and plausible digits are insufficient.

focus.zh: 改宽与全长缩放后的逐项约束
focus.en: Width-only versus all-length scaling with every constraint checked

rationale.zh: H22原坡面积10费120，仅宽3得15/180，全长2倍得40/480但h6>4、r8>6；H23原26/260，仅宽4得52/520，全长3/2倍得117/2与585但h15/2>6、r18>15。两处逐项核侧面长度、坡度、面积k²、定单价费及原高度/水平约束，不由坡度不变推一切合规。
rationale.en: H22 starts area10/cost120,width-only three gives15/180,all lengths×2 gives40/480 but violates h6>4,r8>6. H23 starts26/260,width-only four gives52/520,all×3/2 gives117/2 and585 but violates h15/2>6,r18>15. Both track side lengths,unchanged gradient,k² area,area-rate cost and original height/run limits rather than treating unchanged slope as complete feasibility.

focus.zh: 数值元素、子集与原始清单
focus.en: Numerical elements, subsets and original lists

rationale.zh: 两组四个不同ID清单1,1,2,4或2,2,4,6生成三个不同元素，保原观测次数，区分数∈A与单元素集⊆A而非∈A，空集是子集却非该数值集元素。集合顺序/重复不改，但不能据此删除不同ID原记录。
rationale.en: Each four-ID list, 1,1,2,4 or 2,2,4,6, generates three set elements without deleting observations. Learners distinguish a numerical element from its singleton subset, an empty subset from a numerical element, and set order/multiplicity from original record counts.

focus.zh: 全集下逐元素交并补
focus.en: Elementwise intersection, union and complement in a universe

rationale.zh: H25在U0..6、H26在U1..8实际生成交并补，核A∩Aᶜ为空及A∪Aᶜ=U，逐元素给既在/不在理由。只扩U到8或10时补集加入7与8或9与10、A不变，不能不声明全集求补。
rationale.en: H25 uses universe 0..6 and H26 uses 1..8 to generate intersection, union and complement, proving A∩Aᶜ empty and A∪Aᶜ=U elementwise. Expanding only U adds seven/eight or nine/ten to its complement while A stays unchanged; the universe is required.

focus.zh: 域改变的全称真假与存在否定
focus.en: Domain-sensitive universals and negating existence

rationale.zh: 两处x²≥x或(x−2)²≥x−2在整数域用m≤0或m≥1的一般证明，在实数用1/2或5/2反例；否定全称换存在且保域。存在整数平方2或3的否定是所有整数不等，按|n|≤1或≥2证明；存在一个不等不能否定存在相等。
rationale.en: Both prove x²≥x or (x−2)²≥x−2 over integers by m≤0/m≥1, then refute over reals at 1/2 or 5/2. Universal negation changes to existence while retaining domain. Negating existence of an integer square two/three requires all integers to differ, proved by |n|≤1 or ≥2; one unequal square is not that negation.

focus.zh: 必要充分的指向与逆否
focus.en: Directed necessity/sufficiency and contraposition

rationale.zh: P:x3、Q:x²9或P:x4、Q:x²16逐箭头审，负根反驳Q⇒P，明确谁对谁充分/必要；逆否真而单独否定两边不成立。加x≥0后负反例域外、两方向真，实际重审不是按中文词感判。
rationale.en: P:x3/Q:x²9 or P:x4/Q:x²16 are audited both ways, using the negative root against Q⇒P and explicitly naming necessity/sufficiency. Contraposition holds but the inverse fails. Restricting x≥0 removes that witness and makes both directions true, requiring a domain-aware re-audit.

focus.zh: 完整绝对值集合及零负半径
focus.en: Complete absolute-value sets and zero/negative right sides

rationale.zh: 两组中心3半径2或中心−1半径4亲画全部<≤>≥解集，内侧且/交、外侧或/并，核两端及中心。另逐项给c0的空/单点/去一点/全实及c−2的空或全实，由距离非负而非盲背内外口诀，不用有限整数表替完整集合。
rationale.en: Both draw all four comparison sets about centre three/radius two or centre negative one/radius four, distinguish inside AND/intersection from outside OR/union, and test endpoints/centre. They classify c=0 into empty/singleton/punctured/all-real sets and c=−2 into empty or all reals using nonnegative distance, not mnemonics or finite lists.

focus.zh: 全域单值、像集与目标集
focus.en: Total single-valuedness, image and codomain

rationale.zh: H25给x²域[−2,2]、H26给(x−1)²域[−1,3]，目标[0,9]而实际像[0,4]，亲画多对一仍函数。另同输入两输出及漏一个声明域内输入的关系无效，用每个输入恰一输出说明，不把未达到9当函数失效。
rationale.en: H25 uses x² on [−2,2] and H26 (x−1)² on [−1,3], with codomain [0,9] but actual image [0,4]. Both draw valid many-to-one maps and invalid double-output/missing-input relations, requiring exactly one output for every declared input rather than demanding output nine be attained.

focus.zh: 完整图、值与规则假设
focus.en: Complete graph, values and rule assumptions

rationale.zh: 复用H28/H38实际完整水量折线及双语全部端点，求三段内分数输入值和变化率，并与整包离散规则、只有两观测的两不同候选函数比较。完整图是给定规则才可插值；有限点不能擅连，离散域不补半包，图窗不改率或域。
rationale.en: H28/H38 supply actual complete water polylines with all endpoints in bilingual text, requiring fractional-input values and segment rates. They contrast given continuous rules, discrete whole-pack rules and two observations matching different functions. Interpolation needs the given rule; finite points do not authorise joining, discrete domains do not admit half packs, and viewport does not change rates or domains.

focus.zh: 全域严格性、零函数与奇偶前提
focus.en: Whole-domain strictness, zero function and parity premises

rationale.zh: 两组平方/移位平方给域内反例否定全域严格增，并用两点平方差符号一般证两侧增减。零函数在非退化对称域既奇且偶、非严格增减但非递减且非递增；奇偶先查关于0对称域，x公式在正域或图轴x1不自动满足。
rationale.en: Both refute whole-domain strict increase for square/shifted-square examples and prove each side by the general difference-of-squares sign. On nondegenerate symmetric domains zero is both odd/even, not strictly monotone but both nondecreasing/nonincreasing. Parity first requires zero-centred domain symmetry; formula x on a positive domain or an x=1 graph axis is insufficient.

focus.zh: 推点对应、给定域与零系数重审
focus.en: Derived point mapping, supplied domain and zero coefficients

rationale.zh: 两处推x=h+u/b、y=k+a f(u)与{x:b(x−h)∈D}；负b−2/−3横反射缩1/2或1/3，亲算三个像点。仅a0保给定复合域；b0必须重查内0：H25的[1,9]不含0无允许输入，H26的[−2,1]含0则常值全实，不能除0或把缩放写无穷。
rationale.en: Both derive x=h+u/b, y=k+a f(u) and the supplied-domain preimage. Negative b−2/−3 reflects with horizontal factor 1/2 or 1/3, and three image points are calculated. Changing only a=0 retains that domain. At b=0, recheck inner zero: H25 excludes it in [1,9], so no inputs are allowed; H26 includes it in [−2,1], giving an all-real constant. Division by zero or an infinite-scale label is invalid.

focus.zh: 全部像的唯一原像与坐标交换
focus.en: Unique preimage for every image value and coordinate swap

rationale.zh: 两组输出0唯一原像0或1不证明可逆；输出4有−2与2或−1与3，水平线两交与交换坐标给同输入双输出。右半域[0,2]/[1,3]才得逆√y/1+√y，逆域为实际像[0,4]，不让原目标9自动进入，明确函数/反函数唯一性方向。
rationale.en: A unique preimage zero/one for output zero does not certify invertibility. Output four has negative two/two or negative one/three; horizontal lines and coordinate swapping reveal double inverse outputs. Restricting to right halves [0,2]/[1,3] gives inverses √y or 1+√y with domain actual image [0,4], not unused codomain nine. Original and inverse uniqueness directions differ.

focus.zh: 完整分段、累计与整件按档的预算并集
focus.en: Complete partition, cumulative versus whole-tier budget unions

rationale.zh: H25域[0,6]阈2、预算5，H26域[0,8]阈3、预算10，表中每输入恰一适用规则。累计预算[0,3]/[0,7/2]；整件按档因跳价给[0,5/3]∪(2,5/2]或[0,5/2]∪(3,5]，每段先解后交域再并，核阈值只归第一档及开闭，不擅平滑或补间隙。
rationale.en: H25 uses domain [0,6], threshold two, budget five; H26 uses [0,8], threshold three, budget ten. Each input has one table rule. Cumulative feasible sets are [0,3]/[0,7/2]. Whole-shipment tier jumps give [0,5/3]∪(2,5/2] or [0,5/2]∪(3,5]. Learners solve each segment, intersect its domain, then union and check first-tier threshold ownership/endpoints without smoothing or filling gaps.

focus.zh: 非零倒数、同底运算与括号
focus.en: Nonzero reciprocals, equal-base operations and parentheses

rationale.zh: H31主动算3⁻²×3⁵、3²+3³及括号正负16；H35算5³÷5⁵、5²+5³与正负9。两处从aⁿa⁻ⁿ=1推倒数和非零底条件，乘回反驳0负指数，明确乘除才加减指数而非加法。
rationale.en: H31 generates 3⁻²×3⁵,3²+3³ and signed sixteen; H35 generates 5³÷5⁵,5²+5³ and signed nine. Both derive reciprocal powers and the nonzero-base premise from aⁿa⁻ⁿ=1, reject zero negative powers by multiplying back, and distinguish product/quotient laws from addition.

focus.zh: 正根定义与负底步骤冲突
focus.en: Positive-root definitions and conflicting negative-base procedures

rationale.zh: H31求16^(−3/4)=1/8并核四次根；H35求81^(−3/4)=1/27。负底分别−27的2/6与−32的2/10，先平方偶根与先约分奇根得相反号，要求指出正底前提及另定义奇分母实根的范围，不宣称负底任何有理指数都不存在。
rationale.en: H31 derives16^(−3/4)=1/8 and H35 derives81^(−3/4)=1/27 through checked positive fourth roots. Negative-base2/6 of−27 and2/10 of−32 give opposite signs under incompatible procedures. Both identify the lost positive-base premise and distinguish a separately declared reduced odd-denominator convention from a blanket claim that all negative-base rational powers are undefined.

focus.zh: 恒倍率假设与有限观测
