focus.en: Constant-ratio assumptions versus finite observations

rationale.zh: H31的两点(0,3),(1,6)也被3(1+t)吻合；H35的(0,80),(1,40)也被80/(t+1)吻合且全t≥0正。两例下一时刻与指数不同，需额外指定相等时间恒定倍率与连续延伸，不能由整数记录擅许半时查询或声称现实模型必真。
rationale.en: The growth observations also fit3(1+t); the decay observations also fit80/(t+1), positive for all t≥0. Different next predictions expose non-identification. Equal-interval constant ratios and continuous extension must be stipulated, not inferred from two integer-time records or treated as proof of the real mechanism.

focus.zh: 存在、唯一与递减的逆
focus.en: Existence, uniqueness and decreasing inverses

rationale.zh: 两处将log₄(1/8)与log₉(1/27)改写指数并核−3/2，分别说明负真数无解与底1有多解，写正底非1及正真数完整条件；0<b<1虽递减仍一一覆盖正数，不能误判无逆。
rationale.en: Both rewrite logarithms of1/8 base4 or1/27 base9 into exponent equations and check−3/2. They distinguish no solution for a negative argument from nonunique exponents for base one, state complete real-log domains, and explain why decreasing bases0<b<1 remain one-to-one onto positive values.

focus.zh: 通式推导、拆和反例与原真数
focus.en: General laws, a sum counterexample and original arguments

rationale.zh: 两处由u=aᵖ、v=aᑫ推乘积和商定律，给拆和精确反例。H31原域x>2求±6筛{6}；H35原域x>1求±√10筛{√10}。负候选虽使乘积正却两原真数负，须核回原式，不能借合并式扩大域。
rationale.en: Both derive product and quotient laws from inverse exponents, refute splitting sums with exact examples, then solve log equations. H31 filters±6 to{6} on x>2; H35 filters±√10 to{√10} on x>1. Negative candidates have positive products but invalid original arguments, so a merged expression cannot enlarge the original domain.

focus.zh: 升降阈值、离散域与时间单位
focus.en: Growth/decay thresholds, discrete domains and time units

rationale.zh: H31解3×2ᵗ≥20得t≥log₂(20/3)，相邻2/3小时给12/24；H35解80×(1/2)ᵗ≤12得t≥log_(1/2)(3/20)，相邻2/3天给20/10。均首整数3且实域为半直线，递减比较反向；小时转天倍率2²⁴，天转小时倍率(1/2)^(1/24)，保模型适用及单位边界。
rationale.en: Growth gives t≥log₂(20/3), checked by12/24 at hours2/3; decay gives t≥log_(1/2)(3/20), checked by20/10 at days2/3, with the decreasing-base comparison reversed. Both give a complete real ray and first integer three without rounding. Time conversions use2²⁴ per day or(1/2)^(1/24) per hour, preserving model and unit scope.

focus.zh: 完整转角、有向弧与终边
focus.en: Full winding, signed arc and terminal ray

rationale.zh: H32半径3顺转750°保−25π/6及有向弧−25π/2，H36半径4逆转1110°保37π/6及74π/3；同终边−π/6或π/6不能替代完整转动。两处从s/r说明半径加倍角不变，并保弧长cm与角rad的不同角色。
rationale.en: H32 retains−25π/6 from a clockwise750° rotation and signed arc−25π/2 at radius3; H36 retains37π/6 and arc74π/3 from1110° at radius4. Coterminal representatives cannot replace the full winding. Both derive radius-scaling invariance from s/r and distinguish arc centimetres from angle radians.

focus.zh: 任意角的有符号坐标和正切域
focus.en: Signed arbitrary-angle coordinates and tangent domains

rationale.zh: H32亲画−5π/6第三象限点，H36画5π/3第四象限点，分别精确生成sin/cos/tan并解释符号；两处以π/2、3π/2横坐标0说明正切无定义，锐角正边长只给参考量级而非全角非负性。
rationale.en: H32 constructs the quadrant-three point at−5π/6 and H36 the quadrant-four point at5π/3, generating exact sine, cosine and tangent with sign explanations. Both exclude tangent at zero horizontal coordinatesπ/2 and3π/2, rather than extending positive acute side ratios to all angles.

focus.zh: 坐标搬图与最小周期的两步证明
focus.en: Coordinate-to-graph transfer and two-part least-period proof

rationale.zh: H32搬单位圆纵坐标成正弦波、H36搬横坐标成余弦波。各给π移位反例；任意点转整周证明2π确可用，最高点仅在每整周同一顶/右点再推出任何正周期至少2π，避免只凭零点或样点宣布最小周期。
rationale.en: H32 transfers circle heights into sine and H36 horizontal coordinates into cosine. Exact half-turn counterexamples rejectπ; full-turn recovery proves2π works for every input, while unique maximum locations force any positive period to be at least2π. Repeated zeros or finite graph samples do not establish the claim.

focus.zh: 内角反解、非负振幅与常数边界
focus.en: Inverse inner angles, nonnegative amplitude and constant boundaries

rationale.zh: H32负外系数−3、内2给振幅3/周期π；H36外2、负内−3给振幅2/周期2π/3。两处从u反解五个精确点并画一周，明确横向倒数倍率、反射、中线像集。另A0及B0分别回定义，常数每个正移位都是周期却没有最小正周期，图不能唯一识别相位。
rationale.en: H32 uses outer−3 and inner2 for amplitude3 and periodπ; H36 uses outer2 and inner−3 for amplitude2 and period2π/3. Both solve the inner angle to transfer five exact points, explaining reciprocal horizontal scale, reflection, midline and image. They separately evaluate A=0 and B=0: constants admit every positive shift but no least positive period or unique phase identification.

focus.zh: 任意点恒等式与保留分母限制
focus.en: Arbitrary-point identities with original denominator restrictions

rationale.zh: 两处从任意圆点平方和推恒等，再分别约sin²/sin与cos²/cos，保θ≠kπ或θ≠π/2+kπ。右式零值不授权为原0/0补定义；π/4给sin+cos=√2反驳拆平方和为一次和，有限成功不当全称证明。
rationale.en: Both prove the squared identity from an arbitrary circle point, then cancel sine or cosine only on the original nonzero-denominator domain. A defined zero on the simplified side cannot fill an original0/0 without declaring a new extension. Atπ/4,the sum√2 refutes a false identity; finite successes cannot prove a universal.

focus.zh: 全体两分支与有限区间精确筛选
focus.en: Two full real branches and exact finite-interval filtering

rationale.zh: H32解sin(2(x−π/6))=1/2保两支，筛得{−5π/12,π/4,7π/12,5π/4}；H36解cos(−3(x+π/9))=1/2得{−2π/3,−2π/9,0,4π/9}。逐支给整数范围，两个区间均左端根含、右端根不含；反三角主值只返一角，不覆盖另一支/整周，目标改2由像集判空。
rationale.en: H32 filters the transformed sine branches to{−5π/12,π/4,7π/12,5π/4}; H36 filters transformed cosine to{−2π/3,−2π/9,0,4π/9}. Both give branch-specific integer ranges and include a left endpoint root while excluding a right endpoint root. Principal inverse values alone omit branches and turns; target two is excluded by the image.

focus.zh: 同长反向、平移不变与零方向
focus.en: Equal length with opposite directions, translation and zero

rationale.zh: 两处从非原点端点生位移，与反向同模但非相等；共同平移逐坐标重算并用一般w抵消解释值不依位置。终点重合给零向量无可指定北向，H23三维、H36二维是不同后续情境。
rationale.en: Both generate displacement from nonorigin endpoints, compare an equal-length but opposite vector, and recalculate jointly translated endpoints with general w cancellation. Coincident endpoints yield zero with no assignable north direction. H23 uses three dimensions and H36 two.

focus.zh: 和与两种有向头间差
focus.en: Head-to-tail sums versus two directed head differences

rationale.zh: H23三维u/v和(−1,3,2)、差(3,1,−4)，H36二维和(1,2)、差(3,−4)；亲画移动第二箭头并标最初尾/最终头，同尾v头到u头为u−v，反向符号全换，逆加v核回u。
rationale.en: H23 generates the three-dimensional sum(−1,3,2) and difference(3,1,−4); H36 gives(1,2) and(3,−4). Both draw the translated second arrow and label endpoints, distinguish v-head-to-u-head from its reverse, and verify the difference by adding v back.

focus.zh: 负数乘与零源恢复分支
focus.en: Negative scaling and zero-source recovery branches

rationale.zh: H23用−3/2乘(2,−4,2)，H36用−2/3乘(−3,6)，逐项核新模与反向；两处解ku0、k0=0、k0=非零为{0}/全实/空，并由某非零分量证明必要前提u≠0，不只报唯一0。
rationale.en: H23 scales(2,−4,2) by−3/2 and H36 scales(−3,6) by−2/3, checking components, opposite direction and nonnegative length factors. Both distinguish{0},all reals and empty scalar sets for a nonzero source,zero-to-zero and zero-to-nonzero, with a general nonzero-component proof.

focus.zh: 非原点端点、反向与共同平移
focus.en: Nonorigin endpoints, reversal and common translations

rationale.zh: H23端点相减得(3,4,−2)，共同平移后仍此差；H36得(6,−2)并用新端点核同差。两处说明终点位置B只在起点为原点时等于AB，反向BA各分量取负，不能靠屏幕位置或抄B代替终减起。
rationale.en: H23 obtains(3,4,−2) and H36(6,−2),then checks each using newly translated endpoints. Both explain that position B equals AB only when A is the chosen origin and that reversal negates every component. Screen position or copying B cannot replace end-minus-start.

focus.zh: 标量点积、两式与非零夹角条件
focus.en: Scalar dot products, both formulas and nonzero angle premises

rationale.zh: 复用H23实际点积0与余弦1/√6任务、零向量反例，H36由(A−P)·(B−P)展开圆轨迹并排A/B零向量。两单元重新生成分量乘积和及夹角/轨迹理由，标量与箭头区分，点积0本身不能令零向量有直角。
rationale.en: Reuse H23 scalar-product and exact-cosine tasks plus its zero-vector counterexample. H36 expands(A−P)·(B−P) into a circle locus and excludes endpoint zero vectors. Both regenerate component products and angle or locus arguments; a scalar zero alone cannot assign a right angle to a zero vector.

focus.zh: 等对角线的结构前提与梯形反例
focus.en: Structural premises for equal diagonals and trapezoid counterexamples

rationale.zh: 两处从已知非退化平行四边形一般展开平方差4u·v，等长才给非零邻边直角与矩形；H23同z平面梯形对角平方29、底6/4，H36平方34、底8/2。实际反例否定漏平行四边形前提的命题，不否定带前提定理，避免循环假定。
rationale.en: Both derive the general diagonal squared difference4u·v for a GIVEN nondegenerate parallelogram before concluding perpendicular nonzero sides. Counterexamples have squared diagonals29 with bases6/4 in H23 and34 with bases8/2 in H36. They refute the missing-premise quadrilateral claim,not the conditional theorem,without assuming the desired rectangular structure.

focus.zh: 不同点、非共线点与异面线的真实条件
focus.en: Distinct points,noncollinear points and genuine skew lines

rationale.zh: H23/H36分别以原点组和整体移位放大组证明两不同点给非零方向，重复一点可选两方向；参数直线同时解三坐标矛盾、方向不平行才判异面，并核ABC平面z0/z1与D不在。屏幕交叉不替代共面/相交依据。
rationale.en: H23 uses an origin-based configuration and H36 a translated/scaled one. Both require distinct points for a nonzero line direction and give two lines through a repeated single point. Simultaneous coordinate contradictions plus nonparallel directions establish skewness; noncollinear ABC determines z=0 or z=1,excluding D. Screen crossings cannot certify incidence.

focus.zh: 棱柱锥计数、垂高与曲面边界
focus.en: Prism/pyramid counts,perpendicular height and curved boundaries

rationale.zh: H23数凸五边底棱柱10/15/7及锥6/10/6，H36数六边底12/18/8及7/12/7；两组均核V−E+F2并用底面积/垂高求60/20和90/30cm³，排斜棱替高。球完整曲面不是此有限多面体F中的平面多边形面，不混拓扑另分割定义。
rationale.en: Pentagonal and hexagonal prisms/pyramids give separate vertex/edge/face counts with Euler value two. Perpendicular heights give volumes60/20 and90/30cm³ rather than using sloping edges. Both explain why a sphere’s whole curved boundary is not one planar polygonal face in this finite-polyhedron formula,and distinguish a separate topological decomposition.

focus.zh: 截面定维与展开后的面身份
focus.en: Section dimensions and folded face identities

rationale.zh: H23立方体和面截三角形2√3，极端改顶点/空；H36截矩形9√2，改沿棱/空，保范围及全部边界。另两组给实际编号单位正方形图，分别追交叉/阶梯的六面与相对面，反例2×3环折向冲突或六连条1/5、2/6重复，连通面积不认证有效网。
rationale.en: H23 generates a triangular section of area2√3 then distinguishes vertex/empty contacts; H36 generates a rectangle of area9√2 then edge/empty contacts. Both retain all coordinate bounds. Actual labelled square diagrams support cross/stair net folding and opposite-face identities. A2×3 loop conflicts and a six-strip repeats faces: area and connectedness alone do not certify a cube net.

focus.zh: 线面角的正确投影与余角
focus.en: Correct line-plane projection versus its complementary angle

rationale.zh: H23长方体2/3/6给底对角√13、体对角7、线面cos√13/7与sin6/7；H36用4/4/7给4√2、9、cos4√2/9与sin7/9。亲画AG投影AC，另说明高/体对角是与竖直角的cos；真实边长与投影条件替代屏幕量角。
rationale.en: Cuboids2/3/6 and4/4/7 give exact base/body diagonals and line-plane sine/cosine ratios. Both draw AG’s orthogonal projection AC and identify height/body diagonal as cosine of the complementary vertical angle,rather than using height as the in-plane adjacent side or measuring the screen.

focus.zh: 两张被遮面、分离与尺度
focus.en: Both hidden face patches,separation and scaling

rationale.zh: H23两块5×4×3和2×3×2合体积72、面和126，扣两份6得外露114；H36为6×3×2和3×2×2，体积48、面和104、外露92。分开不改总体积而恢复各面，全长倍2的面积/接触乘4体积乘8，明确内部不叠与贴合约束。
rationale.en: H23 combines volumes to72 and separate surfaces126,subtracting both six-unit patches for114 exposed. H36 gives48,104 and92. Separation restores both surfaces without changing volume; doubling all lengths with the same contact relation multiplies areas/contact by four and volume by eight,under disjoint-interior premises.

focus.zh: 有限前缀、多规则与序号域
focus.en: Finite prefixes,multiple rules and index domains

rationale.zh: H31以前缀2/5/8、H38以前缀1/4/9，各构完整原式及加(n−1)(n−2)(n−3)的另一规则，前三同而第四11/17或16/22。精确反例证明不唯一而非常见预测错误；n0虽可代式仍在声明正整数序号外。
rationale.en: Each constructs two complete rules sharing the observed three terms but giving fourth terms11/17 or16/22. The added cubic vanishes at every observed index. This proves non-identification,not that the familiar prediction is wrong. Formula evaluation at zero does not expand the declared positive-integer domain.

focus.zh: 不同序号恢复与重复条件不足
focus.en: Distinct-index recovery versus repeated conditions

rationale.zh: H31由a2=5/a7=20恢复d3/a1=2/a10=29；H38由a3=8/a9=−4得d−2/a1=12/a6=2。一般差=(序号差)d，保序号不等；另只重复同一项各给d0和d1完整反例，不用0/0擅定公差。
rationale.en: H31 recovers d3,a₁2,a₁₀29 from indices2/7; H38 recovers d−2,a₁12,a₆2 from3/9. Both derive the index-gap identity with distinct indices required. Repeating one observation admits explicit d0/d1 sequences rather than assigning a difference through0/0.

focus.zh: 双份配对、相邻和与空和
focus.en: Two-copy pairing,consecutive sums and empty sums

rationale.zh: 两处亲写正倒两份证明2Sn=n(a1+an)。H31 S10/S9=155/126差29，H38 S8/S7=40/42差−2；均区分Sn/n平均与末项，一般消去前n−1项并定义S0=0核n1，负项可使部分和下降。
rationale.en: Both derive2Sₙ=n(a₁+aₙ) by pairing forward and reverse copies. Consecutive sums155/126 recover29,while40/42 recover−2. They distinguish averages from final terms,prove cancellation generally,and retain S₀=0 at n1. Negative terms may reduce a partial sum.

focus.zh: 负公比、首项指数与零递推约定
focus.en: Negative ratios,first-index exponents and zero recurrences

rationale.zh: H31 8乘−1/2生成五项，H38 −3乘−2生成五项，逐个相邻商和通项保n−1奇偶。零倍率递推虽唯一可算，后续0/0不满足本课非零项/非零公比定义；全零也不由未定义商认证公比1。
rationale.en: Both generate five alternating terms,check every ratio,and retain n−1 in the nth-term rule. Zero-multiplier recurrences remain computable but later0/0 ratios fail the explicitly stated nonzero-term/nonzero-ratio convention. An all-zero sequence cannot acquire ratio one from an undefined quotient.

focus.zh: 错位消项保尾与q1原和
focus.en: Shifted cancellation retaining tails and the q1 branch

rationale.zh: H31首项3、公比1/2的四项和45/8，与丢尾候选6差3/8；H38首−2倍率−1/2五项和−11/8，与丢尾候选−4/3差1/24。一般(1−q)Sn=a1−a1q^n保最后尾项，q1回原重复和12/−10，不拿未论证无限和替有限项或除0。
rationale.en: Shifted subtraction retains the exact final term in(1−q)Sₙ=a₁−a₁qⁿ. Finite sums45/8 and−11/8 differ from discarded-tail candidates by3/8 and1/24. With q1,the original repeated sums give12 and−10 rather than dividing by zero or replacing finite tasks with an unproved infinite process.

focus.zh: 每笔时序、仿射余额与有限贡献
focus.en: Per-deposit timing,affine balances and finite contributions

rationale.zh: H31理想80/q3/2/c4，期末124、190，期初126、195；H38 60/q1/2/c6，期末36、24，期初33、39/2。分别写qB+c与q(B+c)，用时间线数每笔剩余期数，闭式保初值与有限和、q1和n0边界。给两个相邻余额比不同，不能把新增常数忽略当余额等比。
rationale.en: Growth and decay models compare end balances124 then190,or36 then24,with start balances126 then195,or33 then39/2. Both derive qB+c versus q(B+c),count each deposit’s remaining periods,and retain initial balance,finite sums,q1 and n0. Unequal adjacent balance ratios reject calling these affine balances geometric; no fees or rounding are silently added.

focus.zh: 无序编码、原身份与缺失分母
focus.en: Nominal coding,original identities and missing denominators

rationale.zh: 两组实际原表均六行五成员，已核同ID同次复制r5、未记录r6；保原资料另分析四个有效ID，同色不同ID不删。已记录目标色2/4，总体五人只可能2/5或3/5。两套类别编码不改颜色却改均值，明确不能称平均颜色，频数比例要保对象和分母。
rationale.en: Each actual raw table has six rows for five members,with a confirmed duplicate and a missing value. Raw provenance remains while four valid IDs enter analysis. Equal colours at different IDs are retained. Observed2/4 differs from population possibilities2/5 or3/5. Relabelling nominal colour codes changes means without changing colours,so frequencies/proportions require explicit identities and denominators.

focus.zh: 镜像、双峰、离散端点与正态前提
focus.en: Reflection,bimodality,discrete endpoints and normal premises

rationale.zh: H27图示0/0/4/4围绕2双峰，H34图示1/1/7/7围绕4双峰，都是完整四编号演示总体。各直接数μ±σ闭区间4/4、开区间0/4，保重复值身份与端点；对称不证正态，68%近似不能替代本数据计数或认证现实模型。
rationale.en: Actual dot plots show symmetric bimodal complete four-ID populations centred at two/four. Direct counts inside the closed one-SD interval give4/4,but open endpoints give0/4. Repeated values retain IDs. Symmetry alone does not justify normality or replace exact discrete counting with a68% approximation.

focus.zh: 平方先于相加、明示分母与绝对缩放
focus.en: Square before summing,declared divisors and absolute scaling

rationale.zh: H27数据3/5/5/7的离差平方和8，总体方差2、样本8/3；H34数据2/5/5/8平方和18、总体9/2、样本6，均精确给标准差。一般离差c倍导致平方和c²倍、标准差|c|倍，负反射不使标准差负或让离差抵消替平方。
rationale.en: Both compute every squared deviation before summing,then distinguish population versus sample divisors and exact SDs. Sums eight/eighteen give population variances two/9/2 versus sample8/3/six. The general deviation transformation proves SD scales by|c|,not signed c;zero signed-deviation sums do not imply zero spread.

focus.zh: 连参考量一起变换与零尺度边界
focus.en: Transforming reference quantities and zero-scale boundaries

rationale.zh: 两组首观察z−√2，分别反向10−2x与20−3x后连均值/正标准差更新为z′√2。一般z′=(c/|c|)z，正向5+2x不变；常数或c0无标准分数，不由z正负自动判断优劣或概率，保σ>0与原参考分布。
rationale.en: Both start with z=−√2 and obtain√2 after reflection,updating the mean and nonnegative SD. General z′=(c/|c|)z explains positive-affine invariance and negative-affine reversal. Constant data or c0 leaves z undefined;signs alone establish neither merit nor probability.

focus.zh: 共同x的唯一原拟合与不唯一斜率
focus.en: Unique fitted value but nonunique slope with constant x

rationale.zh: H27共同x2、y1/4/7给SSE=18+3(a+2b−4)²，H34共同x3、y2/5/8给18+3(a+3b−5)²。分别全最优族a+2b4/a+3b5，原x拟合4/5唯一而斜率自由；给两最优线在新x预测不同，保不同ID权重、竖直残差与原输入，不把Sxx0写“无拟合值”。
rationale.en: General squared identities give all optimal lines when x is constant. The original fitted value four/five is unique while slope remains free;explicit equally optimal lines predict differently at a new x. Different-ID records keep their weights. Vertical residuals retain original x,and zero Sxx means nonidentified slope rather than absence of an original fitted value.

focus.zh: 扩域、完整根集与负幂
focus.en: Domain extension,complete roots and negative powers

rationale.zh: 两组分别在实/复域解u²+9/16=0；实平方非负与复域零乘积给完整集，再由i⁴=1和1/i=−i核负幂及高幂。扩域不改变实数平方的性质，代候选不替完整性论证。
rationale.en: Both solve u²+9/16=0 in each domain. Nonnegative real squares and complex factorisation establish complete sets. The four-cycle and reciprocal then handle negative and high powers. Enlarging the domain changes available elements,not real squares;substitution alone does not establish completeness.

focus.zh: 实系数条件与虚部坐标
focus.en: Real-coefficient premises and imaginary coordinates

rationale.zh: 两组在明示实a,b下配对两系数；虚部是实数，虚数项才含i，点坐标均为实数。另给确实满足原式的复参数对，展示移除实数前提后原唯一性论证失效。
rationale.en: Both match coefficients under an explicit real-parameter premise,distinguish imaginary part from imaginary term,and plot real coordinates. A different complex-parameter pair satisfies each original equation,showing why the original uniqueness argument cannot survive removal of its premise.

focus.zh: 分配四项与平方交叉项
focus.en: Four distributed products and square cross terms

rationale.zh: 两组新数均计算和差积平方，保留四个乘积后用i²=−1收集实虚部。一般(a+bi)²=(a²−b²)+2abi解释遗漏交叉项为何错误，实例仅核回而不替通式。
rationale.en: New complex pairs require sums,differences,products and squares. All four products precede i² replacement and collection. The general square identity explains missing cross terms;examples check the result rather than replacing the general argument.

focus.zh: 共轭、模与零除数
focus.en: Conjugate,modulus and zero denominators

rationale.zh: 3−4i和−5+12i分别区分共轭与负数、模与平方模，以正实模平方有理化并乘回。一般实系数论证共轭等负数当且仅当a=0；模零当且仅当a=b=0，零仍有共轭和模但不能作除数。
rationale.en: Both distinguish conjugation from negation and modulus from squared modulus,rationalise via a positive squared modulus,and multiply back. Real-coefficient arguments give conjugate=negative iff a=0 and modulus zero iff a=b=0. Zero retains its conjugate and modulus but cannot serve as divisor.

focus.zh: 非原点中心、零位移与矩阵
focus.en: Nonorigin centres,zero displacement and matrices

rationale.zh: 两幅等尺度实际坐标图仅给中心与原始点，须生成位移、像点、圆和逆变换。通式(a,b)→(−b,a)保长度，矩阵作用于中心化位移；T(0)非零辨仿射。中心仍有像，零位移无夹角，不把旋转角误赋给零箭头。
rationale.en: Actual equal-scale figures supply only centre and original point;learners generate displacement,image,circle and inverse. General(a,b)→(−b,a) preserves length. The matrix acts on centred displacement;nonzero T(0) distinguishes the affine full map. The centre has an image but zero arrows have no angle.

focus.zh: 非零方向、竖线与全参数覆盖
focus.en: Nonzero direction,vertical lines and full parameter coverage

rationale.zh: 两组从点和非零方向生成参数式与一般式，包含竖直/水平边界；一般点向式反向用非零分量恢复t，给全部直线而非有限点。零方向只给点，一般式A=B=0给全平面或空，不误叫直线。
rationale.en: Both construct parametric/general forms from a point and nonzero direction,including vertical/horizontal cases. A converse recovers t through a nonzero component and establishes full line coverage. Zero direction gives a point;A=B=0 gives a plane or empty set,not a line.

focus.zh: 垂足、方程缩放与最短性
focus.en: Foot,equation scaling and minimality

rationale.zh: 两组精确求H与距离，验证归属和垂直。一般投影公式保非零法向量，任意Q的勾股恒等式证明全体最短；负倍式分子分母同乘绝对倍率，线上点距离零，不将竖直间隔当最短。
rationale.en: Both calculate exact feet/distances and check membership/perpendicularity. General projection retains a nonzero normal. Pythagoras for arbitrary Q establishes global minimality. Negative equation scaling multiplies numerator and denominator by the same absolute factor;on-line distance is zero.

focus.zh: 配方、圆周/圆盘与退化集合
focus.en: Completing squares,circumference/disk and degeneracies

rationale.zh: 两组新平移方程配方读中心、半径和平方半径，比较给定圆周点与圆心。实坐标非负平方和给正值圆、零单点、负值空集；距离非负保证双向等价，圆盘另用不等式而非混同圆周。
rationale.en: Both complete translated square equations and distinguish centre,radius and squared radius. A point on the circumference differs from the centre. Nonnegative real squares classify positive,zero and negative RHS as circle,singleton and empty set. Reversible distance squaring and a separate disk inequality retain the definitions.

focus.zh: 有符号p、准线距离与退化直线
focus.en: Signed p,directrix distance and the degenerate line

rationale.zh: 左右开口的新抛物线均先读4p再生成焦点准线，给定点精确核两距离。一般非负距离平方双向推Y²=4pX，p0时距离定义和代数式同给整直线，不能仍称非退化抛物线。
rationale.en: New left/right-opening parabolas require extracting p from4p,constructing focus/directrix and checking both distances. Squaring nonnegative distances reversibly derives Y²=4pX. At p0,both the distance definition and equation give a whole line,not a nondegenerate parabola.

focus.zh: 焦距和、轴向与三角取等
focus.en: Focal sum,axis direction and triangle equality

rationale.zh: 水平/竖直新椭圆区分2a与2c，恢复b²与方程并核顶点。小于焦距空、等于为闭焦线段、c0为圆另审a0；中心化距离消元与反向正根条件证明完整等价，不仅核若干点。
rationale.en: Horizontal/vertical ellipses distinguish2a from2c,recover b²/equations and check a vertex. Below focal separation is empty;equality is the closed focal segment;coincident foci give a circle with a0 handled separately. Centred elimination and positive-root converse establish full equivalence beyond sample points.

focus.zh: 绝对差双支与最大差的两闭射线
focus.en: Absolute difference,both branches and two exterior rays

rationale.zh: 水平/竖直双曲线固定焦点标签核两顶点有向差±6，绝对值保两支。差0中垂线、差10两外侧闭射线含焦点、差12空，保反三角取等。通式消元及正根反向恢复两支，避免平方加点或把极限差画整轴。
rationale.en: Both orientations check signed differences±6 at vertices with fixed focal labels;absolute value retains both branches. Difference zero gives the perpendicular bisector,ten gives two closed exterior rays including foci,and twelve is impossible. General elimination and positive-root converse restore both branches without extraneous points.

focus.zh: 三维位移、平移与投影漏项
focus.en: Three-dimensional displacement,translation and projection loss

rationale.zh: 两组新端点算三分量位移、反向、模与中点及共同平移后的全部量。一般同加抵消说明不变量，实际xy投影平方25分别漏z平方9/4，不靠屏幕线长判断；零位移无方向，点位置不冒充相对位移。
rationale.en: New endpoint pairs require all three displacement components,reverse,norm,midpoint and translated values. General cancellation proves invariance. Actual xy squared length25 omits z² nine/four,so screen lengths cannot certify space lengths. Zero has no direction and positions do not replace relative displacements.

focus.zh: 全分量线性组合与长度条件
focus.en: Full-component linear combinations and length conditions

rationale.zh: 两组三维组合2u−3v/−2u+v由逆运算逐项核回，并写一般第j分量。平方模证明绝对数乘倍率，零源不称反向；正交单位向量反驳长度总相加，非零同向取等与零边界分开。
rationale.en: Both three-dimensional combinations are recovered componentwise by inverse operations and a general jth-component formula. Squared norms justify absolute scalar length scaling. Zero has no opposite direction. Orthogonal unit vectors refute universal length additivity;nonzero same-direction equality and zero boundaries remain distinct.

focus.zh: 三项点积、向量角与较小线角
focus.en: Three-term dot product,vector angle and smaller line angle

rationale.zh: 两组点积−2、模平方2/3，向量角余弦−√6/3而较小线角余弦√6/3；生成非零正交例并核三分量。零点积反例保两非零前提，结果为实标量，反向平角不混一般钝角。
rationale.en: Both give dot−2 and squared norms two/three:vector cosine−√6/3 differs from smaller-line cosine√6/3. Learners construct a nonzero perpendicular vector and check all components. A zero-vector counterexample preserves nonzero premises. Dot products are real scalars;opposite straight angles differ from general obtuse angles.

focus.zh: 基点归属、唯一交点与异面
focus.en: Base membership,unique intersection and skew lines

rationale.zh: 两组真实三维线面给在内/严格平行/唯一相交的三类，通式代入解释全部分支。线面垂直须方向平行非零法向；另两线方向点积0却z恒不相等，故异面，xy投影交点不当空间交点。
rationale.en: Both three-dimensional line/plane sets realise containment,strict parallelism and unique intersection,with a general substitution classifying every case. Perpendicularity requires direction parallel to a nonzero normal. Extra lines have zero direction dot product but incompatible constant z values,so are skew despite crossing projections.

focus.zh: 垂足归属、非负距离与最短证明
focus.en: Foot membership,nonnegative distances and minimality

rationale.zh: 两组分别求点到平面及直线的精确垂足和距离3/2，核归属与残余垂直。任意Q的点积/勾股链证明全体最短；平面连右端缩放、直线参数逆倍率、对象内点零距及零法向/方向均明示。
rationale.en: Both find exact plane/line feet with distances three/two,checking membership and perpendicular residuals. Dot-product/Pythagorean arguments for arbitrary Q establish global minimality. Scaling includes the plane RHS and inverse line parameter. On-object zero distance and invalid zero normals/directions remain explicit.

focus.zh: 并集身份与逐支合法结果
focus.en: Union identities and legal branch outcomes

rationale.zh: 两组有两重叠编号的并集均5；受限有序对逐支完整列出6/3而非机械12。一般∑n_i只在分支数恒定时化乘法；计数与等可能/概率独立分别审查，不混规则。
rationale.en: Both unions have two overlapping IDs and five distinct outcomes. Complete restricted ordered-pair lists give six/three rather than twelve. General branch sums become a product only with constant continuation counts. Counting is separated from probability independence and equiprobability.

focus.zh: 职位、重复与空列表
focus.en: Roles,repetition and the empty list

rationale.zh: 四/五名不同成员选三职位得24/60，同权4/10；列ABC六序并论证每个不同成员组均六序。允许重复时AAA/AAB/ABC表示次数1/3/6不同，不能统一除6。选0恰一个空结果，r>n无放回为0。
rationale.en: Four/five members give24/60 role assignments and4/10 equal-status groups. Six ABC orders support a bijection for every distinct-member group. With repetition,AAA/AAB/ABC have one/three/six representations,so uniform division fails. Zero selections give one empty outcome;r>n without repetition gives zero.

focus.zh: 统一倍数的双射与实体/字母身份
focus.en: Uniform-multiplicity bijection and physical/letter identity

rationale.zh: 两组都要求先证明每个无序组恰3!表示才用P=C3!；A1,A2,B1按实体给有序6/无序3，只看字母给AA,AB,BA三个有序与AA,AB两无序，倍数不一致。由实际完整小列表辨认除阶乘所需前提。
rationale.en: Both require proving exactly3! representations per unordered distinct-member group before dividing. Physical A1,A2,B1 give six ordered/three unordered selections;displayed letters give AA,AB,BA versus AA,AB,with unequal fibre sizes. Complete small lists expose the premises behind factorial division.

focus.zh: 选末位置、带符号系数与非等概计数
focus.en: Last-position proof,signed coefficients and unequal count masses

rationale.zh: 五/六公平独立币完整分组串数及恰2/3概率5/16，位置数不均分。选/不选末位置证明Pascal，展开系数40/−20另乘负系数幂。计数、代数与独立同p概率的条件分列，有限模拟不强配理论。
rationale.en: Five/six fair independent flips yield complete unequal head-count multiplicities and exactly-two/three probabilities5/16. Including/excluding the final position proves Pascal. Expansion coefficients40/−20 include signed coefficient powers. Counting,algebra and constant-p independence are distinguished;finite simulation is not forced to theory.

focus.zh: 四格原分母与零条件空间
focus.en: Four-cell denominators and zero conditioning mass

rationale.zh: 两张实际四格表分别给4/7对2/3及3/4对2/3，交集概率另算，乘积判据判非独立。等可能编号前提明示；空B普通条件比0/0未定义，不等可能时需概率质量而非仅计数。
rationale.en: Actual four-cell tables give4/7 versus2/3 and3/4 versus2/3,with separate intersection probabilities and product-based dependence checks. Equally likely IDs are explicit. Empty B gives undefined0/0;unequal IDs require probability masses rather than raw counts.

focus.zh: 基础占比、反向标记与退化独立
focus.en: Priors,reverse marking and degenerate independence

rationale.zh: 1000份虚构质量模型由两来源标记质量重建反向概率：1/4变3/4或3/7变9/11；同条件率不抵消先验。两率均30%以乘积证明独立且后验等先验，零先验/零标记保乘积独立而相应条件比未定义。
rationale.en: Fictional1000-unit mass models reconstruct posteriors from both sources:1/4→3/4 or3/7→9/11. Retaining likelihoods does not erase prior effects. Equal30% rates give product independence and posterior=prior. Zero-prior/zero-flag cases retain product independence while the relevant conditional ratios are undefined.

focus.zh: 两个增量、平均速度与非恒定
focus.en: Two increments,average velocity and nonconstancy

rationale.zh: 两个虚构平移平方位置模型端点差0而中途变动，路程2/8、平均速率1/2与平均速度0分开，单位米/秒。一般输出平移抵消且需不同输入端点，同点0/0不当导数。
rationale.en: Two shifted-square displacement models have zero endpoint change but nonconstant interior motion. Distances two/eight and average speeds one/two differ from zero average velocity. General output-shift cancellation retains m/s units and distinct endpoints;0/0 is not a derivative.

focus.zh: 全部非零增量与双侧误差界
focus.en: All nonzero increments and a two-sided error bound

rationale.zh: 新立方函数差商61/4与19/4区别导数12/3，通式3a²+3ah+h²只在h非零约分。固定a的绝对误差界给任意ε、正负两侧，有限正h表不代替极限，延拓不抹原域孔。
rationale.en: Cubic quotients61/4 and19/4 differ from derivatives twelve/three. The full expression3a²+3ah+h² retains h≠0. An absolute error bound handles arbitrary ε and both sides,going beyond a finite positive-h table. Extension does not erase the original domain hole.

focus.zh: 去心邻域、补点与跳跃
focus.en: Punctured neighbourhoods,patched values and jumps

rationale.zh: 中心2/−1的新有理空洞左右极限4/−2，补9/7仍不连续，正确补值才连续。另两侧常值跳跃分别核点值与左右，平均不是极限；完整规则支撑邻域而非屏幕连线。
rationale.en: New rational holes centred at two/−1 have limits four/−2. Patching nine/seven leaves discontinuity;only the limit value repairs it. Separate constant-side jumps distinguish point values and both limits;averaging fails. Full rules,not connected screen samples,describe neighbourhood behaviour.

focus.zh: 连续、尖点、水平穿越与瞬时率
focus.en: Continuity,corners,horizontal crossing and instantaneous rates

rationale.zh: 两组平移绝对值与立方均中心连续，前者差商−1/1不可导但严格极小，后者h²趋0可导但穿越、非恒定非极值。函数值米与导数米/秒、原比h非零均保留。
rationale.en: Translated absolute-value and cubic functions are continuous at their centres. The corner has quotient sides−1/1 and a strict minimum without a derivative. Cubic h² tends to zero while crossing a horizontal tangent,without constancy or an extremum. Values/derivatives retain different units and h≠0.

focus.zh: 导函数、点值和非法乘法
focus.en: Derivative functions,point values and invalid product rules

rationale.zh: 新四次多项式逐项求导并分开f(1)与f′(1)。常数/立方差商支撑规则，乘积先展开为多项式修复导数相乘错误，以具体输入反驳、一般恒等核回，不由少量吻合证明导函数。
rationale.en: New quartics require termwise derivatives and separate f(1),f′(1). Constant/cubic quotients support rules. Expanding products first repairs multiplication-of-derivatives errors,with counter-inputs and general identities rather than finite coincidences as proof.

focus.zh: 点与局部斜率、再次相交及穿越
focus.en: Point/local slope,further intersections and crossing

rationale.zh: 两新接触给完整切线y=2/y=−3x−2，差式分解找全两交点；过点但斜率错的直线不是切线。x³0处水平穿越反驳只碰一次，有限导数公式保原函数点和局部斜率条件。
rationale.en: Both contacts give complete tangent lines y=2/−3x−2. Factoring differences finds all further intersections;passing through with a wrong slope is insufficient. Cubic crossing at zero refutes touching-once definitions. The finite-derivative formula retains the original point and local slope.

focus.zh: 导数区间判据与跨缺口反例
focus.en: Interval derivative criteria and counterexamples across gaps

rationale.zh: 两新平移倒数函数在两个连续区间导数正，但跨缺口两输入反序，不能说全域递增。实际近似图分两支并标灰色排除线，窗外不截断定义域；负函数值仍能递增，一般符号和平均值定理条件分别核。
rationale.en: Two shifted negative reciprocals have positive derivatives on each interval,but crossing the gap reverses order and refutes whole-domain increasingness. Actual plots keep branches separate and label the excluded grey line;the window does not truncate the domain. Negative function values may increase. General signs and mean-value premises are checked separately.

focus.zh: 候选、双侧局部与全部绝对最值
focus.en: Candidates,two-sided local extrema and all absolute extrema

rationale.zh: 新三次函数在闭区间列全部驻点/端点及并列最值，用因子符号论证整段。x³零导非极值、绝对值尖点非驻点、开区间x²界未取到，明确严格双侧局部约定，驻点非充分条件。
rationale.en: New cubics require all stationary/endpoint candidates and tied absolute extrema,with factored signs covering intervals. Cubic zero slope without extrema,an absolute-value corner,and unattained bounds on an open interval preserve the strict two-sided local convention and the insufficiency of stationarity.

focus.zh: 乘积两项与差商连续前提
focus.en: Two product terms and quotient-limit continuity premises

rationale.zh: 两组新乘积明确u′v和uv′，展开原式独立核导函数；x1正确率6/8，原积0/3、错率积2/4。一般加减混合时点积得到两个差商，可导保证连续后取极限，不把高度或两率相乘作变化率。
rationale.en: Both new products identify u′v and uv′,then check via expansion. At one,the correct rates six/eight differ from original products zero/three and rate products two/four. Adding/subtracting a mixed-time product yields two quotients;differentiability supplies continuity before taking limits.

focus.zh: 已有任务中的复合指数与移动上限
focus.en: Existing composite-exponential and moving-limit tasks

rationale.zh: 复用两题原出口。H31-L01-X须解释e^(2x)导数的内导2并与固定幂/指数区分；H32-L05-X须解释累积上限2x时乘2，保连续内点和累积导数不同于累积值。两题都要求理由，重新使用外导在内值处计算再乘内导，不因标签不同漏记有效复现。
rationale.en: Reuse two actual exit tasks. H31-L01-X requires the inner factor two in e^(2x),distinguishing fixed powers from exponentials. H32-L05-X requires factor two for upper limit2x while retaining continuity/interior-point premises and distinguishing accumulated value from its derivative. Both require reasoning and reapply outer-at-inner times inner derivative despite different tags.

focus.zh: 面积率单位、瞬时零速与授权范围
focus.en: Area-rate units,instantaneous zero speed and authorised ranges

rationale.zh: 新正方形模型先算边长/面积，再求带内导的面积率30/−6，负率不是负面积。另平移立方运动瞬时速度0、两侧正且位置改变，不是全段静止/转向；米、平方米、秒与原时间域分开，代数延拓不替情境授权。
rationale.en: New square models distinguish side/area from area rates30/−6 with inner factors;negative rate is not negative area. A separate shifted cubic motion has zero instantaneous velocity but positive sides and changed positions,so neither interval-wide rest nor reversal follows. Units,time domains and algebraic extensions remain distinct.

focus.zh: 原配对、尺度与未定义相关
focus.en: Original pairs,scales and undefined correlation

rationale.zh: 两张新原ID表给r=1/2或−1/2，整行倒序不变，单列排序造出r1并改变具体配对。中心化通式解释正比例/负反射和零尺度，相关不等同斜率，常数列未定义，不能认证因果或代表性。 另各组Q6从完整五ID表重算含/暂排I5的均值、中心化和、r、OLS和SSE，并将四点线用于原I5；保留原记录，敏感性不当错误证明或删点许可。
rationale.en: Two actual original-ID tables give r=1/2 or−1/2. Whole-row reversal preserves r;single-column sorting creates r1 by changing object pairs. General centred deviations explain positive scales,reflection and zero-scale boundaries. Correlation differs from slope;constant columns are undefined,and causation/representativeness remain unproved. Each Q6 additionally rebuilds means, centred sums, r, OLS and SSE with all five original IDs versus a temporary I5-omitted branch, then applies the four-point line to original I5. Preserve source records; sensitivity is neither proof of error nor deletion authority.

focus.zh: 全实参数平方分解与残差条件
focus.en: All-real-parameter square decomposition and residual conditions

rationale.zh: 两组新三行数据独立求各候选竖直残差；均值常数线残差和0却SSE8/2高于最优值6或3/2。完整SSE非负平方恒等式给全参数唯一最优，Σe与Σxe分开；固定x仍有唯一原拟合值而斜率不识别。
rationale.en: New three-row datasets require vertical residuals for each candidate. Mean-only lines have zero residual sum but SSE8/two above minima six/3/2. Full nonnegative-square identities prove all-parameter optima,distinguishing Σe from Σxe. Constant x retains one original fitted mean but not an identified slope.

focus.zh: 原x残差图、弯曲与诊断限度
focus.en: Residuals at original x,curvature and diagnostic limits

rationale.zh: 两幅实际五ID散点及完整文字坐标要求亲生残差图，r=0、残差和0却SSE14/56及系统U形；原x不排序。另等可能抽ID给X=0/Y=0交集1/5非1/25，显式反驳r=0保证独立；小扇形只提示检查，不证明误差模型或外推。 另各组Q6从完整五ID表重算含/暂排I5的均值、中心化和、r、OLS和SSE，并将四点线用于原I5；保留原记录，敏感性不当错误证明或删点许可。
rationale.en: Actual five-ID scatter plots with complete textual coordinates require generating residual plots at original x. Zero r/residual sum coexist with SSE14/56 and U-shaped structure. An auxiliary uniform-ID draw has joint zero-events1/5 rather than1/25,explicitly refuting zero-correlation independence. A small fan is a diagnostic clue,not a certified error model or prediction guarantee. Each Q6 additionally rebuilds means, centred sums, r, OLS and SSE with all five original IDs versus a temporary I5-omitted branch, then applies the four-point line to original I5. Preserve source records; sensitivity is neither proof of error nor deletion authority.

focus.zh: 全样本枚举、样本量与重复数
focus.en: Complete enumeration,sample size and repetition count

rationale.zh: 两完整四ID总体列全六无放回样本，均值期望2/4、理论方差分别2和11/3，原总体方差6/11；同值不同ID不删。固定AB方差0却偏差−2/−3。n变理论、R仅变模拟频率精度，固定种子仅可重现；普查不修测量/缺失。
rationale.en: Two complete four-ID populations yield all six without-replacement samples,mean expectations two/four and theoretical variances two/11/3 versus population variances six/eleven. Equal-valued IDs remain distinct. Fixed AB has variance zero but bias−2/−3. Changing n changes theory;R changes frequency precision,and seeds only reproducibility. Census does not repair measurement/missingness.

focus.zh: 已知/未知逻辑界与两类随机
focus.en: Known/unknown logical bounds and two uses of randomness

rationale.zh: 新60/80成员计数表保已是、已否、未知；回应3/4、5/8不同于总体逻辑界[3/20,19/20]/[1/8,37/40]。两端可达但中间仅1/N刻度，非置信区间。分别说明随机抽样与志愿者随机分配的推论范围和条件，漂亮拟合不修设计。
rationale.en: New60/80-member tables distinguish yes,no and unknown. Response rates3/4,5/8 differ from logical population bounds[3/20,19/20]/[1/8,37/40]. Endpoints are attainable but intermediate proportions lie on a1/N grid;these are not confidence intervals. Random sampling and volunteer random assignment retain different inferential scopes/conditions;attractive fits do not repair design.

focus.zh: 依赖拆解与独立约束
focus.en: Dependency decomposition and separate constraints

rationale.zh: 复用围栏与水箱出口。前者由2x+y=L、正长度和上限构建面积与可行域，再区别可行/全局最优及整数并列；后者逐项构建进水、容量截断、供水、结转与缺口，解释时间先后使总量比较不足以判可行。均要求重新生成模型依赖、量与限制，不只是看先修链接。
rationale.en: Reuse fence and tank exits. The fence constructs area/domain from2x+y=L,positive lengths and a cap,then separates feasibility,global optimality and integer ties. The tank generates inflow,capacity clipping,supply,carry-over and deficits in time order. Both rebuild model dependencies,quantities and constraints rather than merely following prerequisites.

focus.zh: 换横轴、整包逆像与取消分支
focus.en: Changing axes,whole-pack inverse images and cancellation branches

rationale.zh: 两新原规则及实际包数费用图需生成需求/包数/人数费用表，交点k3反推全部整数n，分别含取消为{0,7,8}/{0,6,7}。仿射延拓不当实际小数人数，库存覆盖的正活动k0费用不同于取消，丢活动标志使仅k不能决定唯一费。
rationale.en: New rules and actual pack-fee plots require generating demand/pack/person-fee rows and recovering integer n from k3,giving{0,7,8}/{0,6,7} including cancellation. Affine extensions do not authorise fractional people. Active stock-covered k0 has fees unlike cancellation;discarding event status prevents k alone determining a fee.

focus.zh: 边界、定义域与合法失败
focus.en: Boundaries,domains and valid failures

rationale.zh: 复用最值与容量证明。H31须比较包含端点、尖点和开端点未取到界，不把驻点当全结论。H38在全部非负整数C域以首三日必要下界90和可行账本证明充分，C89是域内但缺1的合法失败，不能把仅检查一个可行方案当最小性证明。
rationale.en: The extrema exit checks included endpoints,corners and unattained open-end bounds. The capacity exit proves necessity C≥90 over all nonnegative integers and sufficiency by a complete ledger;C89 is a valid-domain failure missing one unit. Both distinguish boundaries and domain membership from feasibility and complete proofs.

focus.zh: 有效反例与全称主张的限度
focus.en: Valid counterexamples and limits of universal claims

rationale.zh: 复用零导数最大值主张及局部贪心最短路主张。前者须给x³0处驻点却非极大的反例；后者须生成非负有向陷阱图的两完整合法路径，局部廉价AB1后总10而AC3后总5。原域和前提均保，明确结论失败而非给无效输入。
rationale.en: One task requests a counterexample to zero derivative implying a maximum:cubic at zero satisfies the premise but lacks a maximum. The other requires legal nonnegative directed paths in a greedy trap:locally cheaper AB1 leads to total ten,while AC3 leads to five. Domain and premises remain valid while the universal conclusions fail.

focus.zh: 带单位、可行集与条件性报告
focus.en: Units,feasible sets and conditional reports

rationale.zh: 复用屋顶净高与终章方案报告。屋顶保米单位、上半截面、完整宽度、H3单点/H4空集及未验证结构；水箱保目录和预算及逐日供水，名义/高用量/长干期给不同可行集，区分模型事实、假设、校准和验证，现实新条件需重算。
rationale.en: The roof report retains metre units,upper cross-section,full widths,H3 singleton/H4 empty cases and unvalidated structural assumptions. The tank report retains catalogue,budget and daily supply while nominal,high-use and dry scenarios change feasible sets. Both separate model facts,assumptions and validation,requiring new evidence/recalculation outside scope.

focus.zh: 固定幂、指数内导与正底全域
focus.en: Fixed powers,exponential inner factors and positive-base domains

rationale.zh: 两新多项式/复合指数式须生成完整导函数并分开f0/f′0，正负内导均保。x⁴/4^x与x³/3^x区分变量位置；一般正底指数包含a1恒定，非正底不能借全域公式越过原定义域。
rationale.en: New polynomial/composite-exponential expressions require complete derivatives and separate values/slopes at zero,including positive/negative inner factors. Fixed powers differ from4^x/3^x. The positive-base rule includes constant a1;nonpositive bases cannot inherit the same all-real domain.

focus.zh: 弧度、度变量与正切各分支
focus.en: Radians,degree variables and tangent branches

rationale.zh: 两组三角线性组合保余弦负号及内导，正切3x/2x逐项保全部排除点；度变量G=g(πd/180)多乘换算，G′0为π/30或−π/90而非照抄弧度斜率。图线不跨无定义点。
rationale.en: Both trigonometric combinations retain cosine signs and inner factors. Tangent at3x/2x keeps all excluded branches. Degree-variable G=g(πd/180) adds the conversion factor,giving slopes π/30 or−π/90 rather than copying radian slopes. Graphs cannot bridge undefined points.

focus.zh: 归属、竖直点与零梯度交叉
focus.en: Membership,vertical points and zero-gradient crossings

rationale.zh: 实际等尺度图同时给圆100及另一交叉曲线，须先核P/Q/O归属再求有限斜率/竖直切线。Q的Fy0而Fx非零与交叉O零梯度两分支不同；O不在圆。除法失效不意味着0或统一竖直，奇点需原局部几何。
rationale.en: An actual equal-scale plot gives the radius-ten circle and a different crossing curve. P/Q/O membership precedes finite slopes or vertical tangents. Q has Fy0 with nonzero Fx,unlike zero-gradient crossing O with two branches;O is off the circle. Failed division establishes neither zero slope nor universal verticality.

focus.zh: 复用全候选与新的半开可行域
focus.en: Reused complete candidates and a new half-open feasible domain

rationale.zh: H35原分析维护要求三次函数的全部驻点/端点值和并列绝对最值，含x³、尖点、开界反例；H38新围栏题给半开可行域上的全局最大和未取到的面积下界，再核整数并列与空域。两者都区分候选、局部、全局和取到性，不把零导当最大证明。
rationale.en: The existing H35 analysis task requires all cubic stationary/endpoint candidates and tied extrema,including cubic,corner and open-bound counterexamples. The new H38 fence task proves a global maximum on a half-open domain while its zero infimum is unattained,then handles integer ties and empty domains. Both distinguish candidates,local/global status and attainment.

focus.zh: 约束前置、配方全证与整数并列
focus.en: Prior feasibility,complete-square proof and integer ties

rationale.zh: 两组三边围栏先消元并交正长度/上限，连续最优在约束端点6/5、面积108/90，驻点越界。另整米26/30总长分别两组并列最优84/112，以一般配方覆盖所有允许实/整数，c0空域不当零面积方案。
rationale.en: Both fence models eliminate a dimension and intersect positivity/cap constraints. Continuous maxima occur at cap six/five,areas108/90,not infeasible stationary points. Separate integer26/30-length cases have two tied optima84/112. General square completion covers every allowed point;cap zero gives no feasible zero-area design.

focus.zh: 速度方向、速率分段与瞬时条件
focus.en: Velocity direction,segmented speed and instantaneous conditions

rationale.zh: 负倍/正倍新位移式保三段速度号，路程24/36与位移−8/12、两平均和单位分开。a0且v非零仅瞬时速率导数0，快慢判据限v非零；平移立方v0不转向反驳，位置加常数保各变化量，模型范围外不作实际预测。
rationale.en: Negative/positive scaled displacement models keep three velocity-sign intervals. Distances24/36 differ from displacements−8/12 and both averages. Zero a with nonzero v is only an instantaneous zero speed derivative;the sign criterion requires v≠0. A shifted-cubic zero velocity without reversal is an explicit counterexample. Position shifts preserve rates and changes;outside-range real predictions remain unauthorised.

focus.zh: 分段时间权重、初始量与零时长
focus.en: Duration weights,initial state and zero duration

rationale.zh: 两张实际分段率表宽分别(1,2,1)或(2,1,2)，新增10/11升、平均5/2或11/5，不是三个率的算术平均。新时刻分别核新增7/2或9/2、状态23/2或15/2与当前率分别1与5；零时长平均未定义，有限点改值不改累积。
rationale.en: Actual piecewise tables have duration weights1/2/1 or2/1/2,giving additions ten/eleven litres and averages5/2 or11/5 rather than unweighted rate means. New times distinguish additions7/2,9/2 from states23/2,15/2 and current rates one/five. Zero-duration averages are undefined;finite point changes do not change accumulation.

focus.zh: 非等宽、合法采样与全网格误差
focus.en: Unequal widths,legal tags and whole-mesh error

rationale.zh: 两幅实际非等宽中点矩形图要求生成左中右三和，平方函数中点不精确而仿射例精确。保首格宽1的序列虽格数增多，和趋7/3或8而非真8/3或9；Lipschitz逐格误差总界8mesh/6mesh覆盖任意合法采样，最大宽趋0而非只加格数。
rationale.en: Actual unequal-width midpoint rectangles require all left/middle/right sums. Midpoint is inexact for the square but exact for the affine example. Keeping a width-one cell yields limits7/3 or eight rather than8/3 or nine despite increasing counts. Width-weighted bounds8mesh/6mesh control arbitrary legal tags when maximum width tends to zero.

focus.zh: 任意常数全族、初值与连通分支
focus.en: Complete constant families,initial data and connected components

rationale.zh: 两新多项式净率分别生成全+C族，再用S(0)=4或S(1)=10固定为S(2)分别12或13并求导核回。C²漏负常数、2C−7仍全体；两原函数差导数0须同一连通区间。两支域导数1而差0/1的反例，及指数/三角回查均实际要求。
rationale.en: New polynomial rates require complete+C families before initial data fixes states twelve/thirteen at time two. Derivatives check the rate. C² misses negative constants;2C−7 covers all. Equality up to one constant needs a connected interval;a two-component derivative-one counterexample has differences zero/one. Exponential/trigonometric primitives are checked too.

focus.zh: 有向贡献、无向区域与共同常数
focus.en: Signed contributions,unoriented regions and a shared constant

rationale.zh: 两新一次函数以零点分段，原积分3/2或−3、面积5/2或5，反向只改积分符号。改上界使净0但总面积分别1与8，反驳函数恒0；等端点0与高度无关。同一C抵消，独立端点常数不是同一原函数。
rationale.en: New linear examples split at zeros:integrals3/2 or−3 differ from areas5/2 or five. Reversing bounds changes signed integrals only. New upper bounds give zero net integral but total areas one/eight,refuting identical-zero claims. Equal endpoints ignore height. A common C cancels;separate endpoint constants are not one primitive.

focus.zh: 累积值、移动上限与跳点条件
focus.en: Accumulated values,moving limits and jump premises

rationale.zh: 新上限2x/x²的累积先积分再求导核，A1为7/3或3/2而导数分别8或4；第二例0处内导0不能漏。邻近平均率的双侧论证需连续内点，跳率2/5的累积仍连续而左右导数不同，改单点值不改积分且不补导数。
rationale.en: New2x/x² upper limits are integrated and differentiated independently. Values at one7/3,3/2 differ from derivatives eight/four;the second inner derivative vanishes at zero. Two-sided local averages need continuity/interior-point premises. A2/5 jump has continuous accumulation but unequal side derivatives;point edits change neither the integral nor derivative existence.

focus.zh: 三种量纲、净/总流与交点换边
focus.en: Three unit structures,gross/net flow and switching curves

rationale.zh: 新运动分别算位移分别0与3、路程分别4与5、末位置分别3与8及两平均。新水量保初始和独立流出，分别总流入8/15、净4/12、末6/16并核非负。实际两曲线图先求交点再分三段绝对面积49/6或11/6，单位来自轴量而非像素，三个模型不混时间/状态。
rationale.en: New motions distinguish displacements zero/three,distances four/five,final positions three/eight and both averages. Separate water models retain initial state/outflow,gross inflows eight/fifteen,net changes four/twelve,final amounts six/sixteen and nonnegativity. Actual curve plots require intersections and three absolute-area segments49/6 or11/6. Units derive from quantities,not pixels;the models do not share time/state.

focus.zh: 编号原像与合法质量
focus.en: ID preimages and legal mass

rationale.zh: 完整原编号表先均匀抽ID再映射新X和绝对值Y；重复值对应的编号均保留，用原像概率相加，不按不同取值平分。反查负项/不全和、合法零行及支持，两个后续单元重新生成不同分布。
rationale.en: Complete ID tables map uniform IDs to new X and absolute-value Y. Equal-valued IDs retain their masses;preimages merge instead of reweighting distinct values equally. Negative/incomplete masses,legal zero rows and support are checked in two later contexts.

focus.zh: 期望、非可取总和与无补偿
focus.en: Expectation,unattainable totals and no compensation

rationale.zh: 两张新非等权偏移表求均值2/11⁄2、期望位置单点率0及仿射期望。十次期望20/55均不在该次总和支持；条件率2/3或3/4不因过去偏小改变，区分有限波动、线性与独立及种子复现。
rationale.en: New unequal-weight offset laws give means two/11⁄2,zero mass at the expectation and affine expectations. Ten-draw expected totals twenty/fifty-five are unattainable in those runs. Conditional chances2/3,3/4 persist after small outcomes,distinguishing finite fluctuations,linearity,independence and seeded reproducibility.

focus.zh: 加权平方距离与负尺度
focus.en: Weighted squared distance and negative scales

rationale.zh: 新方差8/27⁄4用两式核，负倍率使方差72/27、标准差6√2/3√3；中心化通式证a²与|a|，不是样本n−1。零倍率分布合法而z未定义，保cm²与cm。
rationale.en: Variances eight/27⁄4 are checked by both formulas. Negative scales give variances seventy-two/twenty-seven and SDs6√2/3√3. The centred identity proves a² and |a|,without a sample n−1 divisor. Zero scaling leaves a valid constant law but undefined z;cm² and cm stay distinct.

focus.zh: 二项前提、序列因子与退化
focus.en: Binomial premises,ordered factors and degeneracy

rationale.zh: 两新固定独立同p模型亲算恰k、补事件及两矩；有序互斥序列解释组合因子。另两袋不放回给1/15与1/10，反驳独立套式；异p、结果停、n0/p0/p1逐项核条件。
rationale.en: New fixed independent common-p laws require exact-k,complements and moments,with disjoint ordered strings explaining the combination factor. Two without-replacement bags give1/15,1/10,refuting independent formulas. Unequal p,outcome-based stopping and n0/p0/p1 boundaries are audited.

focus.zh: 密度、全轴尾部与形状限制
focus.en: Density,whole-line tails and shape limits

rationale.zh: 实际双正态图明确均值/方差参数，σ加倍峰减半而全实轴面积1；单点0、区间约0.6827及图外非零尾部。另四ID对称分布同均值和σ却闭一σ概率1、开区间0，不将对称/钟形外观或有限频率当正态证明。
rationale.en: Actual two-normal plots state mean/variance parameters:double SD halves peaks while whole-line areas remain one. Point mass zero,approximate0.6827 intervals and nonzero off-window tails are distinguished. Symmetric four-ID laws have the same moments but closed one-SD probability one,open zero;appearance/frequency does not certify normality.

focus.zh: 左尾表、z参照与非正态反例
focus.en: Left-tail tables,z references and nonnormal counterexamples

rationale.zh: 实际六位左尾表生成0.8664/0.9545区间及0.0228/0.0668右尾，保原界/z界和舍入顺序。另四ID上值z1而左尾1，不是Φ1；零σ不可除，不同测量目标不能仅以同z评优劣。
rationale.en: Actual six-decimal left-tail tables yield intervals0.8664/0.9545 and right tails0.0228/0.0668,retaining original/z bounds and rounding order. Four-ID upper values have z1 but left-tail probability one,not Φ1. Zero SD precludes division;equal z alone cannot rank different measurement goals.

focus.zh: 单次误差与设计偏差
focus.en: Realised errors and design bias

rationale.zh: 两张实际完整六ID表，完整框的无放回均值无偏；受限ABCD框均值偏差−2或2 cm，仍可能抽CD恰零误差。框内普查不修遗漏，完整普查不自动修测量/缺失，入样率证明期望而非挑样本认证。
rationale.en: Actual six-ID tables distinguish zero realised error from unbiasedness. Full-frame pair means are unbiased;ABCD-frame bias is−2 or two cm,yet CD can give zero error. A frame census retains omissions;even a complete census does not repair measurement/missingness. Inclusion probabilities prove expectation instead of choosing one lucky sample.

focus.zh: 抽样分布与重复的边界
focus.en: Sampling laws and repetition limits

rationale.zh: 两个新总体列全15对及同均值质量，原方差16、两人均值方差32/5、三人16/5、全体0，SE需取根。受限框方差4/3、相对全体MSE16/3，R不改偏差或理论离散分布，n和R作用分开。
rationale.en: New populations require all fifteen ID pairs and merged mean masses. Original variance sixteen becomes32/5 for pair means,16/5 for triples,and zero for a full census;SE is its root. Restricted-frame variance4/3 and full-target MSE16/3 remain distinct. Repetitions alter neither bias nor the discrete theory;n and R play different roles.

focus.zh: 区间条件与重复覆盖
focus.en: Interval assumptions and repeated coverage

rationale.zh: 两新已知σ的IID正态模型重算SE、z2/1.96区间、四倍n宽减半；实际四构造均值图不泄区间，端点含真值的三行给3/4，明确非模拟/用户数据，不能替代名义覆盖或给固定μ赋后验率。
rationale.en: New known-σ IID normal models regenerate SE,z2/1.96 intervals and width halving at fourfold n. Actual four-mean plots do not reveal intervals;three boundary-inclusive covers give3/4 in teaching constructions,explicitly not simulation/user data. This does not calibrate nominal coverage or give fixed μ a posterior probability.

focus.zh: 预设极端、离散错误率与不拒绝
focus.en: Planned extremeness,discrete errors and nonrejection

rationale.zh: 新5/6试验分别在α1/20或1/8核上侧和预设双侧，p1/32对1/16、7/64对7/32；实际错误率不机械等于α，双侧域可空。不拒绝不证无差异，等效须单独预设范围；换尾/窥看/多重选择保留条件。
rationale.en: New five/six-trial null laws at α1/20 or1/8 compare planned upper/two-sided p values1/32 versus1/16,and7/64 versus7/32. Actual error need not equal α,and a discrete rejection set may be empty. Nonrejection does not prove no difference;equivalence needs a planned range. Tail switching,peeking and selection retain their limitations.

focus.zh: 实际目标、显著方向与设计
focus.en: Practical targets,significant direction and design

rationale.zh: 两张四情境原效应/n表按σ8/6、阈值2/1分钟重算区间与p。同z5同p的A/C效应相差十倍且目标结论不同；B宽且不确定，D显著有害。抽样/分配的推论范围不互换，构造数据不认证真实研究或因果。
rationale.en: Two actual four-case effect/n tables use σ8/six and target two/one minutes. Equal z5/p in A/C accompanies tenfold effects and different target conclusions. B remains uncertain;D is significantly harmful. Sampling and assignment support different inference scopes,and teaching constructions certify neither real research nor causation.

focus.zh: 原复合域与分支逆序
focus.en: Original composite domains and inverse branch order

rationale.zh: 新门槛u≥2/≤−2或u≥1/≤−1与平移复合，亲生原域、值域、两逆及双向验回；域外平方多项式值不补定义。全平方非单射、逆复合逆序、a0公共端点和倒数差异均实际要求。
rationale.en: New thresholds u≥2/≤−2 or u≥1/≤−1 combined with shifts require original domains,ranges,both branch inverses and two-way checks. Polynomial extension values do not restore invalid inputs. Full-square noninjectivity,reverse undoing,a0 endpoints and reciprocal distinctions are required.

focus.zh: 递减底的等价与原对数条件
focus.en: Decreasing-base equivalence and original log conditions

rationale.zh: 两新半底对数和候选±6/±5仅留正支，分别回两原真数核。半底指数等式仍一对一，不等式翻向生成[3,∞)/(−∞,−2]；b1指数退化而log1未定义，非正底不获全实指数域。
rationale.en: New half-base log sums have candidates±6/±5 but retain only positive branches after checking BOTH original arguments. Half-base exponent equality remains injective,while inequalities reverse to[3,∞)/(−∞,−2]. Base-one exponent degeneracy differs from undefined log base one;nonpositive bases gain no all-real exponent domain.

focus.zh: 因式约分与全部周期孔
focus.en: Factor cancellation and all periodic holes

rationale.zh: 新商式cos²/(1+sin)及给定二倍角后的(1−cos2θ)/sin，先因式证明再排−π/2+2kπ或kπ。延拓2/0不当原孔值，不能约加减项；有限试角和窗口不作恒等式证明。
rationale.en: New quotients cos²/(1+sin) and the supplied double-angle(1−cos2θ)/sin require factor proofs before excluding−π/2+2kπ or kπ. Extension values two/zero are not original hole values. Additive-term cancellation and finite angle/window checks do not prove identities.

focus.zh: 点身份、反射与零倍率的域
focus.en: Point identity,reflection and domains at zero scaling

rationale.zh: 实际源抛物线及P/Q生成两新变换：目标(0,−5)/(2,−5)或(−6,8)/(2,8)，水平倍率1/2或2。偶对称使图集重合但点映射反转；一般内层原域不因a0恢复，1/u在b0为空域，在a0且b非零仍有孔。
rationale.en: Actual SOURCE parabola and P/Q require new target points(0,−5)/(2,−5) or(−6,8)/(2,8),with horizontal factors1/2 or two. Even symmetry conceals pointwise reflection. The general inner-input domain is retained at a0:1/u with b0 has empty domain,and with a0/nonzero b still has its hole.

focus.zh: 完备候选、增根与丢根
focus.en: Exhaustive candidates,extraneous and lost roots

rationale.zh: 每单元四独立方程重建原域与候选；根式域内负候选失败、分式唯一候选落孔给合法空集，零乘积保0，绝对值两支齐全。以包含/等价推出完备而非只代回或看有限图窗。
rationale.en: Four independent equations per unit rebuild original domains and candidate sets. Negative radical candidates fail within domain;the sole rational candidate is a hole,proving emptiness. Zero products preserve zero and absolute values retain both branches. Inclusion/equivalence proves completeness rather than substitution or finite plots alone.

focus.zh: 完整交点与次数前提
focus.en: Complete intersections and degree premises

rationale.zh: 两新非零方向参数先求t再还原完整点集(±8,6)/(±3,4)，精确回两式。圆竖切线重根与竖线抛物线一次单交点分开，渐近线代入常数矛盾，不把唯一点自动当切点或只交x根。
rationale.en: New nonzero-direction parameters require full point sets(±8,6)/(±3,4) and original checks. Repeated circle roots differ from linear vertical-parabola singletons;asymptote substitution is a constant contradiction. A singleton does not automatically prove tangency,nor do x roots finish an intersection.

focus.zh: 反构可达与半平面孔
focus.en: Inverse reachability,half-planes and holes

rationale.zh: 平移固定端点的新中点轨迹分别上半圆心(2,1)半径3排(5,1)，或下半圆心(−1,2)半径2排(−3,2)。四候选逐一反构唯一P，保另一端点、极点与错误半平面，必要/充分均实际要求。
rationale.en: Shifted midpoint loci are upper circle centre(2,1),radius three,excluding(5,1),or lower circle centre(−1,2),radius two,excluding(−3,2). Four candidates reconstruct unique sources,distinguishing retained endpoints/poles from holes and wrong half-planes. Necessity and sufficiency are both required.

focus.zh: 参数像、漏点及非时间
focus.en: Parameter images,omissions and no automatic clock

rationale.zh: 半径6/4的新有理参数在全有限R漏E，反解证明其余全可达。新限制[−1,1]/有限[1,∞)重建不同完整圆弧及端点；三点精确弦长反匀速，导数模2r/(1+t²)也非常数，极限不当有限取值。
rationale.en: New radius-six/four rational maps omit E for all finite parameters,and inverse reconstruction covers every other point. Restrictions[−1,1]/finite[1,∞) give different complete arcs/endpoints. Exact three-point chords refute uniform motion;derivative magnitude2r/(1+t²) is not constant. A limit is not a finite value.

focus.zh: 零向量、共线与双向圆周角
focus.en: Zero vectors,collinearity and two-way diameter angles

rationale.zh: 新平移直径端点给点积(x−1)²+(y+2)²−25或(x+2)²+(y−1)²−16，轨迹排A/B。实际源AB/P/C图不泄圆；P/C/Q/T分核普通钝/平/普通锐/零角，点积0与零向量无定义不可混。
rationale.en: Translated diameter endpoints give dots(x−1)²+(y+2)²−25 or(x+2)²+(y−1)²−16,excluding A/B from the locus. Actual given AB/P/C plots do not reveal the circle. P/C/Q/T separately give obtuse/straight/acute/zero angles;zero-dot endpoint vectors leave angles undefined.

focus.zh: 全通道净高与坐标模型
focus.en: Whole-passage clearance and coordinate models

rationale.zh: 新10×5与8×4半轴上屋顶，在两净高算完整区间/两边界/总宽；偏心1的通道即使总宽相等、中心足够，高净高仍失败。一般闭区间全包含证明、H0/顶点零宽/超高空集、上下半与模型限度均保留。
rationale.en: Upper roofs with semiaxes10×5 and8×4 require full intervals,both boundaries and full widths at two clearances. Off-centre-one passages fail at the higher clearance despite matching total width and adequate central height. Whole-interval containment,H0/apex zero-width/above-roof emptiness,upper-section restrictions and model limits remain explicit.

focus.zh: 归纳基例与任意传递
focus.en: Induction bases and arbitrary steps

rationale.zh: 新偶数和/步长5数列和给完整归纳，临时假设用于条件句而非全称；只传递、只基例、有限100次和跳2漏偶数分别反驳。
rationale.en: New even-number/arithmetic sums require full induction. Temporary hypotheses prove conditionals,not the universal claim. Step-only,base-only,one hundred trials and jump-two omission are separately challenged.

focus.zh: 规则、初值与零索引
focus.en: Rules,seeds and zero indexing

rationale.zh: 新3u+2与2u−3规则重建通项、基例和任意k，给相同五项但第六项差120的未声明规则反例；两个不同第二初值证明二阶资料不足，不冒称同一完整规则多解。
rationale.en: New3u+2 and2u−3 rules regenerate closed forms,bases and arbitrary steps. An undeclared-rule prefix counterexample differs by120 at its sixth term. Different second seeds prove second-order underdetermination,without claiming ambiguity for a fully specified rule.

focus.zh: 全局暂定距离与简单路
focus.en: Global tentative labels and simple paths

rationale.zh: 两张完整有向边表分别列全部两条/四条最优简单路，保零边、孤立点与箭头。第二图零环给无限最优游走而非无限简单路；全局最小非局部便宜，非负证明及负边局限齐全。
rationale.en: Complete directed tables require all two/four optimal simple paths,retaining zero weights,isolated nodes and direction. The second zero cycle yields infinitely many optimal walks,not simple paths. Global-label versus local-edge choice and nonnegative-premise proofs remain explicit.

focus.zh: 基像、复合与不可逆
focus.en: Basis images,composition and noninvertibility

rationale.zh: 两组新矩阵从列生成AB/BA及检验向量，两侧验逆；不同压缩给两个同像原向量与det0。一般线性组合解释基像充分，固定平移反例保线性前提。
rationale.en: New matrices regenerate AB/BA,probe images and two-sided inverses. Distinct collapses exhibit two preimages and determinant zero. General linear combinations justify basis sufficiency;fixed translations preserve the linearity caveat.

focus.zh: 包围不变量、试点与残差
focus.en: Bracket invariants,trials and residuals

rationale.zh: 平方根3/立方根2独立二分三次，当前中点27/16或21/16与末试点分开。连续根包围给1/16误差界，异号断点/同号偶根/精确端点与多根另核，缩放残差不缩横误差。
rationale.en: Three new bisections for sqrt3/cuberoot2 distinguish current midpoints27/16 or21/16 from last trials. Continuous brackets give1/16 bounds. Discontinuous sign changes,even roots,exact endpoints,multiple roots and rescaled residuals retain their distinct roles.

focus.zh: 有序水量与守恒
focus.en: Ordered water balance and conservation

rationale.zh: 两新面积/效率与五日表生成七列全账本，容量36/40的第三日缺18/20而总量有余。单位换算、溢流离开、实际供水与非负存量保留，守恒独立核。
rationale.en: New area/efficiency and five-day tables require seven-column ledgers. Capacities36/40 miss18/20 on day three despite excess totals. Unit conversion,departed overflow,actual service,nonnegative storage and independent balance checks are retained.

focus.zh: 开发数据与冻结后验证
focus.en: Development data and post-freeze validation

rationale.zh: 两张三批七行表逐点核实测减预测及含等号容差；B启发改模后不再独立，冻结后C在一组全通过另一组含失败，均不证明全域或溢流因果；再改仍需新数据。
rationale.en: Seven-row three-batch tables require pointwise observed-minus-predicted residuals and inclusive tolerances. B used in revision is no longer independent. Post-freeze C passes both in one case and includes failure in the other;neither proves universal truth or overflow causation. Further revision needs new data.

focus.zh: 公平调用、单调与预算窗口
focus.en: Fair calls,monotonicity and budget windows

rationale.zh: 新供水阈值54/60，在0..100/127按同缓存规则含上界预检，扫描56/62调对二分8调；一般存水归纳证供水单调，预算使联合窗口54..60/60..65，盲预检会误报空集。
rationale.en: New supply thresholds54/60 on0..100/127 use equal caching rules INCLUDING upper prechecks:scan56/62 versus binary eight calls. Storage induction proves supply monotonicity;budget creates54..60/60..65 windows,where blind upper prechecks would falsely report emptiness.

focus.zh: 必要下界与可行充分
focus.en: Necessary bounds and sufficient ledgers

rationale.zh: 新三日无补给前缀给所有整数容量下界54/60，再完整五日账本证该候选可行，小1升缺1交叉核。较大可行不等最优，比较域与固定天气范围写全。
rationale.en: New three-day prefixes give bounds54/60 for ALL integer capacities;complete ledgers prove those candidates feasible and one-litre-smaller misses one. Larger feasibility differs from optimality;objective/domain and fixed-weather scope remain explicit.

focus.zh: 目录交集、成本与压力
focus.en: Catalogue intersections,costs and stress

rationale.zh: 新完整目录与两预算列全名义/高用量交集和最低价；长干期前缀至少缺18/20使任何大空箱无解。情景改变不同于原运算错，新增证据后重建与独立验证保留。
rationale.en: New full catalogues and two budgets require nominal/high-use intersections and least costs. Dry prefixes miss at least18/20 for ANY initially empty tank. Changed scenarios differ from bad arithmetic,and rebuilding after new evidence still requires independent validation.
